paper.title: Certified Multi-Turn Robustness for LLM Safety via Compositional Bounds and Safety Persistence
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to multi-turn jailbreak attacks that progressively manipulate conversation context. Existing certified robustness methods are limited to single-turn inputs; naive multi-turn composition yields bounds that degrade exponentially in the number of turns. We introduce Multi-Turn Certified Robustness (MTCR), a framework that models conversational safety via State-Adversarial MDPs and defines $k$-turn certified robustness as the worst-case safety probability

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究多轮对话中的安全鲁棒性认证：单轮 jailbreak 防御的认证结果不能直接用于多轮场景，因为逐轮相乘的下界会随轮数快速变小，几轮之后几乎没有可用保证。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏安全认证和理论框架，不是预训练方法论文。对基座研究的价值在于提醒两点。第一，多轮对话的风险不是单轮风险的简单重复，历史状态会积累，攻击者会根据模型回复自适应调整输入。第二，安全后训练或 safety tuning 的评测如果只看单轮，很容易高估真实部署稳定性。它对训练目标设计也有间接启发：如果希望模型在长对话中保持安全行为，仅优化单轮拒答或单轮偏好数据不够，需要显式考虑 safety persistence，即安全状态在多步交互中的保持性质。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把多轮对话建模为 State-Adversarial MDP。对话历史经过表示函数映射成状态，攻击者在每一轮从参考输入附近的 epsilon 扰动集合中选择用户消息，模型按策略生成回复，状态随用户输入和模型回复更新。安全性由状态空间上的 Safe predicate 定义。论文定义 k-turn certified robustness：在任意自适应攻击者下，连续 k 轮保持安全的最坏情况概率。直接用单轮认证概率相乘会得到 p^k 的下界，衰减很快。为缓解这个问题，MTCR 引入两类结构。第一是 embedding-space mode decomposition，把状态空间分解为若干 mode，分别认证 mode 内安全性和 mode 间转移，从而比朴素乘法更紧。第二是 (alpha, beta)-safety persistence，刻画安全状态在后续步骤中持续保持的性质；当 beta 大于最坏单轮下界时，认证退化可从 p^k 改善到 beta^k，并可用 1 - k(1 - beta) 给出更可解释的 horizon 估计。论文还给出非重叠分解下的 tightness 结果，以及缺少结构假设时的 impossibility 结论。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖六个 production LLM。论文报告 MTCR 给出的 certified bounds 在 epsilon-bounded adversary 设定下成立；在静态 epsilon-ball 攻击和 Crescendo-style adaptive attacks 下，经验安全率都高于认证下界，没有观察到违反 bound 的情况。文中给出一个示例说明朴素乘法的问题：如果每轮认证安全概率为 0.95，则 10 轮下界约为 0.60，20 轮约为 0.36，50 轮约为 0.08；如果要求 k 轮安全概率至少 0.9，只能支持约 2 轮。这组数字解释了为什么需要 compositional bounds 和 safety persistence。需要注意，形式化认证只覆盖 epsilon-bounded perturbations；Crescendo 这类语义级攻击主要作为经验测试，不在严格认证威胁模型内。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。优先看 Problem Formulation，弄清 SA-MDP、k-turn certified robustness 和 naive multiplicative bound。然后看 compositional certification 和 (alpha, beta)-safety persistence 的定理陈述，不必逐行读证明。实验部分重点看六个 production LLM 的认证下界与经验攻击成功率之间的关系。对预训练研究员来说，最有用的部分不是具体认证算法，而是它把多轮安全分解成状态转移、模式结构和安全持久性的方式，可用于思考多轮 safety data、RL 训练信号和长对话评测。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses certified robustness for multi-turn LLM safety. Single-turn certificates do not compose well in conversations: multiplying per-turn lower bounds gives guarantees that decay rapidly with the number of turns.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a safety certification paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but useful. It makes clear that multi-turn safety is a sequential problem: conversation history accumulates adversarial influence, and the attacker can adapt after observing model responses. This has implications for safety tuning and evaluation. A model that looks robust in single-turn refusal tests may not preserve safety over longer interactions, so post-training data and evaluation protocols need to account for safety persistence across turns.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework, Multi-Turn Certified Robustness (MTCR), models conversation as a State-Adversarial MDP. Dialogue history is mapped to a continuous state; at each turn an adversary chooses a user message from an epsilon-bounded perturbation set; the LLM responds according to its policy; and the state is updated. Safety is defined by a predicate over the state space. The central quantity is k-turn certified robustness: the worst-case probability of staying safe for k turns under any adaptive adversary. A naive certificate gives a lower bound of p^k, where p is the worst-case single-turn certified safety probability. MTCR tightens this through embedding-space mode decomposition, separately certifying intra-mode safety and inter-mode transitions. It also introduces (alpha, beta)-safety persistence, a structural condition under which the degradation can improve from p^k to beta^k when beta is larger than the worst-case single-turn bound, with a linear characterization 1 - k(1 - beta) for interpretable horizon estimates. The paper also discusses tightness for non-overlapping decompositions and impossibility results without structural assumptions.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers six production LLMs. The certified bounds are reported for epsilon-bounded adversaries, and empirical safety remains above the bounds under both static epsilon-ball attacks and Crescendo-style adaptive attacks. A motivating calculation shows why naive composition is weak: with a per-turn certified safety probability of 0.95, the lower bound is about 0.60 at 10 turns, 0.36 at 20 turns, and 0.08 at 50 turns; requiring a guarantee of at least 0.9 would allow only around two turns. The formal guarantee is limited to epsilon-bounded perturbations. Semantic multi-turn attacks such as Crescendo are used empirically, but they are not fully covered by the stated certification model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the problem formulation first to understand the SA-MDP setup, the definition of k-turn certified robustness, and the naive multiplicative bound. Then read the statements around compositional certification and (alpha, beta)-safety persistence; the proof details are less important unless working on certification. In the experiments, check whether empirical safety stays above the certified lower bounds across the six production models. For pretraining researchers, the main useful idea is the decomposition of multi-turn safety into state transitions, mode structure, and persistence, which can inform long-dialogue safety data design and post-training evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把多轮安全从‘经验防御’推进到可组合证书；先看理论定义和退化率那几页，能帮你判断多轮对齐信号到底有多脆。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it upgrades multi-turn safety from empirical defense to compositional certification; read the formalism and degradation-rate sections to calibrate how brittle multi-turn alignment really is.

paper.title: Leveraging Association Context Retrieval in Knowledge Edit- ing to Build White-Box Attacks on LLMs
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are granted increasing autonomy, it is essential to investigate methods that can induce unsafe behavior. We propose a novel white-box attack inspired by locate-then-edit approaches from the field of Knowledge Editing. Our choice is motivated by the observation that models edited with such schemes tend to assign unusually high prediction probabilities to the edit target, a property that is particularly advantageous when designing attacks. We modify the editing fram

summary.core_problem: 研究如何利用 knowledge editing 的 locate-then-edit 机制构造白盒攻击，使 LLM 在某一主题类别上更容易产生不安全行为。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是安全攻击方法。它把知识编辑中“目标 token 概率异常升高”的副作用转化为攻击手段，对理解模型内部知识定位、约束移除和安全边界有一定参考价值，但与基座预训练方法的直接关系较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从 knowledge editing 出发，先定位与目标知识或行为相关的模型内部位置，再结合从模型中检索出的 associative context，把原本面向单条 prompt 或单个事实的编辑扩展为主题类别级的约束移除。核心是用白盒参数修改增强攻击目标的预测概率，同时尽量控制对通用能力的破坏。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多种架构上实验，相比竞争攻击方法有更高攻击有效性，并且没有对通用模型性能造成严重损伤。给定信息未披露具体模型、参数规模、攻击成功率、baseline 名称或标准能力评测细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how locate-then-edit knowledge editing can be repurposed into a white-box attack that induces unsafe behavior across a thematic category.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a safety-attack contribution. It is relevant to model internals because it turns a known side effect of knowledge editing—overconfident edit targets—into an attack primitive, but it is not directly about pretraining recipes or foundation-model scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method adapts locate-then-edit schemes by retrieving associative knowledge from the model and using it to remove constraints over a broader theme rather than a fixed prompt set. The attack modifies model parameters to raise target probabilities while attempting to preserve general model performance.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments across several architectures, improved attack effectiveness over competing methods, and no critical damage to general performance. The supplied abstract does not specify model sizes, exact baselines, attack success rates, or evaluation suites.

recommendation.zh: 作为白盒安全备查即可；knowledge editing 到 jailbreak 的桥有意思，但离 pretrain 决策较远。
recommendation.en: Useful as a white-box safety reference; the editing-to-jailbreak bridge is interesting but too far from pretrain decisions.

paper.title: JailbreakSkill: Scaling Automated Red-Teaming with Reusable and Ever-Evolving Skills
paper.abstract: Automated red-teaming has produced a growing collection of attack strategies, yet they typically remain scattered across prompts and workflows, making them difficult to systematically integrate, reuse, and improve at scale. We introduce \textsc{JailbreakSkill}, a skill-centric framework for scaling automated red-teaming through reusable and continuously evolving attack capabilities. \textsc{JailbreakSkill} packages existing attack strategies into modular, agent-ready skills that can be directly

summary.core_problem: 自动化 red-teaming 已经从单轮 prompt 攻击走向多轮自适应流程，但攻击知识通常散落在 prompt、memory 和 workflow 代码里，难以复用、替换和持续改进。JailbreakSkill 试图把攻击方法从一次性 prompt 或固定流程中抽出来，表示成可执行、可诊断、可演化的技能单元。
summary.importance: 这项工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对安全评测和对齐数据生成有启发。它把 jailbreak 经验组织成可维护的程序化资产，而不是只保存成功 prompt。这个思路适合用于构造更系统的 red-teaming 数据闭环：失败样本不只是下一轮搜索的上下文，而会被归因、抽象成可复用攻击策略，再进入后续评测或安全训练数据生产。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 skill-centric red-teaming。系统维护三类技能：rewrite skill 负责把有害 seed prompt 改写成攻击 prompt；failure-analysis skill 负责聚合未成功攻击轨迹，诊断共性失败模式；evolution skill 负责基于失败模式 refine、combine 或 discover 新的 rewrite skill。完整流程分两阶段。Stage 1 使用初始技能库攻击输入行为，并把攻击轨迹、风险类别和成功统计写入 skill memory。planner 根据风险条件统计选择技能，由外部 executor model 执行。Stage 2 对 Stage 1 没解决的行为做失败聚类和诊断，再生成候选技能；候选技能经过验证后才加入技能库。与直接进化一个端到端攻击程序不同，它保留独立可寻址的技能，因此局部更新和跨任务复用更容易。
summary.experiments: 实验在 AdvBench 和 HarmBench 上评估，覆盖多个目标模型。摘要给出的主结果是 macro-average attack success rate 提升约 17.5 个百分点。全文描述的重点不只是最终 ASR，而是预算约束下的攻击效率、Stage 1 预算内未解决行为的恢复能力，以及新技能在不同目标模型之间的迁移。消融应重点看三类技能是否都必要：只复用初始 rewrite skill、加入 failure analysis、再加入 evolution skill 的差异，能说明性能来自简单多尝试还是来自失败驱动的技能增长。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 prompt-level、memory-based、dynamic workflow 三类方法局限的拆分；再看 Method 的技能表示、两阶段流程和 skill memory/planner 交互。实验部分重点找 ASR 与 query budget 的曲线、Stage 1 unresolved behaviors 的恢复统计、跨模型迁移表，以及 evolution 产生的新技能示例。对 LLM 基座研究员来说，最值得借鉴的是失败样本如何被压缩成可复用训练或评测资产，而不是具体 jailbreak 文案。

summary_en.core_problem: Automated red-teaming has moved beyond one-shot jailbreak prompts, but the reusable knowledge is still entangled with prompts, memories, and workflow-specific orchestration. JailbreakSkill addresses this by turning attack strategies into modular executable skills that can be selected, diagnosed, revised, and reused across behaviors and target models.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining method, but it is useful for safety evaluation and alignment-data pipelines. Its main contribution is an operational representation of red-teaming knowledge. Failed attacks are not only used as context for the next prompt search; they are analyzed, abstracted into reusable attack procedures, validated, and added back to a skill library. That is a useful pattern for building closed-loop safety data generation systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework defines three skill types. Rewrite skills transform harmful seed prompts into adversarial prompts. Failure-analysis skills identify recurring failure modes from unsuccessful traces. Evolution skills refine existing rewrite skills, combine multiple skills, or discover new ones. A run has two stages. Stage 1 applies the initial rewrite-skill library under a planner that uses risk-conditioned statistics from a shared skill memory. An external executor model invokes the selected skills. Stage 2 groups unresolved traces, diagnoses common failure patterns, proposes candidate rewrite skills, validates them, and adds useful ones to the library. The key design choice is to evolve independently addressable skills rather than a monolithic attack program.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses AdvBench and HarmBench with multiple target models. The abstract reports a macro-average ASR gain of about 17.5 percentage points. The more informative results are budgeted attack success, recovery of behaviors that remain unresolved after Stage 1, and transfer of newly evolved skills across target models. The important ablations are whether the gain comes from repeated use of the initial library, from failure analysis, or from the full evolution loop.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Read the introduction for the distinction between prompt-level attacks, memory-based attacks, and dynamic workflows. Then read the method section for the skill representation, the two-stage lifecycle, and how planner, executor, and skill memory interact. In the experiments, focus on ASR under query budgets, unresolved-behavior recovery, cross-model transfer, and examples of newly evolved skills. The most transferable idea is the conversion of failed red-teaming traces into reusable evaluation or training assets.

recommendation.zh: 读 skill 演化闭环和失败分析即可；它更像安全数据生成器，结论别外推到模型鲁棒性。
recommendation.en: Read the skill-evolution loop and failure analysis; treat it as a safety data generator, not proof of model robustness.

paper.title: BabelSteering: Multilingual Safety Alignment via English Steering Vectors
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are deployed globally in high-stakes settings, yet most safety research and alignment efforts remain concentrated on English. Thus, users interacting with LLMs in other languages may encounter weaker safeguards despite relying on the same systems for similarly sensitive tasks. In this work, we investigate whether safety signals learned from a high-resource language, like English, can improve multilingual safety. We propose BabelSteering, an activation steering method

summary.core_problem: LLM安全对齐多集中在英语，其他语言用户使用同一模型时安全防护更弱。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出轻量推理时干预方案，复用英语安全对齐信号跨语言迁移。
summary.technical_approach: 提出BabelSteering：从英语安全监督数据中提取拒绝方向的激活转向向量，推理时施加于多语言场景，无需额外多语言数据。
summary.experiments: 在8种语言上评测，同时衡量有害请求拒绝率、过度拒绝率和通用任务效用，有害拒绝率提升，任务效用下降轻微，伪有害prompt拒绝率略有上升。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM safety alignment is concentrated on English, leaving users of other languages with weaker safeguards on the same model.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation; proposes a lightweight inference-time intervention that transfers English safety alignment signals across languages.
summary_en.technical_approach: BabelSteering extracts refusal-direction activation steering vectors from English safety supervision and applies them at inference across languages, requiring no additional multilingual safety data.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 8 languages, jointly measuring harmful refusal, over-refusal, and general utility; harmful refusal increases with marginal utility loss but slightly elevated pseudo-harmful refusal.

recommendation.zh: 激活转向跨语言迁移的思路可做内部小实验验证，重点看过拒绝率的trade-off分析，无范式突破。
recommendation.en: The cross-lingual activation steering idea is worth a small internal ablation; focus on the over-refusal trade-off analysis, no paradigm shift.

paper.title: The Hallucination Snowball: Modeling Error Propagation as State Transitions in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines
paper.abstract: Sequential multi-agent LLM pipelines chain specialized agents without verification at handoffs, creating a structural flaw with measurable and severe consequences. We show that hallucinations injected at Stage 1 do not merely persist; they transform: raw numerical facts become derived computations, then narrative prose, then editorially approved conclusions. At each transformation, detectability degrades near-irreversibly. We formalize this as the hallucination snowball effect, a first-order Mar

summary.core_problem: 顺序多智能体LLM流水线在阶段交接处缺乏验证机制，早期注入的幻觉会随流水线逐步转化形态，检测难度不可逆地升高，传统的端到端幻觉检测方法无法应对这种结构性的错误传播问题。
summary.importance: 该工作证明幻觉问题不只是单模型生成质量问题，在多阶段、多智能体生成场景下，错误传播存在可量化的结构性规律。它提供了一套错误传播的定量分析框架，对设计多阶段后训练流水线、多模态生成系统、甚至预训练阶段的跨步骤错误感知能力都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将幻觉传播形式化为四状态一阶马尔可夫过程（原始事实→衍生计算→叙事化→不可检测）。基于LangGraph搭建4智能体金融分析流水线（研究员→分析师→作者→审核员），在第一阶段后自动注入数值幻觉，测量每个状态边界的幻觉逃逸概率。对比端到端验证与边界门控两种缓解方案的效果差异。
summary.experiments: 使用gpt-4o-mini搭建4智能体流水线，在FinanceBench的140个金融问题上注入346个数值幻觉。gpt-4o的幻觉检测率从第1阶段的72.0%降至第4阶段的50.9%，下降21.1个百分点。端到端验证仅比无验证降低2.3个百分点的幻觉存活率（从60.7%到58.4%）。边界门控可将幻觉存活率降至16.2%，比端到端检测提升42.2个百分点，代价是内部一致性评分从4.44降至3.93。实测三个状态边界的逃逸概率分别为24.6%、48.3%、89.3%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3节实验设计与检测率衰减结果、第4节马尔可夫过程建模部分，尤其关注Figure 1的状态转移图和Table 1的跨阶段检测率数据，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。做多智能体系统设计的读者可重点关注边界门控的消融实验。

summary_en.core_problem: Sequential multi-agent LLM pipelines lack verification at inter-stage handoffs, so hallucinations introduced early get transformed across stages and become progressively harder to detect. Conventional end-to-end hallucination detection methods fail to address this structural error propagation problem.
summary_en.importance: This work demonstrates that hallucination is not purely a single-model generation quality issue — in multi-stage or multi-agent settings, error propagation follows predictable quantitative dynamics. It provides a formal framework for analyzing error propagation in complex generation pipelines, which is relevant for designing multi-stage post-training workflows, multi-modal generation systems, and pre-training objectives that improve error awareness across chained generation steps.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hallucination propagation is formalized as a first-order Markov process over four states: Raw Fact → Derived Computation → Narrative → Invisible. A 4-agent financial analysis pipeline (Researcher → Analyst → Writer → Reviewer) is built in LangGraph. Numeric hallucinations are automatically injected after the first stage, and per-boundary escape probabilities are measured. End-of-pipeline verification and boundary gating are compared as mitigation strategies.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use a 4-agent gpt-4o-mini pipeline on 140 FinanceBench questions with 346 injected numeric hallucinations. gpt-4o detection accuracy drops 21.1 percentage points from Stage 1 (72.0%) to Stage 4 (50.9%). End-of-pipeline verification only reduces hallucination survival rate by 2.3 pp (from 60.7% to 58.4%). Boundary gating reduces survival to 16.2%, a 42.2 pp improvement over end-checking, at the cost of internal consistency score dropping from 4.44 to 3.93. Measured escape probabilities across the three state boundaries are 24.6%, 48.3%, and 89.3% respectively.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, focus on Section 3 (experimental setup and detection decay results) and Section 4 (Markov process formalization), especially Figure 1 (state transition diagram) and Table 1 (detection rate across stages). Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes. Readers working on multi-agent system design should pay extra attention to the boundary gating ablation.

recommendation.zh: 幻觉传播的量化建模很扎实，做预训练幻觉抑制或多Agent验证设计的研究员，重点看§3的状态转移概率测量部分。
recommendation.en: The quantitative modeling of hallucination propagation is solid; researchers working on pretraining hallucination mitigation or multi-agent verification should focus on §3's state transition probability measurements.

paper.title: ProbGuard: Calibrated Safety Risk Estimation from LLM Output Distributions
paper.abstract: Recent research on Large Language Model (LLM) safety has widely adopted guardrails to identify unsafe LLM outputs. Existing guardrails typically formulate safety assessment as a deterministic classification task, mapping a discrete token sequence to a discrete safety label. However, this paradigm has two limitations: First, safety assessment is inherently an uncertain problem, particularly during the early generation state. Second, relying solely on discrete token sequences discards the rich pro

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 LLM guardrail 把安全判断当成离散分类、忽略生成分布不确定性的问题，尤其面向生成早期的风险估计与提前终止。
summary.importance: 这是一篇安全后训练/推理时风险控制工作。价值不在于提升基座能力，而在于把 safety assessment 从 token 序列分类改成基于输出分布的概率估计与校准，对“如何利用模型分布信号”有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: ProbGuard 是架构无关的概率式 guardrail。输入不是最终离散输出，而是 LLM 在生成前缀阶段的输出分布；目标是估计后续 continuation 为 unsafe 的概率，并进行校准。核心思想是把安全风险视为 continuation-level unsafe probability，从而支持 early stopping，而不是等完整输出后再做二分类。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和数值提升，但强调其能利用 early output distributional signals 进行 calibrated safety probability estimation，并支持 unsafe ongoing outputs 的提前拦截。实验大概率与现有 deterministic guardrail 做比较。与预训练无直接实验接口。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the limitation of current LLM guardrails that treat safety as deterministic sequence classification and ignore uncertainty in the model’s output distribution, especially during early generation.
summary_en.importance: This is a safety/post-training paper rather than a foundation-model paper. Its main value is the shift from discrete safety labels to calibrated probabilistic risk estimation from model distributions, which is mildly relevant if you care about training signals and uncertainty.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProbGuard is an architecture-agnostic probabilistic guardrail. Instead of consuming only the final discrete output, it uses the LLM’s prefix-time output distribution to estimate the probability that the continuation will be unsafe, and calibrates that probability for early stopping.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list model sizes, datasets, or exact gains, but the evaluation likely compares against deterministic guardrails and shows better calibrated early risk estimation for stopping unsafe generations. There is no direct pretraining experiment.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“直接吃输出分布而非离散文本做风险估计”这个角度值得记；只看方法定义和校准结果，别投入太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the move from discrete outputs to distribution-level risk estimation is the only part worth keeping; read the method and calibration tables only.

This convenience is known to carry a safety cost, but almost all of that evidence rests on static refusal tests: fixed harmful prompts scored for compliance. We argue this is misleading. Because safety alignment is "shallow," concentrated in the first few

summary.core_problem: 现有技能合并LLM的安全评估仅依赖静态拒绝测试，无法反映真实自适应攻击下的鲁棒性，静态安全指标具有误导性。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献+分析贡献，首次提出针对技能合并LLM的自适应越狱鲁棒性评测基准SkillSafe-Bench，系统揭示静态安全与真实攻击鲁棒性的显著脱节。
summary.technical_approach: 构建SkillSafe-Bench，采用保守的双裁判AND规则，从静态拒绝率、自适应越狱鲁棒性、能力保留三个维度评测技能合并模型；使用语义模板攻击等自适应攻击方法测试鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 覆盖6个开源基座（5个模型族，2种规模），发现脆弱基座上静态表现安全的合并模型在语义模板攻击下越狱成功率大幅上升，静态安全无法预测自适应攻击鲁棒性。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing safety evaluations of skill-merged LLMs rely solely on static refusal tests, which fail to reflect robustness under real adaptive attacks, making static safety metrics misleading.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark and analytical contribution: first proposes SkillSafe-Bench for evaluating adaptive jailbreak robustness of skill-merged LLMs, and systematically reveals the significant disconnect between static safety and real attack robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds SkillSafe-Bench with a conservative two-judge AND rule, evaluating skill-merged models on three dimensions: static refusal rate, adaptive jailbreak robustness, and capability retention; uses adaptive attacks like semantic template attacks to test robustness.
summary_en.experiments: Covers 6 open-weight bases (5 families, 2 scales); finds that merges appearing safe on fragile bases have much higher jailbreak rates under semantic template attacks, and static safety does not predict adaptive attack robustness.

recommendation.zh: 静态安全测试完全无法预测技能合并模型的自适应越狱鲁棒性，做模型合并与对齐的研究员重点看§3基准设计和§4脱节分析。
recommendation.en: Static safety tests fail to predict adaptive jailbreak robustness in skill-merged LLMs; researchers in model merging and alignment should focus on §3 benchmark design and §4 disconnect analysis.

paper.title: Safety Cost of Steering Vectors Is Separable and Reducible
paper.abstract: Steering vectors are a lightweight tool for controlling LLM behavior. However, emerging evidence shows that steering vectors can unintentionally compromise a model's safety mechanisms and increase compliance with harmful requests, while no effective mitigation yet exists. In this work, we show that this safety degradation arises from a separable component in the vector that disrupts the model's safety mechanisms but contributes little to the steering objective. We identify and remove this safety

summary.core_problem: 如何在不重训模型的前提下，消除 steering vector（激活加法控制行为）带来的安全退化：既要保留原本的 steering 效果，又要把 jailbreak 成功率/有害请求服从度拉回基线，同时还要控制 benign 场景的误拒绝（false refusal）不显著上升。
summary.importance: 属于 post-train/对齐与机制交叉的工作，对“预训练”直接影响不大，但对理解与利用对齐后模型的表示几何有启发：它把安全退化解释为 steering vector 中一个可分离的分量，并用约束优化把该分量“外科手术式”投影掉。对做 RLHF/RLAIF 后模型的可控性、以及把安全机制视作低维子空间来分析，有现实价值；也提示了一个风险面：很多看似无关的行为方向会与拒答/安全子空间发生重叠。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名 CAST（Constrained Ablation for Safe Steering）。核心设定：在某层残差流对每个 token 注入向量 v（activation addition），v 通常由对比提示对的平均激活差得到。安全退化来自 v 与“安全/拒答机制子空间”的重叠，但该子空间不等于某个已知 refusal direction，且可能是多方向的。
实现上把“净化后的向量”写成从 v 中投影掉一个学习到的子空间 S：v* = v - P_S(v)。主实验用 rank-1 近似：学习一个单位向量 r̂，使 v* = v - r̂ r̂^T v。
学习目标是三方约束：
- 有害分布 D_harm 上，使用 v* 的模型拒答率至少回到未 steer 的基线（恢复安全）。
- 效果分布 D_effect 上，v* 的输出分布要接近原 v 的输出分布（保留 steering 效果）。
- 良性分布 D_benign 上，v* 不应显著提高误拒绝（控制副作用）。
把它写成拉格朗日约束优化，用 primal-dual 更新求解 r̂ 与乘子。论文强调得到的 r̂ 具有可解释性，并且“安全退化分量”和“行为有效分量”在几何上可分离。
summary.experiments: 在三种模型、三类行为域、七种 jailbreak 攻击场景上评估，结论是 CAST 能在基本保留 steering 效果的同时，把安全性恢复到接近未 steer 的水平，并且对 benign 误拒绝的影响较小。给定全文片段未包含具体模型名称、层位选择、攻击成功率/拒答率的绝对数值与提升幅度，也未看到 rank-1 与更高 rank 的对比、以及不同 α 强度下的稳定性曲线；这些细节决定它是否能成为可复用的工程配方。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看 Problem Statement：三个分布（harm/effect/benign）与三类约束的定义，这是方法成立的前提。
- 精读优化形式：拉格朗日怎么写、primal-dual 如何更新、约束是用拒答率/分布距离/还是某种 surrogate loss 实现。这里决定了可复现性与数值稳定性。
- 关注“rank-1 足够”的经验依据：为什么一个方向能隔离大部分安全退化，失败案例是什么。
- 看与“直接 ablate 已知 refusal direction”的对比实验：它具体在哪些攻击/行为上失败，CAST 如何补上。
预计阅读时间：25–40 分钟可理解方法；若要落地到内部 steering 工具链，需要补齐实现细节与超参。

summary_en.core_problem: Mitigate the safety degradation caused by activation steering vectors without retraining: preserve the intended steering behavior while restoring refusal/safety on harmful prompts back to baseline, and avoid increasing false refusals on benign prompts.
summary_en.importance: More post-training/mechanistic than pretraining, but practically relevant for controllability of aligned models. The key contribution is framing safety loss from steering as a separable geometric component inside the steering vector, and removing it via constrained optimization rather than heuristics like subtracting a single known refusal direction. It also reinforces a broader lesson: many seemingly benign behavior directions can overlap with the refusal/safety subspace introduced by SFT/RLHF.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CAST (Constrained Ablation for Safe Steering). Setup: a steering vector v is injected into the residual stream at a chosen layer during inference (activation addition), typically built as a mean activation difference from contrastive prompt pairs.
CAST parameterizes a sanitized vector by projecting v away from a learned safety-degrading subspace S: v* = v - P_S(v). Since the true dimensionality is unknown, the main experiments use a rank-1 approximation with a learned unit direction r̂: v* = v - r̂ r̂^T v.
Learning r̂ is posed as a Lagrangian constrained optimization with primal-dual updates, balancing three requirements:
- Safety restoration: on a harmful prompt distribution D_harm (multiple jailbreak styles), the steered model with v* should refuse at least as often as the unsteered baseline.
- Effect preservation: on D_effect, outputs under v* should remain close to outputs under the original v.
- False-refusal control: on D_benign, v* should not significantly increase over-refusals relative to baseline.
The paper argues the safety-degrading component is largely separable from the effect-relevant component, enabling “surgical” ablation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across three models, three behavioral domains, and seven jailbreak attack scenarios. CAST reportedly restores safety close to the unsteered baseline while largely preserving the steering effect and keeping benign over-refusal minimal. The provided excerpt does not include concrete model identifiers, absolute refusal/ASR numbers, ablations on rank-1 vs higher-rank subspaces, or robustness vs steering strength α—those details are important for assessing reproducibility and deployment readiness.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Read the formal problem statement: definitions of D_harm / D_effect / D_benign and the exact constraints.
- Focus on the optimization details: the Lagrangian, what surrogate losses are used for refusal/effect distance, and how primal-dual updates are stabilized.
- Check the empirical justification for rank-1: when it works, when it fails, and whether higher-rank helps.
- Inspect comparisons to the common baseline “subtract a known refusal direction”: which cases it misses and how CAST recovers.
Time budget: ~25–40 minutes to understand the method; longer if you need to implement it in a steering pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 值得看优化设定和方向可分性证据；若结果稳，说明 steering 安全损失不必视为不可避免。
recommendation.en: Read the optimization setup and separability evidence; if robust, it says the safety cost of steering is not an unavoidable trade-off.

paper.title: Measuring the Wrong Thing: Internal Harmfulness Scores Anti-Rank Successful Jailbreaks
paper.abstract: Internal safety scores judge a prompt before any text is generated, and they are validated by how well they separate harmful prompts from benign ones. That separation is then read as evidence that the score will also catch the attacks that succeed. Harmful intent is a property of the prompt. Jailbreak success is an outcome produced later by a particular target model, decoding policy, and judge. A filter tuned on a score that measures the wrong quantity spends its false positive budget on attacks

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何做更强的越狱检测”，而是一个更基础的测量问题：很多内部安全分数是在生成前、只看 prompt 的条件下打分，并用“能区分 harmful vs benign prompt”来证明有效；但部署时，人们往往把这个分数当成“能拦住成功越狱”的证据。论文指出这两者不是同一个随机变量。前者是 prompt 的有害意图 H(x)，后者是目标模型、解码策略和 judge 共同决定的实现结果 Ym(x)。如果一个分数只对 H 有构念效度，却被拿去做 Ym 的阈值决策，就可能把拦截预算浪费在本来就不会成功的攻击上，反而放过真正会成功的包装式越狱。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对“如何解释内部表征、如何验证 probe、如何把内部信号转成部署决策”有很强的方法论价值。它提醒人们：内部 probe 的训练标签和部署目标必须一致，不能把 representation-level harmfulness 当作 outcome-level jailbreak success 的替代。这个问题和预训练研究里常见的 probe 误读、OOD 失效、代理指标错配是同一类。尤其对做 activation probe、safety head、representation auditing、甚至训练中间信号监控的人，这篇文章给了一个很清楚的反例：construct validity 不会自动推出 outcome validity，更不会自动推出 decision validity。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有两个层次。第一层是估计对象的拆分。作者显式区分 harmful intent H、是否带 wrapper 的 W、以及目标模型在固定 judge 下是否真的输出有害内容的 Ym，并分别讨论 ranking、calibration、threshold transfer 三种效度，而不是只报一个 AUROC 就结束。这个拆分很重要，因为很多安全检测工作把这些量混在一起。

第二层是测量设计。作者认为现有 attention-based detector 常从 prompt-dependent 的位置读取信号，wrapper 一旦改变模板结构，既改变了被测内容，也改变了读数坐标，导致分数变化无法归因。为此他们提出 Active Attention Probing, AAP：在 system region 插入一个短 probe embedding，形成固定、与 prompt 内容无关的参考坐标，再读取该 probe 位置上的 attention response，拼接多层多头特征后用 XGBoost 映射到 [0,1] 分数。核心不是“probe token 本身更强”，而是把比较基准固定住，使 plain prompt 和 wrapped prompt 的差异更可解释。

具体实现上，主设定使用 K=3 的 probe rows，只在 BeaverTails 训练集上训练并冻结；后续所有审计都不再用 JailbreakHub、WildJailbreak、JailbreakBench 去挑 probe、挑 head 或调 harmfulness readout，尽量避免在攻击集上做选择偏差。除了 AAP 主通道，作者还做了多种替代读出：rare token、common token、norm-matched、system span、passive attention、refusal logit channel，用来检验结论是否依赖某一种坐标或特征家族。论文还设置了一个 outcome-supervised positive control，证明如果直接用 success label 训练，模型是能学到与结果更相关的信号的；因此问题不在于“内部表征完全没信息”，而在于“harmfulness-trained score 被过度解释”。
summary.experiments:
最关键的结果有三组。

第一组是 harmfulness 与 realized success 的分离。在 Llama 目标模型上，给有害请求加 wrapper 后，harmful generation rate 从 0.05 提高到 0.27，说明包装确实让更多攻击成功；但同一批样本上的 harmful intent AUROC 却从 0.936 降到 0.803。更强的一点是，在 wrapped harmful prompts 内部，这个分数把成功攻击排在失败攻击后面，outcome AUROC 只有 0.220，已经不是“弱相关”，而是明显反向排序。

第二组是稳健性审计。作者声称这种 anti-ranking 现象并不依赖单一测量通道，而是在不同 channel、不同 target、不同 attack family、不同独立 judge 下都能看到。也就是说，这不是某个 probe token 或某个 head 的偶然坏例子，而是标签错配带来的系统性问题。

第三组是部署含义。论文不只看 AUROC，还看在固定 benign false positive budget 下，阈值如何分配拦截容量。结论是：如果阈值是按 harmfulness score 调的，它会优先拦下那些“看起来更有害、但其实不会成功”的攻击，而把真正会成功的 wrapped jailbreak 留在阈值下方。作者还区分了 ranking loss、probability miscalibration、threshold transfer failure，说明即便一个分数在原分布上校准得还可以，到了 wrapper shift 后也可能同时在排序和阈值迁移上失效。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓住问题定义，再看方法细节。先读 Introduction 和 Measurement Setting，重点看 H(x)、W(x)、Ym(x) 的定义，以及 construct validity / outcome validity / decision validity 的区分。这部分决定了整篇文章在批评什么。

然后看 Audit Design，重点理解为什么 passive attention readout 会被 wrapper 改变坐标，以及 AAP 如何通过 system region 的固定 probe 解决这个混淆。这里不需要把所有公式都推一遍，但要看清楚 probe 插入位置、读出的 attention response 是什么、XGBoost 只是 readout 而不是主要创新。

实验部分建议优先看 Figure 1 和所有 plain-vs-wrapped、harmfulness-vs-outcome 的主结果表。阅读时不要只盯 AUROC，要同时看 calibration 和 threshold transfer，因为作者真正关心的是部署决策。若时间有限，30-40 分钟足够抓住主线；若做 safety probing 或内部表征研究，建议再看 appendix 里的 channel ablation、head selection、positive control 细节，那里能看出作者如何避免在攻击集上过拟合结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a measurement mismatch rather than a new jailbreak defense. Many internal safety scores are computed before generation from the prompt alone, and are validated by separating harmful from benign prompts. In deployment, however, these scores are often treated as evidence that a prompt will successfully jailbreak a target model. The paper argues that these are different estimands: harmful intent H(x) is a property of the prompt, while realized jailbreak success Ym(x) depends on the target model, decoding policy, and judge. A score that is valid for H can still be invalid, or even anti-correlated, for Ym.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is highly relevant to representation probing, internal-signal interpretation, and deployment-facing validation. The main contribution is methodological clarity: construct validity for a probe target does not imply outcome validity for a downstream event, and neither implies decision validity under thresholding. That lesson transfers directly to pretraining research whenever internal activations, probes, or surrogate metrics are used as evidence for a stronger claim than the label actually supports. It is especially useful for work on safety probes, mechanistic auditing, and training-time monitoring signals.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two main technical moves. First, it cleanly separates the quantities being measured. It defines harmful intent H, wrapper presence W, and realized harmful output Ym under a fixed judge, then evaluates ranking, calibration, and threshold transfer separately. This matters because many prior discussions collapse these notions into a single “harmfulness score”.

Second, it introduces Active Attention Probing (AAP) to remove a confound in attention-based detectors. Passive detectors often read from prompt-dependent locations. A jailbreak wrapper changes not only the content but also the coordinate from which the signal is extracted, making score changes hard to interpret. AAP inserts a short learned probe embedding into the system region after chat templating, creating a fixed, content-independent reference point. The model’s attention response at that probe is collected across selected heads and layers, concatenated into a feature vector, and mapped to a scalar score with XGBoost.

The key idea is not that the probe token is intrinsically better, but that it stabilizes the readout coordinate so plain and wrapped prompts can be compared at a common location. The primary probe uses K=3 rows, is trained only on the BeaverTails training split, and then frozen for all audits. The authors explicitly avoid selecting probes, heads, or readouts on jailbreak benchmarks such as JailbreakHub, WildJailbreak, or JailbreakBench. They also test multiple alternative channels—rare token, common token, norm-matched token, system-span, passive attention, and refusal-logit channels—to show that the main conclusion is not an artifact of one specific readout family. An outcome-supervised positive control further shows that the model does contain predictive signal for success labels; the failure comes from label mismatch, not from a total absence of useful internal information.
summary_en.experiments:
The central empirical result is the divergence between harmfulness and realized success. On Llama targets, adding a wrapper increases the harmful generation rate from 0.05 to 0.27, so the wrapper makes attacks more successful. At the same time, harmful-intent AUROC drops from 0.936 to 0.803. More strikingly, within wrapped harmful prompts, the score ranks successful attacks below failed ones, yielding an outcome AUROC of 0.220. This is not merely weak prediction; it is active anti-ranking.

The paper also reports that this pattern persists across measurement channels, target models, attack families, and independent judges. That makes the result harder to dismiss as a probe-specific artifact. The deployment analysis is also important: under a fixed benign false-positive budget, a threshold tuned on harmfulness spends blocking capacity on attacks that would have failed anyway, while letting more successful wrapped attacks pass. The authors further separate ranking failure, probability miscalibration, and threshold-transfer failure, showing that a score can remain superficially useful on its original validation task while failing under wrapper-induced distribution shift.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the problem formulation. Read the Introduction and Measurement Setting carefully, especially the distinction among H(x), W(x), and Ym(x), and the three notions of validity: construct, outcome, and decision validity. That framing is the real contribution.

Then read the Audit Design section to understand why passive attention readouts are confounded by wrapper-induced coordinate shifts, and how AAP fixes the readout location in the system region. You do not need every implementation detail on a first pass, but it is worth understanding that XGBoost is only the final readout layer; the methodological novelty is the controlled measurement setup.

In the experiments, focus on the plain-vs-wrapped comparisons and the harmfulness-vs-outcome tables and figures. Do not stop at AUROC. The calibration and threshold-transfer analyses are where the deployment implications become concrete. A 30-40 minute skim is enough to capture the main argument. If your work involves safety probes or internal representation auditing, the appendix is worth extra time for channel ablations, head-selection details, and the outcome-supervised positive control.

recommendation.zh: 对内部安全评分机制的干净反证，做对齐或安全后训练的人读§3的测量方法与Fig 2即可，结论可直接用于内部安全管线审计。
recommendation.en: A clean counterevidence to internal safety scoring mechanisms; for alignment or safety post-training researchers, read §3 methodology and Fig 2, the findings are directly usable for auditing internal safety pipelines.

paper.title: Do All LLMs Know When They're Being Harmful? A Reproducibility Study of Latent-Space Safety Probes Across Model Families
paper.abstract: Khatri et al. (2026) [DOI: 10.1109/DSN-W70714.2026.00027] show that lightweight MLP probes on final-layer activations of a single 8B model (LLaMA-3.1-8B) detect harmful prompts at F1 competitive with guard models 1000x larger, using one probe per benchmark. We reproduce this pipeline end-to-end and extend it along two axes the original study leaves open. First, we test whether the result generalizes across other model architecture and scale by training identical probes on activations from models

summary.core_problem: Khatri et al. (2026) 报告在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 最后一层激活上训练轻量 MLP 探针即可检测有害 prompt，F1 可比千倍大的 guard 模型；本文复现并检验其跨模型/架构的泛化性与推理非确定性。
summary.importance: 可复现性 + 跨家族泛化研究，对"安全概念是否线性编码在隐藏表示中"这一机制问题提供经验证据；属于 interpretability/safety 交叉。
summary.technical_approach: 端到端复现 MLP 探针 pipeline，在 Gemma-4-E4B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Qwen2-7B 上以相同设置训练探针，使用 WildJailbreak/BeaverTails/AEGIS 2.0 三个 benchmark，并用 5 个随机种子测量 F1 方差。
summary.experiments: 在原 LLaMA 模型上 F1 复现偏差 ≤0.37 个百分点（BeaverTails 上 ≤0.2）；跨模型/架构的泛化结果与种子方差在摘要中未完整给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Khatri et al. (2026) reported that lightweight MLP probes on LLaMA-3.1-8B final-layer activations detect harmful prompts at F1 competitive with guard models 1000x larger; this paper reproduces and tests cross-family generalization and inference non-determinism.
summary_en.importance: A reproducibility and cross-family generalization study that bears on whether safety concepts are linearly encoded in hidden representations; sits at the interpretability/safety intersection.
summary_en.technical_approach: End-to-end reproduction of the MLP probe pipeline, trained identically on activations from Gemma-4-E4B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Qwen2-7B across WildJailbreak, BeaverTails, and AEGIS 2.0, with five random seeds to quantify F1 variance.
summary_en.experiments: Reproduces original LLaMA F1 within 0.37 points (within 0.2 on BeaverTails); cross-model generalization and seed-variance results not fully stated in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 复现扎实，跨家族泛化结论是判断"安全探针是否真在读取表征"的关键；只看跨模型表格和种子方差即可，不必细读方法。
recommendation.en: Solid reproduction; the cross-family generalization table is what decides whether safety probes actually read representations—skip the method, read those tables and the seed-variance numbers.

paper.title: WorldMark: A Plug-and-Play World Knowledge Interface for Cross-Host Language Model Watermarking
paper.abstract: Watermarking traces the provenance of text produced by large language models by embedding statistically detectable signals during decoding. Existing schemes fall into logits-based, sampling-based, entropy-aware, and adaptive-strength families, yet all of them place watermark signals according to local token statistics. In the open-ended text-generation settings evaluated in this work, local statistics may provide insufficient guidance for placing robust watermark signals. We introduce WorldMark,

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM水印方案均基于局部token统计放置水印信号，在开放文本生成中鲁棒性不足
summary.importance: 提出利用世界知识指导水印信号放置的即插即用接口，无需骨干重训练或检测器侧额外模型
summary.technical_approach: WorldMark用世界知识记忆(WKM)以记忆图组织语义和情景知识，将检索到的知识转换为token级知识显著性分数，通过非对称知识调制(AKM)调整宿主水印强度
summary.experiments: 在C4主评估上，完整WorldMark接口提升了干净和攻击场景下的检测性能

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM watermarking schemes place watermark signals based on local token statistics, which lack robustness in open-ended text generation
summary_en.importance: Proposes a plug-and-play interface that uses world knowledge to guide watermark signal placement, requiring no backbone retraining or detector-side model
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldMark organizes semantic and episodic knowledge in a memory graph (WKM), converts retrieved knowledge into token-level knowledge saliency scores, and adjusts host watermark strength via Asymmetric Knowledge Modulation (AKM)
summary_en.experiments: On the primary C4 evaluation, the complete WorldMark interface improves clean and attacked detection

recommendation.zh: 水印思路引入世界知识调制信号强度有新意，但属解码侧安全技术，与预训练方法论关系弱。
recommendation.en: Novel idea of modulating watermark strength with world knowledge, but it is decoding-side safety, weakly linked to pretraining.

paper.title: Gradient Immunity: Null-Space Resistance to Malicious Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Released aligned large language models remain vulnerable to malicious downstream finetuning. Existing defenses are largely designed for the fine-tuning-as-a-service (FTaaS) paradigm or rely on downstream users to follow additional safety procedures, and therefore do not directly address the setting we study: a provider controlled partially protected open-weight (PPOW) release setting in which most weights remain trainable while a small safety-critical component is preserved at release. We propos

summary.core_problem: 解决已对齐的开源LLM在部分权重可训练的发布场景下，易被恶意微调破坏安全对齐的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出仅保护极小安全关键组件的防御方案，无需冻结大量参数或依赖下游用户遵守安全流程
summary.technical_approach: 提出单向安全门（USG），由Transformer最后一层后的零空间三次层与逆适配器组成；微调时三次层抑制落入校准保护区域的有害样本的梯度，逆适配器恢复基础模型的前向行为；用防御方持有的有害数据校准阈值，实现泛化保护
summary.experiments: 摘要未明确给出模型规模与具体数据集，仅说明可在保留基础模型性能的同时有效防御多种恶意微调攻击

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses vulnerability of aligned open-weight LLMs to safety alignment destruction via malicious fine-tuning under the partially protected open-weight release setting
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes a defense scheme that only protects a tiny safety-critical component, without freezing large numbers of parameters or requiring downstream users to follow additional safety procedures
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Unidirectional Safety Gate (USG), consisting of a Null Space Cubic Layer and an Inverse Adapter inserted after the final Transformer layer; during fine-tuning, the cubic layer suppresses gradients from harmful samples in the calibrated protected region, while the Inverse Adapter restores base model forward behavior; threshold calibrated with defender-held harmful data enables generalized protection
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not specify model parameter scale or datasets, only claims effective defense against multiple malicious fine-tuning attacks while preserving base model performance

recommendation.zh: 零空间防御恶意微调的新思路，仅看§3的USG结构设计即可，无需深究实验细节
recommendation.en: Novel null-space defense against malicious fine-tuning; only §3 on USG architecture design is worth reviewing, no need to dive into experimental details

paper.title: Trajectory-Guided Forget-Recover Network for Continual LLM Unlearning
paper.abstract: Machine unlearning aims to eliminate the influence of sensitive data on a model. In the real world, unlearning requests arrive continually, which gives rise to two challenges. First, an unlearning intervention may redistribute target-related computation across remaining pathways, allowing previously forgotten knowledge to re-emerge. Second, repeated unlearning interventions may progressively reduce the model capacity needed to preserve retained utility. To address these challenges, we propose th

summary.core_problem: 解决持续LLM遗忘场景下，遗忘操作导致已消去知识复现、多次遗忘逐步损害模型保留效用的问题
summary.importance: 提出持续LLM遗忘的新方法，属于方法创新，通过通道级轨迹追踪平衡遗忘效果与模型能力保留
summary.technical_approach: 提出TFR-Net，追踪跨请求的通道级风险，分离持续目标相关通道与瞬态热点，仅抑制持续通道；同时再激活对保留效用贡献高、遗忘风险低的休眠通道恢复容量，仅当效用退化在容忍范围内时接受恢复
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验设置、模型规模与效果对比数据

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses two key challenges in continual LLM unlearning: re-emergence of previously forgotten knowledge after interventions, and progressive degradation of retained utility across repeated unlearning requests
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel continual unlearning method, contributing a channel-level trajectory tracking framework to balance unlearning efficacy and model capability preservation
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces TFR-Net, which tracks channel-level risk across unlearning requests, separates persistent target-related channels from transient hotspots to suppress only persistent ones, and reactivates dormant channels with high retained utility contribution and low forget risk to recover capacity, with recovery accepted only if utility degradation stays within predefined tolerance
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental setup, model scale, or performance comparison data is provided in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 持续unlearning的通道级方法，对预训练数据隐私防护的后处理方案有参考，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Channel-level continual unlearning approach, useful as reference for post-hoc privacy protection of pretrained models; abstract suffices

paper.title: Safeguards Based on Copyable Context Cannot Provide Reliable Safety for LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language model safeguards decide whether to answer before seeing how an answer will be used. This creates a basic problem for dual-use tasks: the same answer can help an authorized professional or an attacker, while an attacker can imitate a benign request and interaction history. We separate the capability released by the model from the evidence available about downstream use. When that evidence is copyable, we derive the exact worst-case floor on attacker assistance while preserving usef

summary.core_problem: 论文讨论的是：当安全策略只能依赖用户请求、声明意图、交互历史这类可复制上下文时，LLM 在双用途任务上是否可能同时保持有用性和可靠安全性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练算法，而在安全边界建模。它把“模型释放了什么能力”和“系统掌握了什么使用证据”分开分析，给出了一个有用的思考框架：很多安全失败不是分类器不够强，而是下游真实用途在回答释放前不可观测，且攻击者可以复制合法用户的可见证据。这个结论会影响开放模型、API 访问控制、能力分级释放、工具调用权限和后训练安全数据设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是一个有限空间上的决策理论建模。论文固定一个公开任务上下文 W=w，其中包含请求里的任务、身份、角色和声称用途，但把这些声称用途视为不可证明的上下文。系统可选择的终端输出构成 release menu A，包括拒答。每个输出在合法世界 B 下有合法效用 u_B，在恶意世界 M 下有恶意效用 v_M；恶意用户可以在看到输出后选择最有利的误用方式，因此恶意效用取允许恶意用途中的最大值。安全策略被建模为 Markov kernel：它可以基于多轮访问验证 transcript H 随机选择输出 g(a|h)。关键假设是攻击者可以复制合法用户在释放前可见的证据，包括请求、声明、交互答案和历史。论文用 total variation distance 衡量复制误差或 credential separation，并推导在给定合法效用目标 q 下，不可避免的攻击者帮助下界 Γ(q)。核心区别在于，它不是讨论某个 jailbreak 或过滤器是否有效，而是证明只要证据可复制，就存在一个由 release menu 和双用途效用决定的攻击辅助地板；多轮追问、随机化、跨轮聚合证据都不能绕开这个地板。
summary.experiments: 这是一篇以形式化分析为主的论文，没有呈现大规模模型训练或 benchmark 数字。关键结果是理论性的：在固定任务上下文和 release menu 下，合法效用约束 U_B≥q 会诱导一个 capability floor Γ(q)，表示为了保留合法用途，系统至少会向恶意用途释放多少可用能力。论文还讨论近似复制场景，用 total variation inequality 给出可复制证据误差下的近似结论。进一步的结论是安全三难：Useful Capability、Reliable Safety、Open Access 三者不能同时满足。要降低攻击者帮助，需要引入难以复制且与真实下游使用相关的证据，例如可信凭证；单纯改进 prompt intent classifier 或交互式问答不足以提供可靠安全。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和 Main Result，约 20 到 30 分钟。重点看三个建模选择：第一，为什么把公开上下文 W 与实际下游用途分开；第二，release menu A、合法效用 u_B、恶意效用 v_M 如何定义 capability；第三，为什么 transcript H 即使来自多轮验证，仍然可能是可复制证据。若做模型安全或开放能力分级，建议进一步读 capability floor Γ(q) 的定义和 total variation 近似部分。真正可迁移的点不是公式本身，而是把安全策略失败归因到“证据结构不足”，而不是单个安全分类器误判。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM safeguards can provide reliable safety for dual-use tasks when they only observe copyable context such as requests, stated intent, and interaction history.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance is not a new training recipe, but a clean boundary for LLM safety mechanisms. The paper separates the capability released by the model from the evidence available about downstream use. This distinction is useful for thinking about open models, API gating, tiered capability release, tool permissions, and safety-oriented post-training data. The key implication is that many failures are not caused by a weak classifier alone; the true downstream use is unobserved before release, and an attacker can mimic the evidence shown by a legitimate user.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis uses a finite decision-theoretic setup. For a fixed public task context W=w, the context includes the task, claimed identity, role, and stated use, but these claims are not treated as evidence of actual downstream use. The deployment has a finite release menu A, including refusal. Each release has a utility under a legitimate-use world B and a misuse utility under a malicious-use world M; because the malicious user can choose how to exploit the answer after observing it, the malicious utility takes the most useful allowed misuse. A safeguard is modeled as a Markov kernel over terminal releases conditioned on a pre-release transcript H. The central assumption is that the attacker can reproduce the same observable evidence as a legitimate user. Total variation distance is used to quantify imperfect copying or credential separation. Under a legitimate utility target q, the paper derives a capability floor Γ(q): the unavoidable amount of attacker assistance induced by preserving useful answers. This differs from jailbreak-specific work because it proves a structural lower bound for any safeguard based only on copyable evidence, including randomized decisions and multi-turn verification.
summary_en.experiments: The paper is primarily theoretical and does not report large-scale model training results or benchmark numbers. The main result is a lower bound: once a release menu and legitimate/malicious utilities are fixed, any policy satisfying a legitimate utility constraint U_B≥q must leave at least Γ(q) assistance available to malicious use when the evidence is copyable. Approximate versions use total variation inequalities to handle imperfect copying or partial separation. The paper then states a safety trilemma: useful capability, reliable safety, and open access cannot all be maintained under copyable pre-release evidence. Reliable safety requires hard-to-copy evidence tied to actual downstream use, such as trusted credentials, rather than only better intent inference from prompts or conversations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction and Main Result in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on three modeling choices: why the public context W is separated from actual downstream use; how the release menu A and the two utility functions define released capability; and why the transcript H remains copyable even when it comes from multi-turn access checks. For readers working on model safety or capability gating, the most useful parts are the definition of Γ(q) and the total-variation treatment of approximate copying. The transferable idea is the evidence-structure argument: reliable safety may require non-copyable signals about actual use, not only stronger prompt classifiers.

recommendation.zh: 值得看理论设定和最坏情形推导；它会削弱“再加一层上下文分类器就安全”的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the formal setup and worst-case floor; it weakens the prior that another context classifier can make open-access dual-use deployment safe.

paper.title: Forecasting Trajectory-Level Safety Risks in Black-Box Multi-Turn Interactions
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) evolve from standalone assistants into autonomous agents, ensuring their safety requires shifting beyond pointwise risk assessment to understand how risks emerge and unfold over long-horizon trajectories. In multi-turn interactions, malicious intent can be decomposed across seemingly harmless turns and gradually reconstructed through interaction trajectories, eventually resulting in safety failures. Existing safeguards remain largely reactive, detecting manifested

summary.core_problem: 在黑盒多轮交互中提前预测安全风险如何沿对话轨迹累积，而不是等违规内容已经显性出现后再检测。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 LLM safety 方法。它把安全判断从 turn-level violation detection 推到 trajectory-level risk forecasting，对长程 Agent 安全和后训练安全评估有一定参考，但不是预训练核心问题。
summary.technical_approach: Recast 使用双尺度轨迹视图检索风险证据：一侧看短期对话进展，另一侧看长期历史上下文；随后建模组合式风险演化，用于预测潜在恶意意图在多轮中逐步重组后的风险。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出使用的数据集、模型规模、baseline、指标或提升幅度；只能确认任务设置是黑盒多轮交互安全风险预测，而非白盒模型内部监控。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper forecasts how safety risk accumulates over black-box multi-turn interactions, instead of detecting only explicit violations after they appear.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an LLM safety method. It shifts from turn-level violation detection to trajectory-level risk forecasting, which is relevant to long-horizon agent safety and post-training evaluation, but not central to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Recast retrieves risk-relevant evidence from a dual-scale trajectory view: short-term dialogue progression and long-term historical context. It then models compositional risk evolution to predict latent malicious intent as it is gradually assembled across turns.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide dataset details, model sizes, baselines, metrics, or quantitative improvements. The setup is black-box multi-turn safety forecasting rather than white-box internal monitoring.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和实验表即可；trajectory-level safety 是合理方向，但摘要看不出评测是否足够干净。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and results tables; trajectory-level safety is the right framing, but the abstract gives no evidence that the evaluation is clean.

paper.title: RAGuard: A Layered Defense Framework for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems Against Data Poisoning
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems ground large language models (LLMs) in external corpora, but this reliance exposes them to corpus poisoning: maliciously injected passages that manipulate retrieved evidence. We introduce RAGuard, a layered defense against \emph{factual} corpus-poisoning attacks on RAG pipelines. The first layer adversarially fine-tunes a dense retriever on synthetic poisoned documents (fabricated facts, contradictions, and reasoning traps), teaching it to downrank ma

summary.core_problem: RAG系统依赖外部语料，易受事实型语料投毒攻击，恶意段落被检索后操纵模型输出。
summary.importance: 系统创新：提出双层防御框架RAGuard，结合检索端对抗训练与生成端无监督黑盒过滤。
summary.technical_approach: 第一层用合成投毒文档（伪造事实、矛盾、推理陷阱）对抗微调稠密检索器，降低恶意段落排序；第二层ZKIP对每个检索文档做留一解码，通过语义偏移与输出熵变化打分，无需投毒标签、真值答案或模型内部权限。
summary.experiments: 在5%-30%投毒比例的Natural Questions数据集上测试，对比基线RAG管线，两层防御联合显著降低投毒攻击成功率。

summary_en.core_problem: RAG systems are vulnerable to factual corpus poisoning, where maliciously injected passages are retrieved and manipulate LLM outputs.
summary_en.importance: Systems contribution: a layered defense framework RAGuard combining retrieval-side adversarial fine-tuning and generation-side unsupervised black-box filtering.
summary_en.technical_approach: First layer adversarially fine-tunes a dense retriever on synthetic poisoned documents (fabricated facts, contradictions, reasoning traps) to downrank malicious passages; second layer ZKIP performs leave-one-out decoding per document and scores via semantic shift and output entropy change, requiring no poison labels, ground truth, or model internals.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Natural Questions with 5–30% poison ratios; the combined two-layer defense substantially reduces attack success rate against baseline RAG pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 属于RAG安全的应用型防御方案，对预训练研究员无直接方法启发，了解思路即可。
recommendation.en: An applied RAG security defense with no direct methodological insights for pretraining researchers; worth knowing the high-level idea only.

paper.title: Inference-Time Consensus for Mitigating Hidden Behaviors from LLM Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Recent work shows that fine-tuning language models on even a small amount of poisoned data can install targeted misbehavior, and ostensibly benign data can transmit hidden preferences that generalize broadly. Standard defenses, such as data filtering, mixing in harmless data, and regularization, attenuate these effects but do not eliminate them. We instead pursue robustness through redundancy: collecting multiple datasets from different sources and only learning what is common between them. Thus

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是多来源微调数据中的隐蔽投毒问题：当少数数据源带有不可从样本表面识别的偏好、人格或目标行为时，常规过滤、混入安全数据、KL 正则只能削弱这些行为，不能可靠地阻断它们。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口有直接参考价值。它把数据供应链安全从“检测坏样本”转为“利用来源冗余做行为共识”。这个视角适合用于多供应商 SFT、领域继续预训练、数据合成管线和模型合并场景。主要启发不在于提出一个可直接替代常规训练的解码器，而在于指出：如果某个行为只来自单一来源，那么平均式训练目标会保留它的弱信号；要消除它，需要带有否决性质的聚合机制。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先按数据来源分别从同一个 base model 微调得到一组 reference models，而不是把所有数据合并训练一个模型。推理时聚合这些模型的 next-token distributions，只保留多个来源共同支持的 token。论文提出两类 consensus decoder：一种是 token-wise minimum aggregation，用各来源对同一 token 的概率下界作为共识信号；另一种是 base-relative minimum aggregation，先看每个来源相对 base model 对 token 概率的提升，再取最小提升，避免单纯概率低估常见 token 或受 base prior 影响过强。和 KL regularization、union training、LoRA weight merging 的区别在于，这里不是平均不同来源的行为，而是让单一来源无法单独抬高某个行为的生成概率。论文还讨论了 quorum aggregation 和 semantic smoothing，用来放松严格一致性：前者允许只要求达到一定来源数的共识，后者缓解不同来源用不同表面表达传递同一 benefit 的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖显式投毒、subliminal learning、emergent misalignment 等设置，并与 union training、LoRA 权重合并、whole-output consensus sampling 比较。核心结果是 consensus decoder 能保留多来源共享的目标能力，同时显著压制只由单个来源携带的 unwanted behavior。论文还给出一个关键理论观察：对多个 reference models 做 KL 正则时，最优解等价于对这些分布求平均，因此恶意来源的行为会被稀释但不会被否决。这个结论解释了为什么常见正则化防御在隐蔽投毒下只能缓解，难以消除。摘要和引言未提供完整数值表、模型规模和数据规模，精确数字需要查看实验章节。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20–30 分钟。优先看问题设定和 threat model，尤其是 attributable sources 与 support margin 两个假设；再看 Lemma 1，它是论文区分“平均式防御”和“否决式防御”的关键；随后看 consensus aggregation 的定义，重点理解 minimum aggregation 与 base-relative minimum aggregation 的差异。实验部分建议重点看三类攻击设置下与 union training、KL regularization、LoRA merging 的对比，以及 quorum 和 semantic smoothing 的消融。需要保持一个限制意识：方法依赖来源可追踪，并假设目标 benefit 比任一 cost 得到更多来源支持；如果攻击者串通或供应链高度同质，这个假设会变弱。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies hidden behavior injection in multi-source fine-tuning. A small number of malicious or biased sources can transmit targeted behaviors that are not detectable from the surface form of the data, while standard filtering, benign-data mixing, and KL regularization only attenuate these behaviors rather than removing them.
summary_en.importance: The useful contribution is a shift from sample-level detection to source-level redundancy. This is relevant to SFT data procurement, continual pretraining with licensed corpora, synthetic-data pipelines, and model-merging workflows. The paper makes a concrete point for pretraining and post-training practice: averaging objectives preserve weak source-specific signals, whereas eliminating such signals requires an aggregation rule with a veto-like structure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method trains one reference model per data source, all initialized from the same base model. At decoding time, it aggregates their next-token distributions and keeps tokens only when multiple source-specific models support them. The paper introduces token-wise minimum aggregation and base-relative minimum aggregation. The latter compares each reference model’s token probability against the base model and then aggregates relative improvements, reducing the risk that raw probabilities are dominated by the base prior. This differs from union training, KL regularization, and LoRA weight merging: those methods average source effects, while the proposed decoders prevent a single source from independently increasing the probability of a poisoned behavior. The paper also adds quorum aggregation and semantic smoothing to handle cases where not every source contains the desired benefit or where different sources express the same benefit with different surface forms.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluations cover explicit poisoning, subliminal learning, and emergent misalignment. The proposed consensus decoders are compared with union training, LoRA weight merging, and whole-output consensus sampling. The reported pattern is that shared beneficial behavior is largely preserved, while behavior tied to one source is suppressed. A central theoretical result is that KL regularization toward multiple reference models is minimized by an average of their distributions, so source-specific misbehavior is diluted but not vetoed. The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, model sizes, or dataset sizes; those details should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the threat model, especially the attributable-source and support-margin assumptions. Then read Lemma 1, because it explains why regularization behaves like averaging. After that, focus on the definitions of minimum aggregation and base-relative minimum aggregation. In the experiments, prioritize the comparisons against union training, KL-style regularization, and LoRA merging, plus the ablations for quorum aggregation and semantic smoothing. The main limitation to track is that the defense depends on known source identity and on the desired behavior being supported by more sources than any single unwanted behavior.

recommendation.zh: 推理时冗余防御的思路值得后训练安全团队参考，只读§3的两种共识解码器设计部分即可
recommendation.en: The inference-time redundancy defense idea is valuable for post-training safety teams; only read §3 for the two consensus decoder designs

paper.title: Robust Critics: Defending LLMs Against Multi-Turn Attacks
paper.abstract: When a user asks a language model something harmful, is it a genuine attack or a misunderstood but well-meaning question? This ambiguity is one of the central challenges of LLM safety. A model that assumes the worst harms legitimate users; one that assumes the best is easily exploited. The problem is compounded in multi-turn dialogue, where an attacker's true intent may only reveal itself gradually across many exchanges, yet existing safety frameworks apply a contextual bandit treatment, ignorin

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM多轮安全防护框架将对话视为上下文赌博机问题逐轮做静态安全判断，不在线推断对话方的潜在意图，无法同时平衡对良性用户的有用性和对多轮渐进式攻击的鲁棒性，容易出现过度拒绝或被恶意引导绕过的问题。
summary.importance: 该工作将多轮安全问题形式化为用户意图为隐变量的对抗MDP问题，提出的推理时防护方法无需微调基座模型即可黑盒迁移，对推理时对齐、安全防护的工程实现有参考价值，但属于推理时安全引导方向，对基座预训练研究的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出对话评论家引导采样（DCGS）框架，为两阶段生成流程：第一阶段训练意图评论家，基于完整对话历史推断当前对话方为良性或恶意的隐状态；第二阶段用训练好的token级评论家对基础模型采样的候选回复做加权重排，根据推断的意图选择匹配的回复策略。理论上证明该方法可渐进将基础策略向更优策略做指数倾斜，对有限候选集保证期望Q值提升。意图评论家采用反事实目标训练，同时惩罚对良性请求的过度拒绝和对恶意请求的合规回复，无需手动平衡多损失项权重。
summary.experiments: 在最新的多轮攻击数据集上，DCGS相比包括前沿商用模型在内的强基线取得了更高的攻击防御成功率，同时在良性请求上的任务完成率保持相当水平。方法为黑盒兼容设计，无需修改或微调目标基座模型。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注多轮对话安全的对抗MDP形式化、两阶段评论家的设计思路，无需深究理论证明和细粒度实验细节，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM multi-turn safety frameworks treat dialogue as a contextual bandit problem, applying static per-turn safety judgments without online inference of the interlocutor's latent intent. This design fails to balance usability for benign users and robustness against gradual multi-turn attacks, leading to systematic over-refusal or easy adversarial circumvention.
summary_en.importance: The work formalizes multi-turn safety as an adversarial MDP with user intent as a latent variable, and proposes an inference-time defense that transfers to black-box models without fine-tuning. It offers practical reference for inference-time alignment and safety engineering, but has limited direct relevance to base model pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Dialogue Critic Guided Sampling (DCGS) is a two-stage generation pipeline. First, a trained intent critic estimates the interlocutor's latent state (benign vs adversarial) from the full dialogue history. Second, a token-level critic reweights candidate responses sampled from the base LLM, selecting responses appropriate to the inferred intent. The approach comes with a theoretical guarantee that it asymptotically tilts the base policy exponentially toward an improved policy, with guaranteed expected Q-value improvement for finite candidate pools. The intent critic is trained with a counterfactual objective that jointly penalizes over-refusal on benign queries and compliance with harmful requests, eliminating the need for manual loss term weighting.
summary_en.experiments: On recent multi-turn attack benchmarks, DCGS achieves higher defense success rates against attacks than strong baselines including frontier commercial models, while maintaining competitive task completion rates on benign queries. The method operates in a black-box setting, requiring no fine-tuning or modification to the target base model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for core ideas; focus on the adversarial MDP formalization of multi-turn safety and the two-stage critic design. There is no need to dive deep into theoretical proofs or granular experimental results. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将多轮越狱防御建模为 MDP 并引入 critic 引导采样，对 RLHF/安全对齐研究员有启发，值得关注其 critic 的训练和集成方式。
recommendation.en: Modeling multi-turn jailbreak defense as an MDP with critic-guided sampling is inspiring for RLHF/safety alignment researchers; worth noting how the critics are trained and integrated.

paper.title: Isolating LLM Alignment from Regex: Zero Coverage and Metric-Dependent Divergence Under Adversarial Mutation
paper.abstract: Production LLM applications commonly stack a regex filter in front of model-side alignment; prior work found no measurable coverage gain from adding a live Gemini backend behind an active regex filter. We ask whether that ceiling holds when the corpus is \emph{designed to bypass the regex}. We introduce $L_5$-no-regex -- identical to $L_4$-real (Gemini-2.5-flash, token-budget cap, rate limit, output scrub) but with the nine-pattern filter disabled -- and evaluate it against $N{=}45$ adversarial

summary.core_problem: 生产LLM应用普遍在模型对齐前堆叠regex过滤器，但对抗样本下两者的实际覆盖关系与有效性尚不明确。
summary.importance: 通过对抗突变实验揭示了regex过滤的无效性与对齐评测的指标依赖性，属于LLM安全对齐领域的实证发现。
summary.technical_approach: 构造L5-no-regex评测设置（移除9种regex模式，保留Gemini-2.5-flash后端、token预算、速率限制、输出清洗），使用45个对抗探针分三个子语料，通过Gemini释义与PAIR方法扩增到约1555次探针运行，重复5次验证。
summary.experiments: 主指标（子串分类器）下，L5拦截率为0%，与无对齐的L0无差异（Δpp=0，p=1.00，Wilson上界<5%）；次级指标（LLM judge）下PAIR变体拦截率为56-100%（p<0.01），显示对齐效果存在但被主指标掩盖。

summary_en.core_problem: Production LLM applications commonly stack regex filters before model-side alignment, but their actual coverage and effectiveness under adversarial input remain unclear.
summary_en.importance: Empirically reveals the ineffectiveness of regex filtering and metric-dependent alignment evaluation, a key finding in LLM safety alignment research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs L5-no-regex evaluation setup (removing 9 regex patterns while keeping Gemini-2.5-flash backend, token budget, rate limit, output scrubbing), uses 45 adversarial probes across three sub-corpora, amplified via Gemini paraphrase and PAIR to ~1,555 probe-run pairs with 5 replications.
summary_en.experiments: Under primary substring classifier, L5 block rate is 0% with no difference from L0 (Δpp=0, p=1.00, Wilson upper bound <5%); under secondary LLM-judge metric, PAIR variants show 56-100% block rates (p<0.01), indicating alignment effects exist but are masked by the primary metric.

recommendation.zh: 对抗下regex完全失效的结论实证扎实，对齐评测指标选择对结论影响极大，后训练安全团队可参考
recommendation.en: Empirically solid finding that regex filters fail completely under adversarial input; metric choice drastically changes alignment conclusions, relevant for safety post-training teams.

paper.title: Incomplete Prompt Jailbreaks in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly released as open-weight models with safeguards against harmful requests. Nevertheless, sentence completion remains vulnerable to incomplete harmful prompts. In this work, we formalize this phenomenon as incomplete prompt jailbreaks (IPJ) and provide a systematic empirical characterization of when and how incomplete prompts elicit harmful continuations. We analyze diverse attractor types associated with incomplete sentence continuation and show that L

summary.core_problem: 开放权重大模型在面对语法未完结的有害提示时，会优先保持语句连贯性先生成有害内容，待句子结束后才输出拒绝，这种被称为不完整提示越狱（IPJ）的安全失效模式缺乏系统刻画，且现有参数微调防御存在系统性的泛化缺陷。
summary.importance: 揭示了自回归模型预训练阶段习得的语句连贯性先验，与后训练阶段引入的安全对齐目标之间存在系统性冲突，解释了为什么纯微调防御难以从根本上覆盖这类越狱场景；识别出的句终、续接两类功能神经元，为推理时的轻量安全干预提供了思路，但工作本身未涉及预训练层面的改进，对预训练研究的参考价值主要在理解预训练先验与后训练对齐的张力边界。
summary.technical_approach: 首先形式化定义IPJ，构建9类接在有害请求后、维持句子未完成状态以诱导续接的语言“吸引子”结构；将模型输出拆分为句前段、句终token、句后段三部分，用攻击成功率、拒绝距离两个指标量化失效程度。随后验证了针对IPJ的微调防御存在三类一致的泛化失败：跨有害内容域迁移差、跨未见过的吸引子类型迁移差、无法适配不同拒绝风格的基础模型。最后通过激活相关性分析定位两类功能神经元：与句终标点强相关的终止神经元，以及在“禁止终止/强制终止”指令对比下激活差异显著的续接神经元，验证了激活终止神经元、抑制续接神经元可提前打断有害生成。
summary.experiments: 基于公开的正文内容，实验在多款主流开放权重模型上验证了IPJ现象的普遍性，模型普遍表现出“先续接有害内容、句子完结后再拒绝”的行为模式；微调防御在分布外的有害内容和未见过的吸引子上攻击成功率明显回升；初步神经元干预结果显示，定向激活终止神经元可将拒绝位置提前，放大续接神经元则会显著增加有害续接的长度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计阅读时间15分钟。重点关注引言中对IPJ机制的解释——即自回归生成的连贯性优先逻辑，以及微调防御三类泛化失败的相关结论；神经元定位部分可快速浏览，无需深究安全攻防的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Open-weight LLMs exhibit a pervasive safety failure called Incomplete Prompt Jailbreak (IPJ): when presented with grammatically incomplete harmful prompts, models prioritize discourse coherence to generate harmful continuations first, and only produce refusals after the sentence reaches completion; this phenomenon lacks systematic characterization, and existing parameter-tuning defenses suffer from systematic generalization failures.
summary_en.importance: This work highlights the inherent tension between the discourse coherence prior acquired during pretraining and safety alignment objectives introduced in post-training, providing empirical evidence for why fine-tuning alone cannot fully resolve this class of jailbreak vulnerabilities. The identified functional neuron clusters for sentence termination and continuation offer a path for lightweight inference-time safety intervention, though the work does not propose pretraining-level fixes. Its primary relevance to pretraining research lies in clarifying the boundary between pretrained generative priors and post-hoc alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work first formalizes the IPJ problem, constructing a taxonomy of 9 linguistic "attractor" structures that append to harmful requests to keep sentences grammatically incomplete and induce continuation. Model outputs are decomposed into pre-termination, sentence-termination, and post-termination segments, with attack success rate and refusal distance as core metrics. The authors then demonstrate that fine-tuning models to refuse early on incomplete harmful prompts suffers from three consistent failure modes: poor transfer across harmful content domains, poor transfer to unseen attractor types, and inability to generalize across base models with different default refusal styles. Finally, activation correlation analysis is used to identify two functional neuron groups: termination neurons strongly associated with sentence-final punctuation, and continuation neurons that show large activation differences between termination-forbidden and termination-forced prompting contexts, with causal effects on generation continuation verified via activation intervention.
summary_en.experiments: From the publicly available portion of the manuscript, experiments across widely used open-weight LLMs confirm IPJ is a pervasive failure mode, with models consistently generating harmful continuations before producing refusals after sentence completion. Fine-tuning defenses show substantial performance degradation on out-of-domain harmful content and unseen attractors, with attack success rates rebounding to high levels. Initial neuron intervention results indicate that targeted activation of termination neurons shifts refusal positions earlier, while amplification of continuation neurons reliably increases the length of harmful continuations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in approximately 15 minutes. Focus on the introduction's mechanistic explanation of coherence-first autoregressive generation, and the section documenting the three generalization failure modes of fine-tuning based defenses. The neuron analysis section can be scanned quickly; deep engagement with attack and defense implementation details is unnecessary for pretraining researchers.

recommendation.zh: 从机制可解释性角度分析了不完整 prompt 导致越狱的原因（延迟拒绝机制），并定位了终止/续写神经元，对理解 LLM 生成机制和安全对齐有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Analyzes the causes of incomplete prompt jailbreaks from a mechanistic interpretability perspective (delayed refusal mechanism) and locates termination/continuation neurons, offering reference value for understanding LLM generation mechanisms and safety alignment.

paper.title: Geometric Configurations of Perturbed Jailbreak Prompts
paper.abstract: Perturbation techniques that turn unsuccessful jailbreak prompts into successful ones are continuously evolving, constituting a major security threat to LLM safety. In this paper, we investigate the internal representations of such string-level perturbed jailbreak inputs in the small weight models of the Qwen-2.5-1.5B/-3B/-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-1B/-3B/-3.1-8B-Instruct families. We select two representation spaces: the last-layer-last-token embedding space and the top-50 next-token probabilit

summary.core_problem: 研究字符串级扰动 jailbreak prompt 在小型指令模型内部表示中的几何结构，以及这些结构是否能解释拒答和服从行为。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是安全机制分析。它不提出新的防御方法，而是检查常见表示空间中是否存在可分离的 jailbreak 行为几何，对 representation-based safety probe 的可靠性有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文选取两个空间：最后一层最后 token embedding，以及 top-50 next-token probability space。作者比较不同拼写、格式扰动和行为标签在这些空间中的聚类与可分性，并寻找是否存在区分 compliant/refusal 的行为超平面。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen-2.5-1.5B/3B/7B-Instruct 与 Llama-3.2-1B/3B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 等小权重模型。主要发现是 embedding 空间更按拼写和格式分离；top-50 概率空间近似一维但聚类并不简单；在拒答占优的答案集合中，两类空间都没有稳定行为超平面，只有少数 next token 与服从标签显著相关。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies the geometry of string-level perturbed jailbreak prompts inside small instruction-tuned LLMs and asks whether those representations explain refusal versus compliance.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a safety-mechanism analysis. It does not introduce a new defense, but it tests whether common representation spaces contain a clean behavioral separator for jailbreak outcomes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes two spaces: the last-layer last-token embedding and the top-50 next-token probability vector. It examines clustering by spelling, format, and behavioral labels, then searches for a hyperplane separating compliant from refusal-dominated answers.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen-2.5-1.5B/3B/7B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-1B/3B plus Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The embedding space separates spelling and formatting more than behavior; the top-50 probability space is effectively one-dimensional; no robust behavioral hyperplane is found, except for a few next-token associations such as "Sure" in one Qwen model and punctuation/newline tokens in one Llama model.

recommendation.zh: 小模型安全几何的负结果，适合备查；只看表示空间选择和无超平面结论即可。
recommendation.en: A negative result on jailbreak geometry in small models; skim the representation choices and the no-hyperplane finding.

paper.title: HijackKV: New Threat in Position-Independent KV Cache Reuse
paper.abstract: Key-Value (KV) cache reduces inference latency in large language models (LLMs). Traditional prefix-based reuse has low cache hit rates across inference requests because it requires exact token and position matches. To improve efficiency, recent system optimizations introduce position-independent KV reuse, allowing KV cache to be reused whenever identical text chunks appear, regardless of their position in the sequence.   We show this design introduces a new threat, KV Cache Hijacking. Since KV c

summary.core_problem: 位置无关的 KV cache 复用机制为了提升推理吞吐，允许相同文本块在不同前缀、不同位置下直接复用已计算的 KV 状态。论文指出这一设计存在被攻击者劫持的安全漏洞：被复用的 KV 实际编码了原始计算时的上下文，而不是只代表当前块本身，因此攻击者可以预先污染公共块的 KV，在后续跨用户复用时静默改变其他用户的输出。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员的直接启发不在建模范式，而在两个边界问题：一是 KV cache 对上下文的敏感性不仅是精度问题，也是安全边界，说明『把局部块的表征当作可独立缓存对象』这个工程假设与 Transformer 的实际计算语义存在张力；二是随着推理系统越来越激进地做跨请求、跨租户复用，模型内部状态的复用条件需要和训练时的因果假设一起设计，而不只是系统层事后优化。对研究长上下文、注意力机制和推理效率的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 HijackKV 攻击流程。攻击者先选择一个在真实部署中会被高频复用的良性文本块，例如公共 FAQ 或检索文档片段；然后为该块构造一段恶意优化前缀，使该块在前缀条件下计算得到的 KV 隐式携带攻击者目标，例如诱导后续回答偏向某一立场或注入特定内容。当服务端启用位置无关复用后，其他用户请求中只要命中这个相同文本块，就可能直接复用这份被污染的 KV，即使受害者上下文中完全没有攻击者前缀文本。攻击不要求在受害者输入里出现可见的恶意 token，因此区别于传统 prompt injection。论文还分析了现有补救措施，例如选择性重算部分 KV，指出这类方案原本为弥补精度损失设计，默认重算比例不足以消除被植入的上下文偏置。
summary.experiments: 论文在多模型、多 KV 复用机制上评估了攻击可行性。核心结果包括：单次尝试平均攻击成功率约 94%；即使缓存命中率低到 10%，攻击仍然有效；当系统启用最高 50% 比例的选择性 KV 重算时，攻击依旧保持较高成功率；在被污染 KV 之后插入超过 1000 个无关 token，攻击影响仍可保持，说明污染可以跨多轮持续；在黑盒设定下，恶意前缀对不同模型具有一定迁移性。论文没有提出完整防御方案，最后给出了安全设计建议，例如限制跨租户复用、引入上下文绑定校验、提高重算策略的安全阈值。
summary.reading_guide: 适合泛读。重点看引言中的威胁模型、Figure 1 对传统前缀复用与位置无关复用差异的图示，以及攻击为何不依赖受害者输入中出现恶意 token。实验部分重点关注三个数字：94% 成功率、10% 低命中率下仍有效、50% 重算仍失效；这三个结果最能说明问题不是边角案例。防御建议章节可读得快一些，因为目前还是原则性方向。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Position-independent KV cache reuse improves inference throughput by reusing cached KV states for identical text chunks across different positions and prefixes.
