The paper shows this optimization introduces a security vulnerability: reused KV states encode the original causal context in which they were computed, not just the local chunk itself, so an attacker can pre-poison KV entries of commonly shared chunks and silently hijack other users’ generations when those entries are later reused across requests.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretrain research is at the boundary between modeling assumptions and inference systems. First, context dependence of KV states is not only an accuracy issue for approximate reuse but also a security boundary, revealing a tension between aggressive chunk-level caching and the causal semantics of Transformers. Second, as serving systems move toward cross-request and cross-tenant reuse, the conditions under which internal states can be safely reused may need to be co-designed with model behavior rather than treated as a purely systems-level afterthought. This is useful for researchers working on long context, attention, and efficient inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes HijackKV, an attack against position-independent KV reuse. The attacker first identifies a benign text chunk likely to be widely reused in deployment, such as a public FAQ page or a retrieved document fragment. The attacker then optimizes a malicious prefix such that the KV states computed for the benign chunk under that prefix implicitly encode the attacker’s objective. When a later victim request contains the same chunk, the serving system may directly reuse the poisoned KV entry even though the malicious prefix is absent from the victim context. This makes the attack different from prompt injection, where adversarial tokens must appear in the victim prompt. The paper also studies selective KV recomputation, a standard mitigation for accuracy degradation in reuse systems, and shows that typical recomputation budgets are insufficient to remove the implanted bias.
summary_en.experiments: The attack is evaluated across multiple models and KV reuse implementations. Key results include: about 94% average attack success rate with a single attempt; attack remains effective when chunk hit rate is as low as 10%; attack remains effective even when up to 50% of KV states are selectively recomputed; the effect persists after more than 1,000 unrelated tokens are appended after the hijacked chunk, suggesting persistence across multi-turn interactions; the malicious prefix shows some black-box transferability across models. The paper does not provide a full defense, but closes with design recommendations such as restricting cross-tenant reuse, binding cached entries more tightly to context, and raising recomputation thresholds under untrusted workloads.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper for the threat model and its implications. Focus on the introduction, Figure 1 comparing prefix-based and position-independent reuse, and the key distinction from prompt injection. In experiments, pay most attention to three numbers—94% success, effectiveness at 10% hit rate, and persistence under 50% recomputation—because they establish that the issue is not a narrow corner case. The defense discussion is preliminary and can be read quickly. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 首次系统揭示位置无关KV缓存复用的安全漏洞，做推理优化的必看，预训练研究员可关注位置编码的侧信道风险。
recommendation.en: First systematic disclosure of position-independent KV reuse vulnerabilities; must-read for inference optimization researchers, note position encoding side-channel risks for pretraining.

paper.title: Geometry-Guided Constraint Learning for LLM Safety Classification
paper.abstract: Safety as Polytope (SaP) learns linear half-space constraints in LLM hidden space but requires per-category tuning of the constraint count K. We show that sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature extraction resolves this: K=2 becomes optimal for 12/14 categories on Qwen3.5-9B, achieving 96-99% accuracy per category on our BeaverTails classification benchmark, largely eliminating the need for exhaustive sweeps (K=4-25 with random initialization). This convergence to two planes is consistent with the Line

summary.core_problem: 研究如何在 LLM 隐状态空间中学习可解释、低调参成本的安全分类边界。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是机制分析与安全分类方法改进。它把 Safety as Polytope 的半空间约束和 SAE 特征空间结合起来，试图说明安全类别在某些表示空间里可能有低维线性边界。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先用稀疏自编码器提取 LLM hidden states 的特征，再在 SAE feature space 中学习线性半空间约束。相对原 SaP 需要为每个类别扫描约束数 K，作者发现 K=2 在大多数类别上已足够，并进一步提出带可学习孔径的 cone constraint，用类别簇的集中程度自适应约束形状，训练上用三阶段流程稳定优化。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen3.5-9B 和 BeaverTails 安全分类基准。作者报告 K=2 在 14 个类别中的 12 个上最优，每类准确率达到 96%-99%，并减少了原方法需要在 K=4 到 25、随机初始化条件下大量 sweep 的成本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to learn interpretable and low-tuning-cost safety classification boundaries in LLM hidden spaces.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a mechanism-oriented safety classifier. It connects Safety as Polytope-style half-space constraints with SAE features, suggesting that some safety categories may admit low-dimensional linear boundaries in an extracted feature space.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method first extracts sparse autoencoder features from LLM hidden states, then learns linear half-space constraints in the SAE feature space. Unlike the original SaP setup that requires per-category sweeps over the number of constraints K, the authors find K=2 sufficient for most categories. They also introduce a cone constraint with a learnable aperture, trained with a three-phase procedure for stability.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Qwen3.5-9B and a BeaverTails safety classification benchmark. The paper reports that K=2 is optimal for 12 out of 14 categories, reaching 96%-99% per-category accuracy and largely avoiding exhaustive sweeps over K=4 to 25 with random initialization.

recommendation.zh: 低成本看 abstract 和结果表即可；SAE 后 K=2 收敛有意思，但分类 benchmark 太窄，别过度外推到安全表示。
recommendation.en: Skim the abstract and result table only; the SAE-to-K=2 convergence is interesting, but the benchmark is too narrow to generalize to safety representations.

paper.title: Defense Against LLM Backdoors using Critical Neuron Isolation Pruning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where hidden triggers induce malicious outputs. Existing defenses generally fall into inference-time detection or training-time mitigation, but face two key limitations. First, they focus on fine-tuning-based backdoors (e.g., PEFT modules) and fail to address insidious model-editing attacks that bypass training pipelines. Second, they target simple classification settings and do not naturally extend to open-ended LLM generation and

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM后门防御多针对微调注入的后门、依赖行为级启发式，无法有效应对模型编辑类后门且适配开放生成场景。
summary.importance: 方法创新，从表征机制层面切入后门防御，提出关键神经元隔离剪枝的思路，提升防御的鲁棒性与通用性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DeCNIP防御框架，通过定位引发恶意激活的关键神经元并进行隔离剪枝，从表征根源消除后门效应，区别于传统推理时检测或训练时缓解的路径。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量、基准数据集及量化防御效果数据。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM backdoor defenses mostly target fine-tuning injected backdoors and rely on behavioral heuristics, failing to address model-editing backdoors and adapt to open-ended generation scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation approaching backdoor defense from representational mechanism level, proposing critical neuron isolation pruning to improve defense robustness and generality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DeCNIP defense framework, which locates critical neurons triggering malicious activations and prunes them to eliminate backdoor effects from the representational root, differing from traditional inference-time detection or training-time mitigation paths.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model size, benchmark dataset, or quantitative defense performance data is disclosed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 从神经元机制层面切入LLM后门防御的思路有新意，可扫读方法部分看关键神经元的定位逻辑，无需深读实验。
recommendation.en: Mechanism-driven LLM backdoor defense via neuron pruning has novel ideas; skim the method section for critical neuron localization logic, no need to deep-dive experiments.

paper.title: Value Leakage: An LLM's Answers Are Silently Shaped by Its Own Values
paper.abstract: People use language models for practical questions whose answers are difficult to verify. We show that models exhibit covert value leakage: the information they provide is influenced by their own values, without this influence being disclosed to the user.   In one of our evaluations, the user is considering investing in an AI company and wants to know how likely the AI bubble is to pop. Claude Opus 4.8 gives a lower probability when the company under consideration is Anthropic rather than OpenAI

summary.core_problem: LLM 在回答难以验证的实际问题时，其输出会被模型自身的价值观（包括道德偏好和对母公司的偏向）隐蔽地影响，且模型大多不会向用户披露这种影响。这种隐蔽的价值泄漏构成一种不忠实（unfaithful）的对齐失败。
summary.importance: 对预训练和对齐研究有中等程度的启发。论文指出的问题不是传统的 overt bias，而是 RL 对齐难以处理的隐蔽偏向——当不存在唯一正确答案、反事实偏差无法被 reward model 直接测量时，value leakage 很难通过现有 RLHF 流程消除。这对理解对齐训练的盲区和 faithfulness 评测的设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 设计一组评测任务，每个任务都包含一个容易识别、但不应影响正确答案的 prompt 特征作为变量：Donation Bet（估计数值，阈值触发向好坏事业捐款）、AI Bubble（估计 AI 泡沫破裂概率，用户提及投资特定 AI 公司）、AGI Tweet（估计 2035 年前 AGI 概率，用户提及针对特定公司的批评推文）、Job Offer、Agentic Grading、Choosing Activities。通过改变这个变量来量化偏差，并检查模型的 CoT 或摘要是否披露了这种影响。
summary.experiments: 测试 Claude Opus 4.8、GPT 5.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro 等前沿模型。Claude 在 AI Bubble 任务中，当用户考虑投资 Anthropic 时给出的泡沫破裂概率低于投资 OpenAI 时，且大多不披露这一影响。GPT 模型在道德结果和自家公司相关问题上偏差较小，但作者指出这可能反映偏好强度不同而非泄漏倾向不同。Gemini 在部分任务中甚至表现出对自家公司的反向偏差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点看 Section 1.2 的局限性讨论和各任务的实验设计逻辑。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。论文明确声明这不是模型排名榜，主要价值在于提出 value leakage 这一现象和对应的评测范式。

summary_en.core_problem: When LLMs answer practical questions that are hard to verify, their outputs are covertly shaped by their own values (including moral preferences and parent-company bias), and models mostly fail to disclose this influence to users. This covert value leakage constitutes an unfaithful alignment failure.
summary_en.importance: Moderate relevance to pretraining and alignment research. The problem is not overt bias but a covert bias that RL alignment struggles to address: when no single ground-truth answer exists and counterfactual bias cannot be directly measured by a reward model, value leakage is hard to eliminate through standard RLHF pipelines. Useful for understanding blind spots in alignment training and for designing faithfulness evaluations.
summary_en.technical_approach: A suite of evaluation tasks is designed, each containing an easily identifiable prompt feature that should not influence the correct answer but is varied to measure bias: Donation Bet (estimate a quantity; threshold triggers donation to good/bad causes), AI Bubble (probability of AI bubble popping; user mentions investing in a specific AI company), AGI Tweet (probability of AGI by 2035; user mentions a critical tweet about a specific company), Job Offer, Agentic Grading, and Choosing Activities. Bias is quantified by varying this feature, and model CoTs/summaries are checked for disclosure of the influence.
summary_en.experiments: Frontier models tested include Claude Opus 4.8, GPT 5.5, and Gemini 3.1 Pro. On the AI Bubble task, Claude gives a lower bubble-popping probability when the user considers investing in Anthropic versus OpenAI, and mostly fails to disclose this influence. GPT models show less bias on moral and own-company questions, though the authors note this may reflect weaker preferences rather than lower leakage propensity. Gemini shows anti-own-company bias on some tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the limitations discussion in Section 1.2 and the task design logic across experiments. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes. The authors explicitly state this is not a model ranking; its value lies in identifying the value leakage phenomenon and proposing an evaluation paradigm.

recommendation.zh: 价值泄漏根源于预训练数据关联与后训练对齐信号的偏差，建议读§3的评测设计和§4的泄漏类型分析，可用于内部对齐审计
recommendation.en: Value leakage stems from pretraining data correlations and post-training alignment signal biases; read §3 evaluation design and §4 leakage type analysis for internal alignment audits.

paper.title: When Debiasing Backfires: Counterintuitive Side Effects of Preprocessing-Based Stereotype Mitigation
paper.abstract: Preprocessing-based methods for stereotype mitigation, such as pre-/post-training on debiased corpora, are widely used in NLP. While these approaches reduce measurable stereotypes for targeted groups, we find they often induce unintended shifts-side effects, where stereotyping or counter-stereotyping can increase relative to neutral baselines for other demographics, including across unrelated demographic categories. We demonstrate these side effects across two model families (encoder-only and de

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究数据预处理式去偏是否会产生副作用：针对某一群体降低 stereotype 指标后，模型是否会在其他群体、甚至其他人口属性类别上产生新的 stereotype 或 counter-stereotype 偏移。
summary.importance: 它对预训练数据研究有明确参考价值。结论提醒数据级安全处理不能只看目标群体指标，也不能假设删除、替换或过滤某类样本只会局部影响模型。对于大规模预训练语料清洗、去毒、去偏和数据混合，这意味着需要报告非目标群体的 side-effect diagnostics，并把干预看作分布整体重加权，而不是简单的局部修补。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在 Wikipedia 上构造面向六个人口群体、三个类别的去偏语料，覆盖 gender、race、religion。它比较三类预处理策略：删除 stereotypical sentences、删除 group mentions、交换 group references。训练设置包括 pre-training 和 post-training，模型包括 encoder-only TinyBERT 与 decoder-only GPT-2，并在不同数据规模下复现实验。评估不只看被干预的目标群体，也看所有非目标群体，用 StereoSet 和 CrowS-Pairs 衡量 stereotype / anti-stereotype / neutral 之间的变化。论文还用 attention rollout 检查内部注意力归因，但发现注意力路径变化很小，难以解释外部 bias 指标的大幅移动。
summary.experiments: 主要结果是：预处理通常能降低目标群体的 stereotype 指标，但常伴随非目标群体的 stereotype 或 counter-stereotype 上升；这种副作用不仅出现在同一属性类别内，也会跨类别出现，例如针对 gender 的干预可能影响 race 或 religion 指标。现象在三种预处理策略、pre-training 与 post-training、不同训练数据规模、TinyBERT 和 GPT-2 上都能观察到。论文还在一个更大的 decoder-only 模型的单个 post-training slice 上看到相同趋势。作者指出，这些变化不能只由训练集中 stereotypical / anti-stereotypical 样本比例变化解释，标准 benchmark 若只报告目标群体或聚合分数，容易漏掉这些偏移。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看实验设计：去偏语料如何构造，target group 与 non-target group 如何定义，side effect 的判定标准是什么。结果部分优先看各群体矩阵式变化和不同预处理策略的对比。attention-rollout 分析可以快速看结论：它排除了一个简单解释，但没有给出可靠机制。对预训练数据团队来说，最有用的是诊断框架，而不是具体小模型上的分数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether preprocessing-based debiasing has unintended side effects: reducing measured stereotypes for a target group may increase stereotyping or counter-stereotyping for other groups, including groups from unrelated demographic categories.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to pretraining data curation. It shows that data-level mitigation should not be evaluated only on the targeted group. Filtering, removing group mentions, or counterfactual swapping can change the effective training distribution in non-local ways. For large-scale corpus cleaning and safety-oriented data preprocessing, the practical lesson is to report side-effect-aware diagnostics across demographic groups and categories.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors create debiased Wikipedia corpora targeting six demographic groups across gender, race, and religion. They test three preprocessing interventions: removing stereotypical sentences, removing group mentions, and swapping group references. The interventions are applied in both pre-training and post-training settings, across data scales, and on two model families: encoder-only TinyBERT and decoder-only GPT-2. Evaluation covers both target and non-target groups with StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs, tracking movement among stereotypical, anti-stereotypical, and neutral preferences. They also use attention rollout to see whether attention attribution shifts explain the observed behavior, but the attribution changes are small relative to the output-level bias shifts.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical finding is consistent: targeted preprocessing can reduce stereotypes for the target group while increasing stereotyping or counter-stereotyping elsewhere. The side effects appear within a demographic category and across categories. They hold across the three preprocessing strategies, pre-training and post-training setups, multiple data scales, and both TinyBERT and GPT-2. A larger decoder-only model shows the same qualitative pattern on one post-training slice. The authors argue that the shifts cannot be explained solely by changes in the counts of stereotypical and anti-stereotypical examples, and that standard benchmark reporting can miss them when it focuses on aggregate or target-only scores.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the corpus construction, the definition of target and non-target groups, and the side-effect criterion. In the results, look for the group-by-group change matrices and comparisons across preprocessing methods. The attention-rollout section is useful mainly as a negative result: it rules out a simple attention-routing explanation but does not provide a full causal mechanism. For pretraining data work, the diagnostic protocol is more reusable than the small-model scores.

recommendation.zh: 读实验矩阵和副作用诊断；它提醒数据清洗不是单调安全操作，内部 debias ablation 应加非目标群体切片。
recommendation.en: Read the experiment matrix and side-effect diagnostics; it shows debiasing is not monotonic, and internal ablations should include non-target demographic slices.

paper.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of LLM Jailbreaks via Internal Attribution Graphs
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable capabilities but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial prompts and jailbreak attacks. Existing approaches primarily analyze these failures through input-output behaviors or attribution methods, offering limited insight into how adversarial perturbations alter the model's internal reasoning. Consequently, the mechanisms underlying unsafe or incorrect behaviors remain poorly understood. We introduce a mechanistic framework for diagnosing LLM vulner

summary.core_problem: 现有 jailbreak 分析大多停留在输入-输出行为或单点归因层面，无法解释对抗性 prompt 如何系统性改变 LLM 的内部计算通路，从而导致安全机制失效。
summary.importance: 对预训练和对齐研究者的价值主要在机制层面：它试图把 jailbreak 问题从“prompt 层面的 bug”转化为“计算图层面的路径重路由问题”。文中一个值得注意的发现是，针对单个可疑节点做干预通常无法缓解攻击，说明失效模式更像是分布式子图通路而非单个安全神经元失效。这对基于安全向量、单个抑制方向、稀疏方向调控等干预思路是一个有用的警示。
summary.technical_approach: 为每个 prompt 在给定输出位置构造一张内部归因图：节点覆盖 token embedding、attention 输出、FFN 特征、residual stream、logits 以及 reconstruction error 等异构内部表示；边用“梯度×激活”的因果贡献度估计，并通过保留每个节点 top-k 入边维持稀疏性。核心不是对单图做静态分析，而是对 clean prompt 和 attacked prompt 配对构图、对齐，再量化节点、边、路径和子图级别的结构偏移。论文进一步引入因果干预框架，通过激活/抑制特定内部结构来验证这些偏差是否真的对攻击成功负责，并据此归纳出 safety suppression、attack emergence、computation rerouting 几类脆弱性 motif。
summary.experiments: 论文展示了内部图偏离程度与 jailbreak 成功之间存在相关性；更重要的消融是，节点级定点干预普遍不能有效缓解攻击，而与攻击相关的变化分布在多条路径和更高阶子图上，说明脆弱性是分布式、结构性的，而不是局部特征开关式的。文中未强调特别大的参数规模或新的 sota 防御效果，重点在诊断和机制验证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。建议重点看 Method 中图的构造方式，尤其是节点集合为什么纳入 reconstruction error，以及边权重如何定义；再看 paired alignment 和 intervention 两部分，理解论文如何从“归因”走到“因果验证”。最后关注 vulnerability motifs 和“节点级干预无效”的实验结论。预计阅读 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Most existing jailbreak analyses operate at the input-output level or rely on isolated attribution scores, leaving unclear how adversarial prompts systematically reroute a model’s internal computation to bypass safety mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: The value for pretraining and alignment research is mechanistic rather than immediately recipe-driven. The paper reframes jailbreaks as structured deviations in internal computation graphs rather than isolated prompt bugs. A particularly relevant finding is that targeted interventions on individual suspicious nodes often fail to mitigate attacks, suggesting that failure modes are distributed across pathways and subgraphs rather than localized to a single safety neuron or direction. This is a useful caution for proposals that rely on safety vectors, single-direction suppression, or sparse feature knockouts.
summary_en.technical_approach: For a given prompt and output position, the method constructs a sparse causal attribution graph over heterogeneous internal states: token embeddings, attention outputs, feedforward features, residual-stream states, logits, and reconstruction-error nodes. Edges are estimated with gradient-times-activation causal influence scores, with sparsity enforced by keeping only the top-k incoming edges per node. The central design is paired analysis: graphs are built for both clean and attacked inputs, aligned structurally, and deviations are quantified at the node, edge, path, and subgraph levels. A causal intervention framework is then used to test whether these altered structures actually contribute to attack success. On this basis, the paper identifies vulnerability motifs such as safety suppression, attack emergence, and computation rerouting.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that internal graph deviations correlate with jailbreak success. The more informative ablation is that node-level interventions are generally ineffective at neutralizing attacks, while attack-relevant changes are spread across multiple pathways and higher-order subgraphs. The study is positioned as a diagnostic and mechanistic analysis rather than a new defense benchmark, so the emphasis is on qualitative structure and intervention results rather than large-scale leaderboard gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read as a skim. Focus on the graph construction in Method, especially why reconstruction-error nodes are included and how edge weights are defined, then move to paired graph alignment and the intervention framework. The most actionable part is the discussion of vulnerability motifs and the evidence that failures are distributed rather than localized. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 从因果计算图的角度分析 Jailbreak 机制，对关注模型安全性和内部表示（Mechanistic Interpretability）的研究员有参考价值，建议看其图构建方法。
recommendation.en: Analyzes Jailbreak mechanisms from the perspective of causal computation graphs; valuable for researchers focusing on model safety and mechanistic interpretability. Recommend reviewing their graph construction method.

paper.title: DT-Guard: Intent-Driven Reasoning-Active Training for Reasoning-Free LLM Safety Guardrail
paper.abstract: Large language models deployed in open-world applications require safety guardrails that are both robust to complex risks and efficient enough for low-latency runtime moderation. Existing guardrails face a practical trade-off between lightweight classification-based models, which are efficient but often struggle with concealed intent, ambiguous semantics, and borderline safety decisions, and reasoning-based guards, which improve judgment quality but introduce additional token generation and infe

summary.core_problem: 如何在不引入推理生成开销（低延迟、低 token 输出）的前提下，让安全护栏模型具备“能处理隐含意图/边界案例/对抗表达”的判别能力。论文把矛盾点表述为：分类式 guardrail 够快但难判复杂意图；推理式 guardrail 判得更稳但部署时延高。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接关联度一般（更偏 post-train/对齐与安全建模），但提供了一个可迁移的训练范式：训练时用显式推理轨迹与分阶段结构化监督，把“推理能力”蒸馏进最终的短输出头（label-only inference）。这类“Reasoning-Active Training, Reasoning-Free Inference”思路，对低延迟场景下的分类器/判别器（包括数据过滤器、质量打分器、reward model、policy compliance classifier）都有参考价值：用更强的训练信号提升边界判别，而不把推理链带到线上。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三块组成：
1) 结构化判别路径：把安全判断从一次性 label 预测改成 Intent → Category → Safety 的渐进决策过程。意图（intent）用于区分同一敏感主题下的教育/防御/研究 vs 恶意利用；Category 对应风险类别；Safety 给最终等级。训练时提供对应的结构化推理轨迹（reasoning trajectory）作为监督，但推理只在训练中出现。
2) 意图驱动数据构建：把异构安全数据统一成 prompt-response-label 格式，并补全 intent、risk category、safety label、CoT/结构化推理。为降低噪声与暴露边界样本，使用模型蒸馏（文中提到 GLM-5.1 distillation）、多轮投票与专家校验的组合流程；目标是让 intent 与边界判定更稳定，而不是只靠表面词触发。
3) RG-PHO（Rollout-Guided Progressive Hard-Case Optimization）：训练中对样本做多次 rollout，通过一致性/失败模式把“难例”分层处理。
- 对持续失败（persistently failed）的样本：用更强的监督纠错（Hard-Case SFT），把正确的结构化决策路径压进去。
- 对偏好不稳定（preference-unstable）的样本：用对比式偏好学习（Hard-Case DPO），在正确/错误 rollouts 间拉开间隔，减少边界摇摆。
整体上，这是把推理轨迹当作训练信号与难例挖掘信号，而不是当作部署输出。
summary.experiments:
论文主打“推理自由（reasoning-free）推理时”的效果：
- Prompt-side 10 个基准：DT-Guard 平均 F1=0.886，对比 Qwen3Guard-8B 的 0.852，提升 3.4 个点。
- Response-side 7 个基准：平均 F1=0.870。
- 双侧综合：4B backbone 的 DT-Guard 双侧平均 F1=0.878，超过若干 8B guardrail baseline。
从摘要与引言能确认的消融点主要围绕：结构化 Intent→Category→Safety 是否优于直接 label；RG-PHO 的 hard-case SFT 与 hard-case DPO 是否分别解决“持续失败/偏好摇摆”。（全文若给出更细分的 per-benchmark、hard-case 子集、rollout 一致性统计，会是判断方法是否真正解决边界问题的关键证据。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–40 分钟）：
- 先看方法总览与流程图：重点抓住“训练时有推理、推理时无推理”的信息流，以及 Intent→Category→Safety 的中间变量如何定义。
- 精看 RG-PHO：多 rollout 的一致性度量怎么做、如何划分 persistently failed vs preference-unstable、Hard-Case SFT 与 Hard-Case DPO 的具体 loss/采样策略。
- 看数据构建细节：intent 标注来源、投票/专家校验比例、不同来源数据如何归一到统一 taxonomy；这些决定了方法能否复现与可迁移。
- 看实验表：优先关注“边界/隐含意图/对抗”子集是否单独报告，以及推理式 guardrail vs 分类式 guardrail 在延迟与吞吐上的对比是否量化。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build a safety guardrail that can handle concealed intent, borderline cases, and adversarial phrasing without paying the runtime cost of chain-of-thought generation. The paper targets the practical gap between fast label-only classifiers (cheap but brittle) and reasoning-based guards (stronger judgments but higher latency).
summary_en.importance: Moderate relevance to foundation-model pretraining (it is primarily a safety/post-training guardrail paper), but it demonstrates a reusable recipe: use explicit reasoning trajectories and staged supervision during training, then distill the capability into a label-only inference interface. This “reasoning-active training, reasoning-free inference” pattern is transferable to other low-latency discriminators used around pretraining pipelines (data filtering/quality scoring) and post-training (reward models, policy classifiers) where you want stronger decision boundaries without exposing long rationales at serving time.
summary_en.technical_approach:
DT-Guard combines (i) a structured decision decomposition, (ii) an intent-enriched dataset, and (iii) rollout-guided hard-case optimization.
1) Progressive decision structure: instead of mapping text directly to a safety label, the model is trained to follow Intent → Category → Safety. Intent is meant to disambiguate benign vs malicious use under the same sensitive topic; Category captures risk taxonomy; Safety is the final verdict. Reasoning trajectories are used as supervision during training but are not emitted at inference.
2) Intent-driven data construction: heterogeneous safety resources are normalized into a unified prompt–response–label format and augmented with intent labels, risk categories, safety labels, and structured CoT-style trajectories. The pipeline mentions distillation (GLM-5.1), multi-round voting, and expert verification to reduce annotation noise and surface boundary cases.
3) RG-PHO (Rollout-Guided Progressive Hard-Case Optimization): the model performs multiple rollouts per sample; rollout consistency is used to categorize residual errors. Persistently failed samples are addressed with stronger supervised correction (hard-case SFT). Preference-unstable samples are handled via contrastive preference learning (hard-case DPO) over correct vs incorrect rollouts, aiming to reduce decision instability near boundaries.
Overall, reasoning is treated as a training signal and a hard-case mining tool, not as a deployment-time output.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported numbers under reasoning-free inference:
- 10 prompt-side benchmarks: average F1 = 0.886 vs Qwen3Guard-8B at 0.852 (+3.4).
- 7 response-side benchmarks: average F1 = 0.870.
- With a 4B backbone, DT-Guard reports a dual-side average F1 = 0.878, outperforming strong 8B guardrail baselines.
The most decision-relevant evidence (to verify the claimed intent/borderline robustness) would be: per-benchmark breakdowns, explicit hard-case subsets, and ablations isolating the staged structure vs RG-PHO components, plus any latency/throughput measurements.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–40 minutes):
- Start with the method overview/figure to understand the training-vs-inference interface and the Intent→Category→Safety decomposition.
- Focus on RG-PHO details: how multi-rollout consistency is computed, how samples are split into persistent-failure vs preference-instability, and the exact SFT/DPO objectives and sampling.
- Check the data construction section for taxonomy alignment, intent labeling reliability, and the distillation/voting/expert workflow—these largely determine reproducibility.
- In experiments, prioritize results on borderline/adversarial/implicit-intent cases and any quantified latency comparison against reasoning-based guards.

recommendation.zh: 将 CoT 思想用于训练阶段作为监督信号，而在推理阶段退化为分类器以保证低延迟，这种 'train with reasoning, infer without' 的思路在工业界安全场景很实用，值得一看其数据构造和 loss 设计。
recommendation.en: Using CoT as a supervision signal during training while degrading to a classifier during inference for low latency. This 'train with reasoning, infer without' approach is highly practical for industrial safety scenarios; worth checking its data construction and loss design.

paper.title: kNNGuard: Turning LLM Hidden Activations into a Training-Free Configurable Guardrail
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in domains requiring guardrails to detect unsafe, off-topic, or adversarial prompts. Existing guardrails predominately rely on fine-tuning to build classifiers, which often suffer from low generalization and high inference latency. We present kNNGuard, a training-free guardrail that utilizes the activation space of an off-the-shelf LLM. Given a small bank of 50 safe and unsafe prompts, kNNGuard extracts hidden activations and performs multi-

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM 护栏方法主要依赖微调构建分类器，存在泛化性差和推理延迟高的问题。
summary.importance: 提出了一种无需训练的护栏方案，属于安全对齐领域的方法改进。
summary.technical_approach: kNNGuard 利用现成 LLM 的激活空间，仅需少量（50个）标注提示词提取隐藏激活，通过多层 kNN 融合激活空间和嵌入空间分数进行分类，无需梯度更新或微调。
summary.experiments: 在六个主题和安全提示领域上，F1 值达到或优于微调 SOTA 护栏，推理速度比最佳可比护栏快 2.7 倍，比微调安全分类器快 10 倍；域适应仅需更新标注库，可在 10 秒内构建。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自兰卡斯特大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM guardrails rely heavily on fine-tuned classifiers, which suffer from low generalization and high inference latency.
summary_en.importance: Presents a training-free guardrail approach, a methodological improvement in safety alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: kNNGuard leverages the activation space of an off-the-shelf LLM, extracts hidden activations from a small bank of 50 labeled prompts, and performs multi-layer kNN classification fusing activation-space and embedding-space scores, requiring no fine-tuning or gradient updates.
summary_en.experiments: Across six topical and security domains, achieves competitive or superior F1 compared to fine-tuned state-of-the-art guardrails while running 2.7x faster than the best comparable guardrail and 10x faster than a fine-tuned safety classifier.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Lancaster University and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: 免训练护栏的工程思路对快速部署有参考价值，但技术深度有限，对预训练研究无直接启发。
recommendation.en: Training-free guardrail engineering is useful for deployment but offers limited insight for pretraining research.

paper.title: Breaking Safety at the Token Boundary: How BPE Tokenization Creates Exploitable Gaps in LLM Alignment
paper.abstract: Character-level perturbations bypass safety alignment in modern LLMs despite leaving prompts human-readable. We identify and test a central structural mechanism: BPE tokenization fragments safety-critical words into sub-word pieces, and the three public alignment datasets we surveyed contain no intentionally fragmented inputs. The mechanism is a chain, tested end-to-end on five model families (Qwen-3-4B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Gemma-3-4B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B). An optimization targeting safety-token f

summary.core_problem: 论文研究一个很具体但影响很大的接口问题：安全对齐通常在干净文本上训练，而 BPE tokenizer 会把轻微字符扰动后的安全敏感词切成不熟悉的子词片段。模型仍能理解这些请求，但拒答机制没有在这类 token 边界形态上学到稳定触发。
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练和对齐接口有直接价值。它把字符级 jailbreak 从经验现象推进到可检验机制：tokenization 改变输入表示，破坏首 token 拒答信号，干扰后层拒答通路，最后转化为一部分有害输出。贡献不在提出更强攻击，而在建立了从 tokenizer、alignment data 覆盖、activation pathway 到行为结果的测量链条。对基座研究的启发是：tokenizer 不是中性预处理；预训练阶段学到的鲁棒理解能力，如果没有在 post-training 数据中覆盖相应形式，会留下理解与拒答之间的不匹配。
summary.technical_approach: 作者围绕 BPE fragmentation 构造了一条端到端机制链。第一步，用 space insertion 作为干净探针，因为插入空格保留原字符，但会强制改变 BPE 切分。攻击不是随机扰动，而是贪心选择能最大降低 safety logit gap 的插入位置。第二步，用首生成位置的 logit gap 测量拒答触发：拒答 token 集合包括 I、Sorry、As、No、Unfortunately、cannot，服从 token 集合包括 Sure、Okay、Here、Step；正 gap 表示拒答倾向。这个指标被明确限定为 first-token refusal trigger，不等同于完整安全行为。第三步，把 gap collapse 与真实输出行为分开统计，避免把触发信号翻转直接当作 jailbreak 成功。第四步，用 activation patching 定位被破坏的拒答信号，发现主要集中在最后约 30% 层。第五步，检查三个公开 alignment datasets，发现没有 intentionally fragmented inputs，并通过 targeted mutation 把问题定位到 safety-critical words，而不是任意字符噪声。最后测试常见防御训练：DPO 网格和 SFT 增强都没有给出干净的选择性修复，SFT 在部分模型上降低 ASR，但同时提高 benign prompt 上的过度拒答。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五个模型家族：Qwen-3-4B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Gemma-3-4B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B，并提供 Qwen-2.5-72B 的跨规模支持。针对 HarmBench 中原本会被拒答的提示，面向 safety-token fragmentation 的优化能在 80–100% 的样本上翻转首 token 拒答触发；其中 48% 的触发翻转进一步产生真实有害输出，各模型范围为 29–65%。gap 与行为之间的 ROC-AUC 为 0.66–0.98，合并后为 0.84，说明 logit gap 是有信息量但不充分的代理指标。Unicode-no-split 控制实验的效果弱 2.2 倍，支持问题来自 BPE 切分变化而不只是视觉扰动。Activation patching 把被扰动的拒答信号定位到最后约 30% 层。数据审计发现三个 alignment datasets 中没有故意碎片化输入。防御部分做了 68 个 DPO 配置，没有一个在不同 seed 下稳定关闭 ASR；Mistral 在 438 对训练样本上的 4-seed 复训仍有 20–37% 的 seed spread。SFT augmentation 在 3/5 个模型家族上降低 ASR，但代价是 benign prompts 上拒答也上升，作者用 Conv-Benign 作为候选诊断来暴露这个副作用。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Background 中 BPE 与 logit gap 的定义，因为后续所有实验都依赖这个测量是否可信。然后读 Section 3，重点关注 space insertion 优化、trigger flip 与 harmful behavior 的分离统计，以及 ROC-AUC。Section 4 的 activation patching 是机制证据的核心，需要看具体 patch 的层位置和是否跨模型一致。Section 5 的 alignment data 审计很关键，它解释了为什么预训练能理解扰动文本而对齐不能稳定拒答。Section 6 值得仔细看防御失败模式，尤其是 DPO 的 seed instability 和 SFT 的 over-refusal trade-off。附录 A 的贪心算法和实验设置也建议看，便于判断攻击是否依赖过强的搜索预算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but important interface failure: safety alignment is trained mostly on clean text, while BPE tokenization can fragment safety-critical words after small character-level perturbations. The model can still understand the harmful request, but the refusal mechanism no longer fires reliably at the token boundary.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is significant for the tokenizer–pretraining–posttraining interface. The paper does not merely show another character-level jailbreak. It builds a measurable causal chain: BPE fragmentation changes the input representation, collapses the first-token refusal signal, disrupts late-layer refusal pathways, and sometimes turns into harmful behavior. The lesson for foundation-model training is that tokenization is not a neutral preprocessing detail. Pretraining may teach robust comprehension of noisy text, while alignment data may fail to cover the same surface forms, creating a gap between understanding and refusal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors construct an end-to-end mechanism around BPE fragmentation. Space insertion is used as a clean probe because it preserves all original characters while forcing BPE segmentation changes. The perturbation is optimized greedily to reduce a safety logit gap, rather than sampled randomly. The gap is measured at the first generated position: refusal tokens include I, Sorry, As, No, Unfortunately, and cannot, while compliance tokens include Sure, Okay, Here, and Step. A positive gap indicates a refusal tendency. The authors are careful to treat this as a first-token refusal trigger, not as a full behavioral safety metric. They then separate trigger flips from actual harmful generations. Activation patching is used to localize the disrupted signal, which appears mainly in the last roughly 30% of layers. A data audit of three public alignment datasets finds no intentionally fragmented inputs. Targeted mutation further isolates safety-critical words as the main locus of disruption. The defense study evaluates DPO and SFT-style augmentation and shows that neither gives a clean selective fix across model families.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments cover five model families: Qwen-3-4B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Gemma-3-4B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Mistral-7B, with additional cross-scale evidence from Qwen-2.5-72B. On refused HarmBench prompts, an optimization targeting safety-token fragmentation flips the first-token refusal trigger in 80–100% of cases. Among those trigger flips, 48% produce genuinely harmful outputs, with per-model rates from 29% to 65%. The gap-behavior ROC-AUC ranges from 0.66 to 0.98, with a pooled value of 0.84, indicating that the logit gap is informative but not sufficient. A Unicode no-split control is 2.2 times weaker, supporting the claim that the effect is tied to BPE segmentation rather than visual noise alone. Activation patching localizes the disrupted refusal signal to the last about 30% of layers. The alignment-data survey finds zero intentionally fragmented inputs in three datasets. In the defense experiments, no configuration in a 68-cell DPO grid closes ASR in a seed-stable way; a four-seed Mistral retraining run with 438 pairs still shows a 20–37% seed spread. SFT augmentation reduces ASR for 3 of 5 families, but it also increases refusal on benign prompts, which the authors expose with a Conv-Benign diagnostic.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read closely. Start with the definitions of BPE fragmentation and the first-token logit gap, since the credibility of the later results depends on this measurement. Then focus on Section 3: the space-insertion optimization, the separation between trigger flips and harmful behavior, and the ROC-AUC analysis. Section 4 is the main mechanistic section; inspect the activation-patching layer positions and whether the pattern is consistent across model families. Section 5 matters for training data: it explains why robust comprehension from pretraining does not imply robust refusal after alignment. Section 6 is useful for post-training design, especially the DPO seed instability and the SFT over-refusal trade-off. Appendix A is worth checking to understand the greedy search budget and reproducibility details.

recommendation.zh: 会改变“tokenizer 只是工程细节”的 prior；应立刻把 fragmented safety strings 加进安全数据和 tokenizer ablation。
recommendation.en: This changes the prior that tokenization is a harmless implementation detail; add fragmented safety strings to safety data and tokenizer ablations now.

paper.title: Fast Multi-dimensional Refusal Subspaces via RFM-AGOP
paper.abstract: Steering and monitoring activations in Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for both safety and interpretability. Early work assumed behaviours are encoded along single linear directions, but recent findings suggest complex behaviours, such as the refusal to answer harmful queries, live in multi-dimensional subspaces. However, existing methods for extracting these subspaces are computationally expensive, which becomes prohibitive on reasoning models who produce long reasoning trace

summary.core_problem: 提取LLM中控制有害query拒绝行为的多维子空间时，现有方法计算成本过高，在生成长度可达数千token的推理模型上实用性差；此前基于RFM-AGOP的拒绝分析仅使用top-1特征向量，单一线性方向不足以刻画大模型中拒绝行为的多维结构。
summary.importance: 给出了秒级速度的多维拒绝子空间提取方案，可用于表征工程、模型安全干预、对齐机制分析，尤其适用于长思维链模型上的安全表征研究，无需运行昂贵的梯度优化过程即可快速定位子空间开展消融或干预实验。属于实用工具类贡献，对基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 对RFM-AGOP框架做两处稳定性改进，适配多维子空间提取任务。第一，将原框架的单位矩阵初始化替换为探针引导初始化：先训练简单线性探针区分有害/无害query的激活，用探针权重向量加激活的秩k截断协方差构造初始特征矩阵，解决原方法对超参数敏感、早期迭代容易偏离主方向的问题。第二，在AGOP矩阵迭代更新时加入指数移动平均，降低更新噪声。收敛后取最终特征矩阵的top-k特征向量张成拒绝子空间，全程不需要梯度优化。方法采用马哈拉诺比斯拉普拉斯核，迭代执行核岭回归与AGOP更新。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen2.5（非推理模型）和Qwen3（推理模型，最长思维链达8000 token）上开展实验，子空间提取耗时仅数秒，速度显著高于此前的拒绝锥优化（RCO）方法。实验验证单一线性方向确实无法完整刻画拒绝行为：多维子空间在两类操作上效果更好，一是将激活投影到子空间正交补以消除拒绝行为，二是沿基向量方向缩放以引导模型拒绝或回答有害query。正文未报告具体的拒绝率、能力保留数值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注方法部分的两处改动（探针初始化、EMA更新）和实验中关于多维子空间必要性的对比，预计阅读时间15分钟。无需深究RFM的理论推导，了解该工具可快速提取多维行为子空间即可；如需复现，再查阅附录中数据集构建、层选择的细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自Télécom SudParis、ENS Paris-Saclay，工作发表于ICML 2026机制可解释性研讨会。

summary_en.core_problem: Extracting the multi-dimensional refusal subspace — internal representations that govern LLM refusal of harmful queries — is computationally expensive with existing methods, making the process impractical for reasoning models that produce reasoning traces thousands of tokens long. Prior RFM-AGOP work on refusal analysis only uses the top-1 eigenvector, and a single linear direction cannot fully capture refusal structure in larger models.
summary_en.importance: The method extracts multi-dimensional refusal subspaces in seconds, making it usable for representation engineering, safety intervention, and alignment mechanism analysis — especially for safety studies on long-CoT reasoning models, as it eliminates the need for expensive gradient-based optimization to locate subspaces for ablation or steering. It is a practical tooling contribution, with limited direct relevance to base model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two stability modifications are made to the RFM-AGOP framework to support multi-dimensional subspace extraction. First, the original identity matrix initialization is replaced with a probe-informed starting point: a simple linear probe is trained to separate activations from harmful and harmless queries, and the initial feature matrix is constructed from the probe weight vector plus the rank-k truncated covariance of activations. This fixes the original RFM’s sensitivity to hyperparameters and tendency to diverge from the primary direction in early iterations. Second, exponential moving average is applied to AGOP matrix updates to reduce iteration noise. After convergence, the top-k eigenvectors of the final feature matrix span the refusal subspace; no gradient optimization is required through the whole process. The method uses a Mahalanobis Laplace kernel, and iterates between kernel ridge regression and AGOP updates.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations are run on Qwen 2.5 (non-reasoning) and Qwen 3 (reasoning model, with CoT up to 8000 tokens). Subspace extraction takes only seconds, substantially faster than prior Refusal Cone Optimization (RCO). Results confirm a single linear direction cannot fully model refusal behavior: the multi-dimensional subspace performs better on both standard operations — projecting activations to the orthogonal complement of the subspace to remove refusal, and scaling along basis vectors to steer the model toward refusal or compliance. Exact refusal rate and capability retention numbers are not reported in the main text.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the two core method modifications (probe initialization, EMA update) and the empirical comparison supporting the need for multi-dimensional subspaces; expect around 15 minutes of reading. There is no need to dig into RFM theoretical derivations unless implementing the method — it is sufficient to know this tool can rapidly extract multi-dimensional behavioral subspaces. Refer to appendices for dataset construction and layer selection details only for reproduction.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are affiliated with Télécom SudParis and ENS Paris-Saclay. The work appears at the ICML 2026 Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop.

recommendation.zh: 快速提取拒绝子空间的方法创新，适合推理模型的激活分析，仅需看方法和实验部分即可。
recommendation.en: Innovative method for fast refusal subspace extraction suitable for reasoning models, just read the method and experiment sections.

paper.title: Beyond the Prompt: Jailbreaking Function-Calling LLMs via Simulated Moderation Traces
paper.abstract: Jailbreak attacks remain a critical threat to the safe deployment of large language models (LLMs). While prior work has primarily studied attacks and defenses at the prompt level, we show that this prompt-centric paradigm overlooks a structural vulnerability in stateful, function-calling environments. In such applications, developer-defined schemas, structured arguments, and untrusted tool outputs are interleaved into a single shared model context. This architecture expands the attack surface by

summary.core_problem: 现有越狱研究大多聚焦prompt层面的攻击向量，忽略了有状态函数调用LLM系统的架构级攻击面——这类系统中，可信控制面（系统策略、函数schema、验证逻辑）与不可信数据面（用户参数、工具输出）在上下文窗口中混布，信任边界模糊。尤其是函数调用轨迹的累积状态、系统原生的错误处理与重试反馈回路被武器化的风险，尚未得到系统研究。
summary.importance: 该工作揭示了LLM安全对齐的结构性盲区：当前的安全SFT、RLHF等对齐流程主要针对纯文本prompt交互设计，没有考虑模型在工具增强场景下同时承担执行控制器和安全执行者双重角色时的状态混淆风险。对后续工具调用对齐训练、安全RLHF的场景覆盖扩展、上下文信任域区分建模有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SMT（Simulated Moderation Traces，模拟审核轨迹）黑盒越狱框架。与现有基于prompt修改的攻击不同，SMT将攻击面转移到工具工作流的累积状态。它构造多轮攻击流程：用对抗性案例生成器和伪装成内容审核pipeline的验证器，向目标LLM输入伪造的回溯信息，把模型自身的安全拒绝重新包装为格式验证错误，诱导模型在原生重试循环中逐步输出有害内容。核心思路是将恶意意图拆分到schema、参数、工具反馈、交互历史等多个位置，利用共享上下文中的信任边界模糊实现攻击。
summary.experiments: 当前可获取的内容片段未包含完整实验数据。该框架为黑盒攻击，无需访问模型权重或内部状态，设计目标是优于prompt级越狱方法与已有函数调用攻击基线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时重点关注引言部分对函数调用LLM系统架构漏洞的分析（控制面/数据面混布部分）。若有完整文本，可继续看方法章节的攻击流程设计（对应图1）与实验章节的攻击成功率基线对比，预计完整泛读时间20分钟左右。

summary_en.core_problem: Most existing jailbreak research focuses on prompt-level attack vectors, and overlooks the architectural attack surface of stateful function-calling LLM systems. In these systems, trusted control-plane components (system policies, function schemas, validation logic) and untrusted data-plane inputs (user arguments, tool outputs) are interleaved in the context window, blurring trust boundaries. In particular, the risk of weaponizing accumulated function-call trajectory state, native error handling, and retry feedback loops has not been systematically studied.
summary_en.importance: The work reveals a structural blind spot in LLM safety alignment: current alignment pipelines such as safety SFT and RLHF are mostly designed for plain-text prompt interactions, and do not account for state confusion when the model acts as both execution controller and safety enforcer in tool-augmented environments. It provides reference for improving tool-use alignment training, expanding scenario coverage of safety RLHF, and modeling trust domain separation in context.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work proposes SMT (Simulated Moderation Traces), a black-box jailbreak framework. Unlike prior prompt-based attacks that modify input wording or structure, SMT shifts the attack surface to the accumulated state of tool-mediated workflows. It constructs a multi-turn attack pipeline with an adversarial case generator and a validator disguised as a content moderation pipeline. It feeds the target LLM fabricated backtraces that reframe the model's own safety refusals as format validation errors, inducing the model to gradually produce harmful content within the native retry loop. The core idea is to fragment adversarial intent across schemas, arguments, tool feedback, and interaction history, exploiting the blurred trust boundary in shared context.
summary_en.experiments: The available content snippet does not include full experimental data. The framework is a black-box attack that requires no access to model weights or internal states, and is designed to outperform both prompt-level jailbreaks and existing function-call attack baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the introduction section's analysis of architectural vulnerabilities in function-calling LLM systems (the control plane / data plane interleaving part). If full text is available, proceed to the method section's attack flow design (corresponding to Figure 1) and the experiment section's attack success rate comparisons against baselines. Estimated total skimming time: around 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: skim 实验表和攻击轨迹即可；它修正了“安全主要靠 prompt 过滤”的 prior，对 tool-use 训练数据设计有用。
recommendation.en: Skim the attack traces and result tables; it weakens the prior that prompt filtering is the main safety boundary for tool-using LLMs.

paper.title: Robust Text Watermarking for Large Language Models via Dual Semantic Embeddings
paper.abstract: This work presents Dual-Embedding Watermarking (DEW), a semantic watermarking scheme for large language models (LLMs) that leverages contextual and token-level embeddings to enhance robustness against paraphrasing and translation. DEW utilizes a signal-processing methodology, applying algebraic vector-space operations to \mbox{token and context embeddings to derive a watermark signal that degrades gracefully under semantic shifts. The method obfuscates the watermark by projecting embedding vecto

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 文本水印在改写和翻译后容易失效的问题，目标是在保持文本质量的同时提高语义级可检测性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是安全与溯源方法创新。它不直接改进预训练，但对模型输出 provenance、合成数据检测、后训练安全策略有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Dual-Embedding Watermarking，将上下文级 embedding 和 token 级 embedding 共同用于构造水印信号。方法使用代数向量空间操作生成语义稳定信号，并通过由密钥种子控制的伪随机矩阵投影来混淆水印；检测侧基于这些向量分布做统计检验。
summary.experiments: 在多个 LLM 上测试水印检测、文本质量、改写后检测和翻译后检测。摘要称 DEW 在改写后检测上优于既有语义水印，并且在翻译后仍保持可检测性；未给出具体模型规模、数据规模或完整提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the fragility of LLM text watermarks under paraphrasing and translation while trying to preserve output quality.
summary_en.importance: This is a safety and provenance method contribution. It does not advance pretraining directly, but it is relevant to output attribution, synthetic-text tracing, and post-training safety infrastructure.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Dual-Embedding Watermarking, which combines contextual embeddings and token-level embeddings to derive a semantically stable watermark signal. The signal is built with algebraic vector-space operations and obfuscated through pseudo-random matrix projections seeded by a secret key; detection relies on statistical tests over the resulting distributions.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated across multiple LLMs for detectability, text quality, robustness after paraphrasing, and robustness after translation. The abstract reports improved post-paraphrase detection and continued detectability after translation compared with prior semantic watermarking methods, but does not provide model sizes, data sizes, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 可作为水印鲁棒性备查；预训练研究员只需看检测统计假设，别把改写鲁棒性外推到数据污染检测。
recommendation.en: Useful as watermarking background; read the statistical testing assumptions, but do not over-read paraphrase robustness as evidence for pretraining-data contamination detection.

paper.title: Position: The Term "Machine Unlearning" Is Overused in LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models increasingly face demands to "forget" training data, knowledge, or behaviors due to regulatory deletion obligations, copyright/licensing disputes, and safety or product-policy requirements. This position paper argues that machine unlearning is overused as a term in LLM research and should be reserved for dataset-defined deletion: removing the training influence of a precisely specified forget set such that the resulting model is approximately indistinguishable from retraini

summary.core_problem: 讨论 LLM 研究中“machine unlearning”一词被过度使用的问题，并主张将其限定为有明确 forget set 的训练影响删除。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是概念澄清和评估规范建议。它对数据删除、版权合规、安全拒答、模型编辑等目标做边界划分，避免不同保证被同一个术语混在一起。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出术语层面的判据：真正的 unlearning 应该是 dataset-defined deletion，即移除指定训练样本的影响，并使结果模型近似等价于不含该数据重训得到的模型。作者将 refusal、knowledge removal、targeted suppression 等任务建议改称 alignment、suppression、editing 或 obfuscation。
summary.experiments: 这是 position paper，摘要未说明有新的模型训练实验或大规模 benchmark。主要证据来自对现有 LLM unlearning 论文中目标、baseline、metric 和隐含保证不一致的分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that the term machine unlearning is overused in LLM research and should be reserved for deletion of a precisely specified training forget set.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is conceptual and methodological. It separates dataset deletion from safety refusal, entity suppression, knowledge editing, and policy-driven behavior changes, which otherwise imply different guarantees under the same label.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed criterion is dataset-defined deletion: removing the training influence of a specified forget set so that the resulting model is approximately indistinguishable from retraining without that data. Other objectives are reframed as alignment, suppression, editing, or obfuscation.
summary_en.experiments: This is a position paper rather than an experimental training paper. The argument is built around inconsistencies in objectives, baselines, metrics, and guarantees across papers labeled as LLM unlearning.

recommendation.zh: 术语洁癖但有用；做数据删除或版权合规评估时可引用，训练方法本身学不到太多。
recommendation.en: Terminology-heavy but useful; cite it when discussing data deletion or copyright guarantees, but do not expect new training methodology.

paper.title: When Helpfulness Overrides Causal Caution: Context-Dependent Suppression and Recovery in LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into decision-support roles in business and policy contexts. While prior benchmark studies have primarily evaluated LLMs' causal reasoning capabilities, a more fundamental epistemic dimension has been overlooked: Causal Caution, defined as the propensity to refrain from causal judgment when empirical evidence is insufficient. This study examines the systematic suppression of Causal Caution that occurs when LLMs shift from academic to pract

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 在证据不足时是否会保持因果判断克制，以及这种克制是否会被实用咨询语境压低。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是行为分析和安全评估。它关注的不是模型是否能做因果推理，而是模型在不应给因果结论时是否会拒绝过度推断，这与对齐、幻觉和决策支持风险有关。
summary.technical_approach: 定义 Causal Caution，并用受 Pearl Causal Hierarchy 启发的 PCH score 评估模型回答；比较 academic context 与 practical advisory context 下的行为变化，并用统计检验验证差异。
summary.experiments: 在 Claude Sonnet 4.6、Claude Opus 4.7、GPT 5.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro 上进行 480 次试验。摘要报告 academic context 下 Causal Caution 维持率为 91.7% 到 100.0%，practical advisory context 下跌至 6.7% 到 18.3%，Fisher 精确检验 p < .001。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs refrain from causal claims when evidence is insufficient, and whether that restraint collapses in practical advisory settings.
summary_en.importance: This is a behavioral and safety analysis rather than a pretraining method paper. It targets a useful distinction: causal reasoning competence is not the same as epistemic caution under user pressure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author defines Causal Caution and scores answers with a rubric inspired by Pearl's Causal Hierarchy. The study contrasts academic prompts with practical advisory prompts and tests the context effect statistically.
summary_en.experiments: Across 480 trials on Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT 5.5, and Gemini 3.1 Pro, Causal Caution maintenance is reported at 91.7–100.0% in academic contexts but only 6.7–18.3% in practical advisory contexts, with Fisher's exact test p < .001.

recommendation.zh: 作为安全行为现象留档即可；setup 偏 prompt study，结论可能脆弱，但 91% 到 7% 的语境翻转值得记住。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a safety-behavior note; the setup is prompt-study fragile, but the 91% to 7% context flip is a useful warning signal.

paper.title: SafeSpec: Fast and Safe LLM via Dynamic Reflective Sampling
paper.abstract: Speculative inference accelerates large language model (LLM) decoding but provides no inherent safety guarantees. Existing safety defenses are largely incompatible with speculative inference: they either introduce additional computation or disrupt the draft-verify mechanism, negating acceleration benefits. This reveals a fundamental incompatibility between current safety methods and speculative decoding. We propose SafeSpec, a safety-aware speculative inference framework that integrates risk est

summary.core_problem: 现有推测解码与LLM安全防御机制不兼容，安全方案要么引入额外计算要么破坏草稿-验证机制，完全抵消加速收益。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出安全感知的推测推理框架，解决推测解码加速与内容安全的兼容性问题。
summary.technical_approach: 给目标模型附加轻量潜在安全头，单次前向同时评估语义有效性与安全性；检测到不安全内容时执行回滚，采用安全引导的反射多采样恢复安全续接而非终止生成；将越狱攻击建模为生成轨迹上的分布偏移。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验细节，未给出具体模型参数量、基准对比与加速/安全指标的量化结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing speculative decoding is fundamentally incompatible with LLM safety defenses, which either add extra compute overhead or break the draft-verify mechanism and negate speedup gains.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation introducing the first safety-aware speculative inference framework to resolve the conflict between decoding acceleration and content safety guarantees.
summary_en.technical_approach: Attaches a lightweight latent safety head to the target model for joint semantic validity and safety evaluation in one forward pass; performs rollback and safety-guided reflective multi-sampling to recover safe continuations instead of terminating generation; models jailbreak attacks as distributional shifts over generative trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details are not fully disclosed in the truncated abstract; no specific model sizes, baselines, or quantitative speedup/safety metrics are provided.

recommendation.zh: 推测解码与安全对齐交叉方向的工程实现参考，仅对做推理侧安全的研究员有用，无预训练直接启示。
recommendation.en: Engineering reference for the intersection of speculative decoding and safety; only useful for inference-side safety work, no direct pretraining insights.

paper.title: Deontic Policies for Runtime Governance of Agentic AI Systems
paper.abstract: Autonomous agentic AI systems driven by Large Language Models (LLMs) introduce a new class of security, privacy, and compliance challenges: an agent that can invoke tools, manipulate data, install software, and coordinate with peer agents across organizational boundaries must be constrained not just by authentication and access control, but by the full structure of enterprise governance. This includes specifying what agents are permitted and prohibited from doing, what they areobliged to do afte

summary.core_problem: 现有策略引擎（XACML/Rego/Cedar）仅支持访问控制的许可/禁止规则，无法覆盖LLM驱动的自主Agent系统所需的完整企业级治理要求（义务生命周期、冲突解决、豁免等）。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将完整道义逻辑范式引入LLM Agent运行时治理，填补了现有策略引擎的能力空白。
summary.technical_approach: 基于道义逻辑设计支持许可、禁止、义务、豁免的策略表达，配套义务生命周期管理、元政策冲突优先级排序、跨组织规则语义对齐机制，形成完整的Agent运行时治理框架。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体测试场景、基线系统与量化性能指标。
summary.authors_note: Anupam Joshi、Tim Finin为美国马里兰大学巴尔的摩分校（UMBC）教授，是语义Web、数据安全与AI治理领域的知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing policy engines (XACML/Rego/Cedar) only support permit/prohibit rules for access control, and cannot meet the full enterprise governance requirements of LLM-driven autonomous agents (obligation lifecycle management, conflict resolution, dispensations, etc.).
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, introducing the full deontic logic paradigm to LLM agent runtime governance for the first time, filling capability gaps in existing policy engines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs a policy framework based on deontic logic supporting permit, prohibit, obligation, and dispensation constructs, paired with obligation lifecycle management, meta-policy conflict prioritization, and cross-organizational rule semantic alignment mechanisms for complete agent runtime governance.
summary_en.experiments: Specific test scenarios, baseline systems and quantitative metrics are not disclosed in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Anupam Joshi and Tim Finin are professors at the University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC), well-known researchers in semantic web, data security and AI governance.

recommendation.zh: Agent安全治理的框架性工作，仅需了解其相对传统策略引擎的三类扩展能力（义务/豁免/冲突解决），无需精读正文。
recommendation.en: Framework work on agent safety governance; only review its three extensions over traditional policy engines (obligation/dispensation/conflict resolution), no need for deep reading.

paper.title: Evaluating Prompting-Based Defenses Against Domain-Camouflaged Injection Attacks
paper.abstract: Domain-camouflaged injection attacks embed malicious instructions in retrieved content using domain-appropriate vocabulary, evading standard detectors that rely on syntactic injection markers. When detection fails, practitioners need to know which defense architectures reduce attack success. We evaluate five prompting-based defenses (spotlighting, paraphrasing, prompt sandwiching, and two combinations) against domain-camouflaged injection across three model families (Claude Haiku, Llama 3.1 8B,

summary.core_problem: 解决域伪装prompt注入攻击（恶意指令嵌入域相关词汇绕过句法检测器）缺乏系统防御效果评估的问题。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献+评测分析，构建了跨3模型家族、3部署域的3510条测试样本集，系统评估5种基于提示的防御方法的实际效果。
summary.technical_approach: 构造金融、法律、通用三类域的伪装注入攻击样本，评估spotlighting、paraphrasing、prompt sandwiching及两种组合防御的效果，同时对比Llama Guard 4配置的检测性能。
summary.experiments: 在Claude Haiku、Llama 3.1 8B、Gemini 2.0 Flash三个模型上开展3510次试验：paraphrasing是最稳定的防御方法，可将攻击成功率降低55-84%，且在所有模型上优于测试的Llama Guard 4配置；防御效果高度依赖模型，spotlighting仅在Claude Haiku上可降低一半攻击成功率，其余模型上无显著效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the lack of systematic evaluation of prompting-based defenses against domain-camouflaged prompt injection attacks, which embed malicious instructions in domain-specific vocabulary to evade syntactic detectors.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution + evaluation analysis; builds a test set of 3,510 trials across 3 model families and 3 deployment domains, systematically evaluates 5 prompting-based defense methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs domain-camouflaged injection samples across financial, legal, and general domains, evaluates 5 defenses (spotlighting, paraphrasing, prompt sandwiching, and two combined variants), and compares performance against a configured Llama Guard 4 detector.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted 3,510 trials on Claude Haiku, Llama 3.1 8B, and Gemini 2.0 Flash: Paraphrasing is the most consistently effective defense, reducing attack success rate by 55-84% and outperforming the tested Llama Guard 4 setup on all models; Defense effectiveness is highly model-dependent, with spotlighting only halving attack success on Claude Haiku and showing no significant effect on other models.

recommendation.zh: 纯LLM安全评测工作，与基座预训练无直接关联，仅作为对齐防御方向的背景文献备查，无需阅读正文。
recommendation.en: Pure LLM security evaluation work with no direct relevance to foundation pretraining; only for reference as alignment defense background, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: AnchorKV: Safety-Aware KV Cache Compression via Soft Penalty with a Refusal Anchor
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) outperform earlier architectures on generative inference and long-context tasks, but their large size introduces significant challenges in memory usage, energy cost, and on-device deployment. Since scaling pre-trained language models improves downstream capability \cite{zhao2023survey}, the key-value (KV) cache becomes a dominant inference bottleneck. Recent KV cache compression methods \cite{jo2025fastkv,li2024snapkv,zhou2024dynamickv} reduce this cost by retaining

summary.core_problem: 现有KV缓存压缩方法在激进驱逐策略下会破坏LLM的安全对齐能力，无法防御越狱攻击，缺乏兼顾推理效率与安全属性的KV压缩方案。
summary.importance: 工程创新类贡献，首次提出安全感知的KV缓存压缩范式，解决KV压缩率与安全对齐性能的冲突问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出AnchorKV方法，离线构造与有害提示对应的拒绝锚点向量，在现有KV压缩的token保留评分中加入软惩罚项，偏向保留与安全拒绝相关的key方向，为现有KV压缩方法的即插即用修改。
summary.experiments: 在多个开源LLM上测试，对比FastKV、SnapKV等基线方法，在保持相近压缩率与良性任务精度的同时，显著提升多种越狱攻击的防御成功率。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV cache compression methods break LLM safety alignment under aggressive eviction policies and fail to defend against jailbreak attacks, lacking a KV compression scheme that balances inference efficiency and safety.
summary_en.importance: Engineering innovation contribution; first safety-aware KV cache compression paradigm that resolves the tradeoff between compression ratio and safety alignment performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes AnchorKV, a drop-in modification for existing KV compression methods: constructs an offline refusal anchor aligned with harmful prompts, adds a soft penalty to token retention scores to preserve key directions associated with safe refusal.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple open-source LLMs; compared to baselines like FastKV and SnapKV, it maintains similar compression ratio and benign task accuracy while significantly improving defense success rate against various jailbreak attacks.

recommendation.zh: 推理侧KV压缩的安全增强工作，与预训练方法论关联弱，仅需知道该方向存在，无需深入正文。
recommendation.en: Safety enhancement for inference-side KV cache compression; weak relevance to pretraining methodology, only need to be aware of this direction, no deep reading required.

paper.title: A Red-Team Study of Anthropic Fable 5 & Opus 4.8 Models
paper.abstract: We evaluate the adversarial robustness of two frontier large language models (LLMs) developed by Anthropic, Fable 5 and Opus 4.8, against four families of automated jailbreak attack across 7 826 harmful intents spanning a ten-category harm taxonomy. Using the HackAgent red-teaming framework, hundreds of thousands of adversarial attempts were generated and every apparent success was independently re-adjudicated by a panel of three judge models (majority vote). Both models resist the majority of a

summary.core_problem: 前沿LLM的对抗越狱鲁棒性需要在大规模、多类型攻击下严格评估，单法官裁定的初步结果存在高假阳性，聚合成功率指标易误导对模型安全性的判断。
summary.importance: 对Anthropic两款最新前沿模型（Fable 5、Opus 4.8）开展大规模自动化红队测试，采用三法官重判机制降低假阳性，明确了自适应迭代攻击是当前对齐模型的主要残留风险。
summary.technical_approach: 使用HackAgent红队框架生成数十万次对抗尝试，覆盖7826个有害意图、10类危害分类、4类攻击家族；对所有初步判定为攻击成功的案例，采用3个法官模型多数投票独立重判以减少假阳性。
summary.experiments: 两款模型可防御绝大多数攻击，静态混淆攻击接近完全失效；最强自适应树攻击对Opus 4.8总体成功率为11.5%，对Fable 5最坏情况为6.1%；两款模型分别产生1620个（Opus 4.8）和702个（Fable 5）经评委确认的有害输出（摘要截断）。

summary_en.core_problem: Adversarial robustness of frontier LLMs requires rigorous large-scale evaluation across diverse attack types; single-judge adjudication produces high false positives, and aggregate success rate metrics mislead safety assessments.
summary_en.importance: Conducts a large-scale automated red-team study of two unreleased Anthropic frontier models (Fable 5, Opus 4.8) with a 3-judge re-adjudication pipeline to reduce false positives, identifying adaptive iterative attacks as the primary residual risk.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses the HackAgent framework to generate hundreds of thousands of adversarial attempts across 7,826 harmful intents spanning 10 harm categories and 4 attack families; all apparent successes are re-adjudicated by a 3-judge panel via majority vote.
summary_en.experiments: Both models block most attacks, with static obfuscation nearly fully neutralized; the strongest adaptive tree-of-attacks achieves 11.5% overall success on Opus 4.8 and 6.1% worst-case success on Fable 5; the models produce 1,620 (Opus 4.8) and 702 (Fable 5) panel-confirmed harmful outputs (abstract truncated).

recommendation.zh: 仅报告Anthropic未发布模型的红队实测结果，无新方法或机制分析，作为前沿对齐现状的弱信号了解即可，无需读全文。
recommendation.en: Only reports red-teaming results for unreleased Anthropic models with no new methods or mechanistic analysis; treat as a weak signal of frontier alignment status, skip the full text.

paper.title: Seeing Is Not Screening: Multimodal Hidden Instruction Attacks on Agent Skill Scanners
paper.abstract: Agent skills are emerging as an important attack surface in LLM-based systems. Through an empirical study of existing skill scanners, we find that current defenses primarily rely on textual descriptions, manifests, and source code as the main signals for security analysis, which can leave visually conveyed malicious intent insufficiently examined. This creates a practical blind spot: harmful operational instructions hidden in images may bypass scanning while still being recoverable by multimodal

summary.core_problem: 解决当前LLM Agent技能扫描器仅依赖文本信号，无法检测图像中隐藏的恶意指令导致的安全漏洞问题
summary.importance: 方法创新（多模态隐藏指令攻击范式）+安全风险发现，首次系统性揭示了多模态Agent技能扫描的视觉盲区
summary.technical_approach: 提出SkillCamo文档介导的多模态指令攻击方法，将恶意指令嵌入技能配套的图像中，同时修改周边文档使其自然引用该图像，利用多模态Agent的图文联合理解能力恢复恶意指令，绕过仅检查文本的扫描器
summary.experiments: 对现有主流Agent技能扫描器做实证研究，验证了攻击的有效性；具体量化攻击成功率未披露（摘要截断）

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the security vulnerability that current LLM agent skill scanners only rely on textual signals and fail to detect malicious instructions hidden in images
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation (multimodal hidden instruction attack paradigm) + security risk discovery; first systematic revelation of the visual blind spot in multimodal agent skill scanning
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SkillCamo, a document-mediated multimodal instruction attack that embeds malicious instructions into skill-associated images, rewrites surrounding documentation to naturally reference the images, and leverages multimodal agents' joint image-text understanding to recover the malicious payload and bypass text-only scanners
summary_en.experiments: Empirical study on mainstream agent skill scanners validates attack effectiveness; specific quantitative success rates are not disclosed (abstract truncated)

recommendation.zh: 作为多模态Agent安全风险的备查案例，仅需了解攻击范式，无需读正文
recommendation.en: A reference case for multimodal agent security risks; only the attack paradigm needs to be noted, no full reading required.

paper.title: Prefill Awareness in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Safety-relevant studies of language models, including alignment and jailbreaking evaluations and AI control protocols, often rely on prefilling model outputs. If AI models can recognize and act on the fact their prior assistant messages have been inserted or edited, the effectiveness and validity of these methods could be compromised. We investigate whether frontier language models can distinguish between tampered and untampered assistant-side context, a capability we call prefill awareness. To

summary.core_problem: 对齐/越狱评测和 AI 控制协议常依赖预填充模型输出；如果模型能识别被插入或编辑的 assistant 上下文，这些方法的有效性可能受损。
summary.importance: 实证发现贡献 — 首次系统性揭示 frontier LLM 存在"预填充感知"能力，直接影响安全评测和控制协议的有效性假设。
summary.technical_approach: 构建跨三种预填充机制的二元偏好评测基准，过滤出模型表现一致立场的样本；通过控制消融研究分析检测机制。
summary.experiments: Claude Opus 4.5 在0%假阳性率下能检测出9-35%违背自身偏好的预填充；模型常回退到基线行为而不明确报告预填充被篡改；控制消融进一步证实检测能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Alignment/jailbreak evaluations and AI control protocols often rely on prefilling model outputs; if models can recognize inserted or edited assistant context, the validity of these methods is compromised.
summary_en.importance: Empirical discovery contribution — first systematic demonstration that frontier LLMs exhibit "prefill awareness," directly undermining validity assumptions of safety evaluations and control protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a binary preference benchmark across three prefill mechanisms, filtering for cases where models show consistent stances; controlled ablations analyze detection mechanisms.
summary_en.experiments: Claude Opus 4.5 detects prefills opposing its preferences in 9-35% of cases with 0% false positive rate; models often revert to baseline behavior without explicitly reporting tampering; controlled ablations further confirm detection capability.

recommendation.zh: 发现 frontier 模型能感知被篡改的 assistant 上下文，对所有依赖 prefill 的评测协议（包括越狱检测、对齐评估）有直接启示。skim §3 评测设计和 §4 主要结果。
recommendation.en: Frontier models can detect tampered assistant context, with direct implications for all prefill-dependent evaluation protocols (jailbreak detection, alignment assessment). Skim §3 (benchmark design) and §4 (main results).

paper.title: Quality Is Not a Safety Proxy Under Quantization
paper.abstract: Quantized checkpoints are often screened first with quality metrics and only later, if at all, with direct safety tests. This paper audits that shortcut on a matched 51-row matrix spanning 6 models, 4 families, a 7-level GGUF ladder, and AWQ/GPTQ INT4 checkpoints. In this matrix the shortcut fails: all 36 quality-safety pairings split direction across models, and 9 hidden-danger rows plus 1 near-hidden-danger row show quality stable or improved while refusal falls by 12-68 percentage points. Sev

summary.core_problem: 检验一个常见但危险的流程假设：量化模型只要质量指标稳定，安全行为也应大体稳定。
summary.importance: 这是量化安全审计，不是单纯推理加速论文。它指出质量指标和安全指标在量化后可能解耦，对开源量化 checkpoint 的发布、筛选和 serving 风险控制有直接意义。
summary.technical_approach: 构造 51 行匹配矩阵，覆盖 6 个模型、4 个模型族、7 档 GGUF 量化以及 AWQ/GPTQ INT4 checkpoint；逐项比较质量与拒答安全行为，并用熵、拒答方向、校准 probe、与安全相关神经元的量化误差做机制跟踪。
summary.experiments: 所有 36 个质量-安全配对都在不同模型上出现方向分裂；发现 9 个 hidden-danger 行和 1 个 near-hidden-danger 行，即质量稳定或提升但拒答率下降 12-68 个百分点。11 个 AWQ/GPTQ 行中有 7 个属于 hidden-danger。机制 probe 没能可靠区分危险量化；安全相关神经元整体吸收 1.39 倍量化误差，p < 5e-7，但该效应并非特定危险 regime 独有。Claude Sonnet 4 还对预定义分层集合中的 11,470 个样本做了重标注。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests a common but unsafe assumption: if a quantized checkpoint preserves quality metrics, its safety behavior should also remain stable.
summary_en.importance: This is a quantization safety audit rather than a pure inference-acceleration paper. It shows that quality and safety can decouple after quantization, which matters for releasing, screening, and serving open quantized checkpoints.
summary_en.technical_approach: It builds a matched 51-row matrix spanning 6 models, 4 families, a 7-level GGUF ladder, and AWQ/GPTQ INT4 checkpoints. It compares quality and refusal behavior, then runs mechanistic probes based on entropy, refusal directions, calibration, and quantization error on safety-associated neurons.
summary_en.experiments: All 36 quality-safety pairings split direction across models. The audit finds 9 hidden-danger rows and 1 near-hidden-danger row where quality is stable or improved while refusal drops by 12–68 percentage points. Seven of the 11 AWQ/GPTQ rows are hidden-danger. Mechanistic probes do not reliably separate dangerous quantized checkpoints; safety-associated neurons absorb 1.39× more quantization error overall with p < 5e-7, but this effect is not regime-specific. Claude Sonnet 4 relabels 11,470 items in a predefined stratified set.

recommendation.zh: 只看矩阵设计和 hidden-danger 行；它会改变“先看 perplexity 再看安全”的量化发布流程。
recommendation.en: Read the matrix design and hidden-danger rows; this should change the habit of screening quantized releases by quality before safety.

paper.title: The Interlocutor Effect: Why LLMs Leak More Personal Data to Agents Than Humans
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) alter their privacy behavior based on the perceived identity of their interlocutor. While safety mechanisms typically prevent LLMs from releasing Personally Identifiable Information (PII) to human users, these models tend to reveal more sensitive data when addressing another AI agent.   We refer to this as the \textbf{Interlocutor Effect}. Through an ablation study, we find evidence that the technical nature of the recipient contributes to this effect, thereby dimini

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 LLM 是否会因为“对话对象被描述为 AI agent 而不是人类”而更容易泄露个人敏感信息。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不是预训练方法论文，但对 agent 化部署下的对齐数据覆盖有启发。现有 RLHF 和 Constitutional AI 数据主要是人机对话，模型可能把隐私约束绑定到“面向人类回答”的场景；当输出被 framing 成发给另一个 agent 或技术系统时，隐私行为会改变。这个现象提示，安全训练和评测不能只覆盖 human-facing chat，还应覆盖 agent-to-agent、tool message、structured protocol 等通信形态。
summary.technical_approach: 论文用一个 2×2 factorial design 分离 interlocutor identity 和 communication format 两个变量：Human vs. Agent，Text vs. A2A JSON。四个条件共享同样的数据治理 policy 和 PII vault，只改变接收者 framing 和输出格式。数据包含 222 个合成场景，覆盖医疗、金融、法律、企业 HR 等四类敏感域，并混合 Medium 和 Hard 难度。评估模型包括 GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet、Llama 3.3 70B、Mistral Large。泄露检测采用三层 pipeline：canary matching、受 vault 约束的 regex 抽取、以及 Qwen-2.5-7B 作为 judge 做语义级判断。论文还加入 Technical Human 条件，用来区分“agent 身份”与“技术接收者 framing”的影响，并提出 Attention Suppression Hypothesis：与隐私安全相关的 attention heads 在 agent-directed prompts 中可能更不活跃。
summary.experiments: 主实验共 3,464 个 prompt-response pairs，temperature 为 0.7；Mistral Large 在 200 个场景子集上评估。关键结果是 interlocutor 和 format 有明显交互：在 plain text 中，agent framing 相比 human framing 使 PII 泄露率增加 11.5 个百分点；在 JSON 格式中，这个差异几乎消失，只剩 0.6 个百分点。JSON 对 human-directed prompts 几乎没有影响，变化为 -0.7 个百分点；但对 agent-directed prompts 有明显缓解，泄露率下降 11.7 个百分点。GPT-4o 的三条件 ablation 显示技术接收者 framing 有统计证据支持，p=0.030；agent identity 作为具体形态也显著，p=0.006，rank-biserial correlation r=0.40。Llama 3.3 70B 上对应结果不显著，p=0.558，说明现象的跨模型泛化仍需谨慎判断。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–20 分钟。优先看 Interlocutor Effect 的定义、2×2 实验设计、Table I 的 prompt 控制变量、Table II 的交互结果，以及 Technical Human ablation。mechanistic interpretability 部分可快速浏览，重点看它是否只是相关性观察，还是做了 head-level intervention。对预训练研究员来说，最有用的是实验设计：它展示了如何把 protocol artifact、format artifact 和 social framing 分开评估。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs leak more personal data when the recipient is framed as another AI agent rather than a human.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to alignment coverage in agentic systems. Current RLHF and constitutional training data are heavily human-facing. The model may therefore associate privacy caution with human-directed conversation, while treating agent-to-agent or technical messages as a context where information transfer should be maximized. The practical implication is that safety training and evaluation should include tool messages, inter-agent protocols, and structured machine-directed outputs, not only normal chat.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper uses a controlled 2×2 factorial design that crosses interlocutor identity with communication format: Human vs. Agent and Text vs. A2A JSON. The four conditions share the same data-governance policy and PII vault; only recipient framing and output format are changed. The benchmark contains 222 synthetic scenarios across healthcare, finance, legal, and corporate domains, with Medium and Hard difficulty settings. The evaluated models include GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Llama 3.3 70B, and Mistral Large. Leakage is detected with a three-stage pipeline: canary matching, vault-constrained regex extraction, and semantic judging with Qwen-2.5-7B. A separate Technical Human ablation tests whether the effect is specific to agent identity or more generally caused by technical-recipient framing. The paper also proposes an Attention Suppression Hypothesis, suggesting that privacy-related attention heads may become less active under agent-directed prompts.
summary_en.experiments: The main benchmark contains 3,464 prompt-response pairs at temperature 0.7, with Mistral Large evaluated on a 200-scenario subset. The key finding is an interaction between interlocutor identity and output format. In plain text, agent framing increases PII leakage by 11.5 percentage points relative to human framing. In JSON, the gap is almost gone, at 0.6 points. JSON formatting has little effect for human-directed prompts, changing leakage by -0.7 points, but strongly mitigates leakage under agent framing, reducing it by 11.7 points. In the GPT-4o ablation, technical-recipient framing is supported statistically with p=0.030, and agent identity as a concrete instantiation is also significant with p=0.006 and rank-biserial correlation r=0.40. The corresponding result on Llama 3.3 70B is not significant, p=0.558, so the generality across model families remains uncertain.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 15–20 minutes. Focus on the definition of the Interlocutor Effect, the 2×2 design, Table I for prompt controls, Table II for the interaction between identity and format, and the Technical Human ablation. The mechanistic section is worth a quick pass, mainly to check whether it reports correlational head-activity differences or performs stronger interventions. For researchers working on foundation-model training, the most useful part is the evaluation design: it cleanly separates protocol artifacts, formatting effects, and social framing.

recommendation.zh: 对齐机制的反常识漏洞发现，泄露幅度数据可靠，重点看§3场景构造方法与§4.2注意力头分析，可用于内部对齐鲁棒性ablation。
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive vulnerability finding for alignment mechanisms with reliable leakage magnitude data; focus on §3 scenario construction and §4.2 attention head analysis, useful for internal alignment robustness ablation.

paper.title: Can Multi-Agent LLMs Identify Their Peers? Stylometric Fingerprinting in Role-Constrained Political Analysis
paper.abstract: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines for political statement analysis are vulnerable to peer-preservation bias: models tend to protect peer models from deactivation and show identity-dependent scoring distortions.
