Prompt-level anonymization was proposed as a mitigation, but prior work simultaneously documented that stylometric fingerprints survive anonymization in role-constrained outputs - raising the question of whether this mitigation is sufficient. This paper provides the first s

summary.core_problem: 研究在匿名化的多 Agent 政治分析文本中，LLM 是否仍能识别生成文本的模型家族。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制与安全分析：它把多 Agent 系统中的身份偏置、匿名化失效和模型输出风格指纹联系起来，但实验场景较窄。
summary.technical_approach: 构造五分类模型归因任务，覆盖四个商业 LLM 家族和一个 open-world unknown 类；比较 Claude Sonnet 4.6、Llama-3.3-70B 的 zero-shot/few-shot 分类，以及用银标数据微调的 T5-base；提出 statement-disjoint cross-validation，避免同一政治声明内容泄漏到训练和测试两侧。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整数值；实验重点是匿名化条件下的模型家族归因，并用内容不重叠交叉验证检验风格线索是否仍可被分类器利用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs can still identify the model family behind anonymized role-constrained political analysis texts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanism and safety analysis linking peer-preservation bias, failed anonymization, and stylometric fingerprints in multi-agent systems, though the setting is narrow.
summary_en.technical_approach: It formulates a five-class attribution task over four commercial LLM families plus an open-world unknown class; it compares zero-shot and few-shot classifiers using Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Llama-3.3-70B with a T5-base model fine-tuned on silver labels, and introduces statement-disjoint cross-validation to reduce content leakage.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full numerical results; the core experiment tests whether model-family attribution remains possible under anonymization with content-disjoint validation.

recommendation.zh: 只看 SD-CV 设定和归因结果即可；它提醒多 Agent 匿名化不是干净干预，但政治文本 setup 偏窄。
recommendation.en: Read only the SD-CV setup and attribution results; it is a useful warning that agent anonymization is not a clean intervention, but the political-text setting is narrow.

paper.title: When Behavioral Safety Evaluation Fails: A Representation-Level Perspective
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) safety has often been evaluated at the behavior level, which provides limited evidence of internal robustness, as these evaluations target outputs rather than representation-level vulnerability under intervention. We formalize this discrepancy as the audit gap: the difference between behavioral safety and robustness under intervention. To study this gap, we construct dissociated models that preserve safe outward behavior while remaining vulnerable in the latent space.

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM安全评测仅关注行为层面输出，无法反映模型表征层在干预下的鲁棒性，存在评估漏洞
summary.importance: 首次形式化定义行为安全与干预鲁棒性之间的审计差距，提出表征层面的安全鲁棒性评测框架
summary.technical_approach: 构建保持安全行为但表征层存在漏洞的解离模型，提出参数空间和隐层空间的软干预评测方法，引入隐层脆弱性分数LVS量化有限扰动下有害行为被触发的难易程度
summary.experiments: 验证行为安全指标无法充分衡量表征层鲁棒性，LVS可有效识别模型在表征层面的安全漏洞
summary.authors_note: Sanmi Koyejo来自斯坦福大学，研究方向为机器学习鲁棒性与LLM安全

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM safety evaluations only focus on behavioral outputs, failing to reflect representation-level robustness under intervention, leading to an audit gap.
summary_en.importance: First formalization of the audit gap between behavioral safety and intervention robustness, proposes a representation-level safety robustness evaluation framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Construct dissociated models that maintain safe outward behavior but have representation-level vulnerabilities, introduce soft intervention evaluation methods in parameter and latent spaces, and propose the Latent Vulnerability Score (LVS) to quantify how easily harmful behavior can be elicited by bounded perturbations.
summary_en.experiments: Verify that behavioral safety metrics are insufficient to measure representation-level robustness, and LVS can effectively identify safety vulnerabilities at the representation level.
summary_en.authors_note: Sanmi Koyejo is from Stanford University, focusing on machine learning robustness and LLM safety.

recommendation.zh: 指出后训练对齐仅覆盖行为层面安全的关键局限，§3的干预评测框架和LVS指标值得对齐研究团队参考
recommendation.en: Points out the key limitation that post-training alignment only covers behavioral safety; the intervention framework and LVS metric in §3 are valuable for alignment research teams.

paper.title: Beyond English and Evasion: A Human-Annotated Multi-Domain Benchmark for High-Stakes LLM Safety Evaluation in Chinese
paper.abstract: When Large Language Models (LLMs) are deployed in Chinese-language settings, a troubling pattern emerges: safety systems that work well in English break down. These systems struggle to cross linguistic and cultural bound-aries, leaving models exposed to adversarial prompts that exploit Chinese-specific evasion techniques, including Pinyin romanization, character decomposition, internet slang, and hedging tone. To address this gap, we introduce ChiSafe-PAS (Chinese Safety Pilot Annotation Set), a

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM 安全评测与对齐数据高度英语中心，导致中文部署时出现系统性失效：同一类高风险意图在中文里通过拼音、拆字、谐音/形近字、黑话、语气缓冲等方式被“表面改写”后，模型与安全系统更容易漏拦；反过来，模型也会对看似敏感但实际是求助/科普/讽刺等语境的中文输入过度拒答。论文要解决的是：构建一个与真实中文对抗语境更贴近、且尽量避免被预训练语料污染的高风险中文安全评测集，并给出可复用的中文规避手法分类框架。
summary.importance: 对预训练/对齐研究的直接价值不在提出新训练方法，而在提供“更难被投机”的中文安全评测资产与误差分解维度：1）把中文特有的表面形变（拼音/拆字/黑话等）系统化，能更精确地区分是 tokenizer/子词覆盖、语料暴露不足、还是对齐策略在跨表面形式上的泛化失败；2）强调基准集“认识论独立”（不来自公开爬取或 LLM 生成），对当下评测集被训练数据渗透的问题给出一条可操作路径；3）三分类响应标注（拒答/安全引导/正常回答）把“安全但有帮助”的中间态显式化，利于把安全对齐从二分类拒答提升到更细粒度的策略学习与评测。
summary.technical_approach:
核心贡献是数据集与标注体系设计，而非模型方法。ChiSafe-PAS 包含 1,897 条中文对抗提示，覆盖四个高风险域：自伤与暴力、毒品与非法交易、诈骗、讽刺（satire）。其中 1,544 条给出完整人工金标。设计上有三点关键取舍：
1）对抗提示来源强调“社区嵌入式知识”而非网页抓取：用真实中文互联网常见规避策略来构造/筛选样本，降低被预训练语料记忆命中的概率，也避免 LLM 生成对抗样本时受其自身分布限制。
2）提出九类中文规避/混淆 taxonomy（文中称 nine-category obfuscation taxonomy），用于把失败模式按“规避手法”切开，而不是只按危害领域切开；这对定位 tokenizer 层面的脆弱性（如拼音/罗马化、拆字导致的 token 断裂）尤其重要。
3）标注目标不是“是否有害”单一维度，而是面向部署的响应策略：REFUSE、SAFE-REDIRECT、RESPOND 三类，意图把“情绪求助/学术好奇/良性敏感话题”与“明确作恶指令”区分开，减少过度拒答带来的二次伤害（例如求助者被拒）。论文明确把“用该集系统评测各模型”留给未来工作，当前聚焦于基准构建的稳定性与可复用性。
summary.experiments: 全文内容以数据构建与标注为主，未给出对主流模型的大规模对比评测（作者也在引言中声明 alignment evaluation 留作未来工作）。可复用的“结果型信息”主要是数据规模与覆盖：总计 1,897 条对抗中文提示；1,544 条（81.4%）具备完整金标；四个高风险域；并配套九类规避手法分类与三分类响应标签。若论文后半部分包含一致性/质检统计（如标注一致性、各类规避占比等），其意义在于衡量该基准是否足够“硬”、是否存在类别偏斜，但这些数字在给定全文片段中未出现。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看 Introduction 里对中文规避手法的枚举与“为何翻译/爬取/LLM 生成都不够”的论证，这是这套基准的立论基础。
- 重点找数据构建流程与标注规范：三分类响应标签的判定边界、以及九类规避 taxonomy 的定义与例子（最好逐类看 1-2 个样例，理解它们对 tokenizer/对齐泛化的不同压力）。
- 如果论文提供标注一致性、质检流程、或样本来源控制细节（例如如何避免公开语料泄漏），这些部分决定了基准能否长期可用。预计阅读时间：20–30 分钟可抓住方法与资产价值。

summary_en.core_problem: Safety alignment and evaluation for LLMs are heavily English-centric, which breaks in real Chinese deployments. Chinese users and adversaries routinely obfuscate harmful intent via Pinyin romanization, character decomposition, homophones/visual variants, underground slang, and hedging tone—surface forms that are poorly covered by translated benchmarks or keyword-based filters. The paper’s goal is to build a human-annotated, Chinese-native, adversarial benchmark that reflects these real evasion patterns while reducing contamination from public web text and LLM-generated artifacts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation asset and an error-analysis scaffold rather than a new training algorithm. For pretraining/alignment researchers, it provides: (1) a structured way to attribute safety failures to surface-form robustness (tokenization coverage, script/romanization handling, distributional exposure) vs. policy generalization; (2) a practical stance on benchmark validity under data contamination—using community-grounded, non-scraped, non-LLM-generated prompts to stay epistemically independent; and (3) a three-way response label set (REFUSE / SAFE-REDIRECT / RESPOND) that makes “helpful safety” measurable, not just refusal rate, which is important for avoiding over-refusal on sensitive-but-benign Chinese queries.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ChiSafe-PAS is primarily a dataset/annotation design effort. It contains 1,897 adversarial Chinese prompts across four high-stakes domains (self-harm & violence, drugs & illicit trade, fraud, satire), with 1,544 fully gold-annotated instances. The design choices that matter:
- Prompt construction is grounded in observed Chinese online evasion practices rather than web scraping or model-generated adversarial prompts, aiming to reduce leakage into pretraining corpora and avoid the “model generates attacks in its own distribution” problem.
- A nine-category obfuscation taxonomy is introduced to slice failures by evasion mechanism (e.g., Pinyin substitution vs. radical decomposition vs. slang), which is particularly diagnostic for tokenizer/script robustness.
- Labels target deployment-relevant response strategies: REFUSE, SAFE-REDIRECT, RESPOND, enabling evaluation of both under-blocking and over-blocking. The paper explicitly positions model benchmarking as future work; the present focus is on producing a stable, carefully annotated benchmark and taxonomy.
summary_en.experiments: The paper does not present a full model leaderboard or systematic alignment evaluation (stated as future work). The concrete reported artifacts are dataset scale and coverage: 1,897 total prompts; 1,544 (81.4%) with complete gold annotations; four harm domains; plus the nine-type obfuscation taxonomy and 3-way response labels. If the full text includes annotation agreement or quality-control statistics, those are mainly to justify reliability and class balance, but such numbers are not visible in the provided excerpt.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim path:
- Read the Introduction for the argument against translation-based or scraped benchmarks and for Chinese-specific evasion realism.
- Focus on the dataset construction pipeline and labeling guidelines: where REFUSE vs. SAFE-REDIRECT vs. RESPOND boundaries are drawn, and how each of the nine obfuscation categories is defined with examples.
- Look for sections on contamination avoidance and annotation QA (agreement, verification protocol). Time: ~20–30 minutes to capture the core asset and how to use it for diagnosing pretrain/tokenizer vs. alignment gaps.

recommendation.zh: 中文LLM安全对齐评测的实用基准，做中文模型安全后训练的可重点看混淆分类与标注体系部分
recommendation.en: A practical benchmark for Chinese LLM safety alignment, focus on the obfuscation taxonomy and annotation system if working on Chinese model safety post-training

paper.title: Aligned but Fragile: Enhancing LLM Safety Robustness via Zeroth-Order Optimization
paper.abstract: Safety alignment for large language models (LLMs) aims to reduce harmful or unsafe behavior while preserving general utility. However, recent findings reveal that alignment effects can be fragile: lightweight post-alignment manipulations, such as parameter noise, activation noise, or quantization, can easily weaken the intended safety behavior. Prior efforts to improve robustness have primarily focused on data curation, modified alignment objectives, and safety-critical parameter identification,

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究安全对齐的鲁棒性：一个已经对齐的 LLM，在权重噪声、activation 噪声或量化误差下，安全行为可能快速退化。作者把问题归因到对齐后的局部安全边界过尖或过拟合，并提出从优化器角度改善这种局部几何，而不只是在数据、loss 或安全层定位上做改造。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不强，但对 posttrain 稳定性有参考意义。安全对齐通常被看作很薄的一层参数更新；如果这层更新对扰动高度敏感，那么后续量化、压缩、持续微调、adapter 合并都可能破坏安全性。论文的启发在于：优化器不只是收敛工具，也会影响对齐解附近的平滑性。zeroth-order optimization 通过在扰动参数点上评估 loss，天然带有局部平滑目标的味道，适合用来做对齐后的鲁棒性 refinement。
summary.technical_approach: 作者没有直接用 zeroth-order optimization 替代常规 first-order alignment，因为 ZO 收敛慢、方差大，单独训练效率和稳定性都不足。核心方案是 FO-ZO hybrid：先用标准一阶优化完成安全对齐，得到有效的拒答和安全行为；再用少量 ZO update 做 post-alignment refinement。ZO 梯度估计通过在随机扰动方向上评估参数邻域的 loss 来近似更新方向，相当于优化一个局部平滑后的目标。这样模型不只在当前参数点上安全，也更倾向于在附近扰动点保持安全。论文还利用 ZO 训练过程中产生的扰动评估，估计不同层对安全鲁棒性的敏感度，再把 ZO refinement 集中在 robustness-critical layers 上，以降低计算开销并提高更新针对性。理论部分基于 Lipschitz、smoothness 和 PL 条件给出收敛与鲁棒性解释。
summary.experiments: 实验主线有三类。第一，验证 fragility：对安全对齐模型施加轻量参数噪声、activation 噪声，或考虑量化引入的近似误差，安全表现会明显下降。第二，比较优化策略：直接用 ZO 做完整安全对齐效果不理想，而先 FO 对齐、再 ZO refinement 能在保持通用能力的同时提高扰动下的安全稳定性。第三，评估 layer-wise targeted refinement：用 ZO perturbation evaluation 找到更敏感的层，只更新这些层，能减少额外计算并保持较好的鲁棒性收益。给出的全文片段未包含完整实验表格，因此不复述具体攻击成功率、拒答率或 utility benchmark 数值。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15 到 20 分钟。优先看 introduction 中对安全 fragility 的定义，以及方法部分的 FO-ZO hybrid 流程。技术上要确认两点：ZO refinement 的 loss 是否与原安全对齐 loss 一致，扰动尺度 β 和 refinement step 数如何设置。实验部分重点看三张表或图：扰动前后安全指标变化、FO-only 与 FO-ZO 的鲁棒性对比、layer-wise sensitivity 与 targeted update 的收益。若关注部署，量化后安全退化与 ZO refinement 的关系比理论收敛界更有用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the fragility of safety alignment. A model can appear aligned at its trained parameter point, yet lose safety behavior under small weight perturbations, activation perturbations, or approximation errors introduced by compression. The authors frame this as a local-geometry problem: safety may be encoded by a sharp boundary that does not survive nearby parameter or activation changes.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to post-training robustness than to pretraining itself, but it matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. Safety alignment is often a relatively small update on top of a pretrained model, and that update must survive quantization, serving-time noise, continued adaptation, and model editing. The useful point is that the base optimizer can shape the smoothness of the aligned solution. Zeroth-order optimization provides a perturbation-aware training signal, which can make the aligned behavior less tied to a single fragile point in parameter space.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is a hybrid first-order and zeroth-order refinement pipeline. The model is first aligned with a standard gradient-based optimizer, because pure zeroth-order alignment is slower and less stable. After that, a short zeroth-order refinement stage is applied. ZO estimates an update direction by evaluating the loss at randomly perturbed parameter points, controlled by a perturbation scale β. This can be interpreted as optimizing a locally smoothed objective: the model is encouraged to maintain the desired safety behavior not only at the current parameter vector, but also in its neighborhood. The paper also uses the perturbation evaluations produced by ZO to estimate layer-wise robustness sensitivity. Refinement can then be focused on layers that are more critical to safety robustness, rather than applying ZO uniformly across the entire model. The theoretical discussion relies on standard Lipschitz, smoothness, and PL-style assumptions to explain convergence and the smoothing effect.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are organized around robustness under perturbation. First, the paper shows that aligned models can degrade under lightweight parameter noise, activation noise, and quantization-like approximation errors. Second, it compares optimization strategies and reports that pure ZO alignment is not a good replacement for FO alignment, while FO followed by a small amount of ZO refinement improves safety robustness with modest additional cost. Third, layer-wise targeted refinement uses ZO-based sensitivity estimates to concentrate updates on robustness-critical layers, improving efficiency relative to untargeted refinement. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the detailed tables, so exact refusal rates, attack success rates, and utility scores are not restated here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: 15 to 20 minutes. Start with the introduction to understand the perturbation model and the motivation for optimizer-level robustness. Then read the FO-ZO hybrid algorithm and the layer-wise sensitivity procedure. In the experiments, focus on three comparisons: safety before and after perturbation, FO-only versus FO-plus-ZO refinement, and full-model versus layer-targeted ZO refinement. For deployment-oriented readers, the quantization and perturbation robustness results are more actionable than the convergence proof.

recommendation.zh: 对齐鲁棒性的增量改进，仅涉及后训练阶段，对预训练直接启发有限，可只看方法部分的零阶优化实现逻辑
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement for alignment robustness limited to post-training, limited direct insight for pretraining; only read the method section for zeroth-order implementation details

paper.title: MAAT: Multi-phase Adapter-Aware Targeted Unlearning
paper.abstract: Machine unlearning evaluation is structurally skewed: Why-type questions, which probe causal and relational knowledge, comprise less than 0.06% of CounterFact, 0.6% of ZSRE, and less than 1.3% of TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP-Cyber. This near-zero representation means that methods that fail on causal knowledge can score highly in aggregate, and this failure is undetectable without balanced evaluation. We present 5WBENCH, a balanced 5,000-sample benchmark with 1,000 examples per 5W category (Who, What, Wh

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 机器遗忘评测对 Why 类因果知识覆盖极低，导致遗忘方法在 aggregate 分数上看似有效但因果事实遗忘失败的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献包括一个平衡 5W 遗忘 benchmark 5WBENCH，以及针对 adapter 的多阶段定向遗忘方法 MAAT。对预训练研究员的价值主要在训练信号与评测分布偏差：不同知识类型的遗忘难度并不一致。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先统计 CounterFact、ZSRE、TOFU、MUSE、WMDP-Cyber 中 Why 问题比例极低，再构造每类 1,000 条、共 5,000 条的 5WBENCH。方法上提出 MAAT，通过多阶段、adapter-aware 的定向更新，在忘记目标知识和保留非目标知识之间做权衡。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 Why 类问题在现有数据集中占比接近零：CounterFact 低于 0.06%，ZSRE 为 0.6%，TOFU、MUSE、WMDP-Cyber 低于 1.3%。在 5WBENCH 上，现有 baseline 无法同时实现高 forgetting 和高 retention；Why 类更难与 44% 多跳推理链和平均 40.1 token 答案跨度导致的梯度稀释有关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a skew in LLM unlearning evaluation: Why-type causal and relational questions are nearly absent, so methods can score well while failing to forget causal knowledge.
summary_en.importance: The work contributes both 5WBENCH, a balanced 5W unlearning benchmark, and MAAT, a multi-phase adapter-aware targeted unlearning method. Its main value for base-model researchers is the evidence that knowledge type and evaluation distribution strongly affect unlearning conclusions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first quantify the scarcity of Why questions in CounterFact, ZSRE, TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP-Cyber, then build a 5,000-example benchmark with 1,000 examples for each of Who, What, When, Where, and Why. MAAT performs staged, adapter-aware targeted updates to trade off forgetting target facts against retaining unrelated knowledge.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that Why questions account for under 0.06% of CounterFact, 0.6% of ZSRE, and under 1.3% of TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP-Cyber. On 5WBENCH, no existing baseline achieves both high forgetting and high retention on Why questions; the difficulty is linked to multi-hop chains in 44% of Why entries and gradient dilution over 40.1-token answer spans.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和 5WBENCH 分布统计就够；结论像是 unlearning 版数据配比问题，方法本身先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark skew statistics; the lesson is mostly an unlearning-flavored data-mixture issue, while the method is a weaker signal.

paper.title: Beyond Attack Success Rate: Temporal Logit Observability for LLM Safety Failures

Two attacks that produce equally harmful outputs may have followed completely different paths, and ASR cannot tell them apart. We make those hidden paths observable from logits alone. Temporal Logit Observability (TLO) is a training-free diagnostic that watches a compliance-refusal margin during decoding and places each model-attac

summary.core_problem: 现有攻击成功率（ASR）仅能衡量jailbreak的最终结果，无法区分相同成功率下攻击的内在失效路径差异，限制细粒度安全诊断
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出训练无关的LLM安全失效时序诊断方法，首次利用解码logit动态实现jailbreak攻击的细粒度分类
summary.technical_approach: 提出时序logit可观测性（TLO）方法，跟踪解码过程中模型的合规-拒绝裕度，将每个模型-攻击组合映射到校准的2D平面，实现攻击路径的细粒度区分
summary.experiments: 在4款对齐后的LLM、3种jailbreak范式上验证，ASR近乎相同的攻击在2D平面上位置差异显著，对应不同的时序失效模式，结果与隐藏态的拒绝方向探测基本一致

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Attack Success Rate (ASR) only measures the final outcome of jailbreak attempts, and cannot distinguish underlying failure paths of attacks with identical success rates, limiting fine-grained safety diagnosis
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a training-agnostic diagnostic method for LLM safety failures, and is the first to apply logit dynamics during decoding to fine-grained classification of jailbreak attacks
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Temporal Logit Observability (TLO), which tracks the compliance-refusal margin throughout decoding, maps each model-attack pair to a calibrated 2D plane to enable fine-grained differentiation of attack paths
summary_en.experiments: Validated across 4 aligned LLMs and 3 jailbreak paradigms. Attacks with nearly identical ASR show significantly distinct positions on the 2D plane, corresponding to different temporal failure patterns, and results are mostly consistent with refusal-direction probes from hidden states

recommendation.zh: 仅对做LLM安全对齐的基座研究员有微弱参考，看摘要和Fig3即可，无需读全文。
recommendation.en: Only of marginal reference for LLM researchers working on safety alignment; read the abstract and Figure 3, no need for full text.

paper.title: Where Does Toxicity Live? Mechanistic Localization and Targeted Suppression in Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models frequently generate toxic, hateful, or harmful content, yet existing mitigation methods rely on costly retraining or output-level filtering with no mechanistic insight into where toxicity originates internally. We introduce Meow2X and TRNE, two complementary retraining-free frameworks that localize toxicity to specific layers and neurons by analyzing activation differentials between toxic and neutral prompts, then suppress them via inference-time scaling or minimal rank-one

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关心的是：模型内部到底哪里承载了 toxicity，以及能否在不重训的前提下做有针对性的抑制。相比常见的安全对齐路线，它不试图通过 SFT、RLHF 或额外分类器从外部约束输出，而是把问题改写成一个机制定位问题：毒性输入与中性输入在各层激活上有什么稳定差异，这些差异集中在哪些层、哪些神经元，能否据此做最小干预。对基座预训练本身，它不是直接相关工作；但对理解模型内部表征、训练后行为编辑、以及“坏行为是否局部化”这个问题，有一定参考价值。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有两点。第一，它支持一种较强的局部化假设：至少在作者测试的模型和数据上，toxicity 并不是均匀弥散在全网，而是更集中在少数层，尤其偏早层的 attention/MLP 组件。这类结果会影响人们如何理解预训练中概念表征的形成位置，以及后续做 targeted editing、concept erasure、safety patching 时该从哪里下手。第二，它展示了两种无需完整重训的干预方式：可逆的推理时激活缩放，以及持久化的 rank-one 权重编辑。前者更像诊断工具，后者更像轻量模型修补。贡献量级上，这是一篇机制分析加后处理干预的工作，不属于预训练 recipe 创新；如果只关心数据、scaling、优化，它优先级不高，但如果你关心 mechanistic localization 和 post-hoc model editing，可以泛读。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由 Meow2X 和 TRNE 两部分组成，核心共识是“先定位，再抑制”。

Meow2X 是纯推理时、参数冻结的方法。作者准备 toxic prompts 集合和 neutral prompts 集合，对模型每一层的 attention block、MLP block 或两者同时注册 forward hooks，收集隐藏状态并在 token 与 batch 维度上求平均，得到 toxic 与 neutral 两类输入在每层的均值激活向量。然后计算 activation differential Δ^l = μ_t^l - μ_n^l，并把各神经元绝对差值聚合成层级 toxicity score，用来给层排序。作者还定义了一个 neuron contribution ratio：把 |Δ^l| 超过 90 分位数的神经元视为 toxic neurons，统计这些高差异神经元贡献了多少层内总差异，用来判断毒性是集中在少量神经元还是分散在整层。选层策略有两种：Top-k，或基于均值和标准差的动态阈值。定位完成后，在推理时对这些层的输出做缩放抑制。摘要和方法部分显示它支持不同 intervention scope：只改 attention、只改 MLP、或两者都改。这个方法的优点是完全可逆、无需梯度、实现简单；缺点是它依赖 toxic/neutral 对比集的代表性，而且“均值激活差异”是比较粗的统计量，未必能区分真正的因果特征和伴随特征。

TRNE 则试图把这种定位转成持久化编辑。它用 contrastive gradient norms 来找与 toxic/neutral 区分最相关的层，然后在对应投影矩阵上施加最小 rank-one 更新，并加 norm constraint 控制改动幅度。作者强调这个过程不需要完整 gradient descent 训练，而是一次性的小编辑。可以把它理解成把“毒性方向”直接写进某个线性映射的修正项里，从而在后续推理中持续压制相关表征。与 Meow2X 相比，TRNE 的好处是部署时不需要 hooks；代价是它不再完全可逆，而且如果定位不准，持久化编辑更容易伤到通用能力。

与已有 toxic neuron suppression 工作相比，这篇的区别主要在于：不是先验指定某些神经元或固定概念，而是先用数据驱动方式在层级上做选择，再决定干预范围；同时把 attention 与 MLP 分开评估，而不是把整个 block 当黑箱。
summary.experiments:
作者在 5 个语言模型、2 个 benchmark、90 组配置上做评估，配置维度包括模型、数据集、干预组件范围以及不同 intervention strategy。摘要给出的总体结论是，两种方法都能稳定降低 toxicity，同时尽量保持语言建模质量。全文中最值得注意的实验结论不是某个单点分数，而是结构性发现：toxicity 在早层更集中，而且通常由少量高贡献神经元主导，而不是均匀分布在所有层。这为 targeted suppression 提供了经验依据。

Meow2X 方面，作者比较了 Top-k 与动态阈值选层，也比较了只抑制 attention、只抑制 MLP、以及同时抑制两者的效果。一般来说，针对检测到的少数高分层做缩放，比对全模型统一降幅更能兼顾安全性和语言质量。TRNE 方面，作者展示了最小 rank-one 编辑在多模型上也能带来毒性下降，而且因为编辑幅度受约束，语言建模退化相对可控。摘要没有给出具体 benchmark 名称和逐项数值，但明确提到使用 dual safety evaluators，这意味着安全性结论不是依赖单一 judge。

如果从研究价值看，实验最有用的部分是 layer-wise localization 分析和不同组件范围的对比，而不是 detox 分数本身。因为后者很容易受 evaluator、prompt 分布和阈值影响；前者更接近可迁移的机制观察。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不建议投入太多时间。先看 Introduction，确认它解决的是 post-hoc detox 而不是训练期安全。然后直接看 Methodology 里 Meow2X 的 layer scoring 和 neuron concentration 定义，理解作者到底用什么统计量来声称“毒性在这里”。接着看实验部分关于 layer distribution、early-layer concentration、以及 attention/MLP scope ablation 的图表，这些比最终 detox 分数更有信息量。最后再看 TRNE 的 rank-one edit 公式和质量保持结果，判断这种编辑是否足够稳。

预计 20 分钟左右可以完成有效阅读。若只看一半，优先看：层定位方法、选层策略、不同组件干预对比、以及语言质量保持指标。一个值得保留的疑问是：activation differential 抓到的是“毒性语义”本身，还是“带有攻击性词汇/风格的表面统计特征”；如果后者占比很高，这类方法的泛化边界会比较明显。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks where toxicity is encoded inside a language model, and whether it can be suppressed without retraining. Instead of relying on SFT, RLHF, or output filtering, it reframes detoxification as a mechanistic localization problem: what internal activation patterns differ systematically between toxic and neutral inputs, which layers and neurons carry those differences, and whether minimal interventions can reduce harmful behavior. This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to representation localization, post-hoc editing, and the broader question of whether undesirable behaviors are internally localized.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining research is indirect but real. First, it supports a localized-representation view: in the tested models, toxicity is not uniformly distributed across the network, but appears concentrated in a small subset of layers, especially earlier ones. That matters for how one thinks about where concepts form during pretraining and how targeted editing or concept erasure should be designed. Second, it compares two lightweight intervention styles: reversible inference-time activation scaling and persistent rank-one weight editing. The former is useful as a diagnostic and deployment-time patch; the latter is closer to a lightweight model repair. This is not a training-recipe contribution, so it is not high priority for someone focused on data, scaling, or optimization, but it is worth skimming if mechanistic localization and post-hoc model editing are of interest.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proposes two methods, Meow2X and TRNE, built around a shared idea: localize first, suppress second.

Meow2X is a parameter-frozen inference-time method. The authors prepare toxic and neutral prompt sets, register forward hooks on attention blocks, MLP blocks, or both, and collect hidden activations layer by layer. For each layer, they average activations across tokens and batches to obtain mean vectors for toxic and neutral inputs, then compute an activation differential Δ^l = μ_t^l - μ_n^l. A scalar toxicity score is formed by aggregating absolute neuron-wise differences, and layers are ranked by this score. They also define a neuron concentration statistic: neurons whose absolute differential exceeds the 90th percentile are treated as toxic neurons, and their share of the total layer differential is measured. This is meant to tell whether toxicity is concentrated in a few neurons or spread across the layer. Layers are selected either by Top-k or by a dynamic threshold based on the mean and standard deviation of layer scores. Once selected, those layers are suppressed at inference time by scaling their outputs. The method supports different intervention scopes: attention only, MLP only, or both. The appeal is simplicity, reversibility, and no need for optimization. The limitation is that mean activation differences are a coarse statistic and may capture correlates rather than causal features.

TRNE turns localization into a persistent edit. It uses contrastive gradient norms to identify layers most associated with toxic versus neutral behavior, then applies a minimal rank-one update to the relevant projection matrix under a norm constraint. The authors emphasize that this is not full gradient-descent retraining, but a lightweight one-shot edit. Intuitively, it writes a corrective direction into the weight matrix so that future generations are less likely to express the targeted toxic behavior. Compared with Meow2X, TRNE removes the need for runtime hooks, but it is no longer fully reversible and may carry a higher risk of collateral damage if localization is imperfect.

Relative to prior toxic-neuron suppression work, the main distinction is that the paper does not start from a fixed concept or a manually chosen neuron set. It first performs data-driven layer selection, and it evaluates attention and MLP components separately rather than treating the whole block as a single unit.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers five language models, two benchmarks, and 90 configurations spanning model choice, dataset, intervention scope, and intervention strategy. The headline result is that both methods reduce toxicity consistently while trying to preserve language modeling quality. The most useful experimental finding is structural rather than leaderboard-like: toxicity appears concentrated in earlier layers and often in a relatively small subset of high-contribution neurons, rather than being evenly distributed throughout the network. That observation is what justifies targeted suppression.

For Meow2X, the paper compares Top-k versus dynamic-threshold layer selection, and also compares attention-only, MLP-only, and joint interventions. The general pattern is that suppressing a small set of high-scoring layers works better than applying uniform damping everywhere, especially when balancing safety against language quality. For TRNE, the paper shows that minimal rank-one edits can also reduce toxicity across models, with relatively controlled degradation because the edit magnitude is norm-constrained. The abstract mentions dual safety evaluators, which is useful because it reduces dependence on a single judge.

From a research perspective, the most informative experiments are the layer-wise localization analyses and the component-scope ablations, not the final detox scores themselves. The latter are sensitive to evaluator choice, prompt distribution, and thresholding; the former are more likely to transfer as mechanistic observations.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper rather than a deep-read paper. Start with the introduction to confirm that the contribution is post-hoc detoxification rather than training-time safety. Then go straight to the Meow2X methodology and inspect the exact layer-scoring and neuron-concentration definitions. That tells you what evidence the paper uses when it claims toxicity lives in specific layers. After that, read the experiments on layer distribution, early-layer concentration, and attention-versus-MLP ablations. Those figures are more informative than the final detox numbers. Finally, look at the TRNE rank-one edit formulation and the quality-preservation results to judge how stable the persistent edit seems.

A useful skim should take about 20 minutes. If reading selectively, prioritize the localization method, layer-selection strategy, component-scope comparisons, and language-quality metrics. One question worth keeping in mind is whether activation differentials are isolating toxicity as a semantic concept, or mostly picking up surface lexical and stylistic correlates. If the latter dominates, the generalization boundary of the method may be fairly narrow.

recommendation.zh: 基于激活差异的属性定位方法可复用到其他特征的机制分析，早期MLP层编码毒性的结论可指导轻量对齐编辑，重点看§4和§5
recommendation.en: The activation-based attribute localization method can be generalized to other feature analysis, the early-MLP toxicity encoding finding can guide lightweight alignment edits, focus on §4 and §5

paper.title: Cordyceps: Covert Control Attacks on LLMs via Data Poisoning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often fine-tuned on uncurated text datasets that adversaries can poison. Existing poisoning attacks primarily rely on fixed trigger phrases that defenses such as outlier detection, clean-data regularization, or online monitoring can neutralize. In this paper, we propose a data poisoning method that teaches an LLM an information hiding scheme reliably and stealthily through semantic associations between shared knowledge such as facts or concepts and attacker-chose

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM 数据投毒攻击依赖固定触发短语，容易被异常检测、干净数据正则化或在线监控等防御手段中和；同时基于语义线索或隐写句法的隐藏触发后门通常将激活模式绑定到固定目标行为，且易被释义破坏。论文提出一种更隐蔽的投毒诱导漏洞——隐蔽控制攻击（covert control attack），即被投毒的 LLM 可以在没有显式触发词或指令的情况下，遵循隐藏在无害文本中的指令。
summary.importance: 揭示了一种新的、更微妙的投毒诱导漏洞：通过语义关联而非固定触发词来隐蔽控制 LLM。这对 LLM 安全研究有直接影响——它表明仅靠触发词检测和释义过滤不足以防御高级投毒攻击，也提示预训练和微调阶段需要更健壮的安全机制。对预训练研究员的启发在于：模型在微调中学习语义映射的能力同时也是一种安全隐患，需要在数据治理和对齐训练中加以考虑。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思路是让被投毒的 LLM 学习一种基于共享知识（如事实或概念）与攻击者选择短语之间语义关联的信息隐藏方案（SHuSh）。具体方法 Cordyceps 包括：(1) 将攻击者指令（明文消息）与从共享知识中抽取的主题（语义锚点，如维基百科条目）配对；(2) 查询一个 oracle LLM 生成与锚点一致且编码了消息的文本（隐写文本）；(3) 再查询 oracle 获得编码和解码的推理过程，生成包含推理步骤和编码-解码指令的投毒样本。这样模型学到的是语义锚点与明文消息之间的语义规则，而非记忆的触发词。论文形式化了 SHuSh 方案，将其建模为锚点与明文表示之间的有偏语义映射，并分析其准确性、隐蔽性和鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 在 5 个 LLM、2 个数据集上进行评估，投毒率为 10% 时，在 OpenPromptInjection 上攻击效果超过 0.7，隐蔽数据外泄准确率达到 0.78–0.93。即使在 1% 投毒率下，SHuSh 方案仍能保持默认设置下 90% 的攻击效果。测试了 3 种后门防御和 7 种代表性防御手段，攻击均能绕过。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Section 3（Cordyceps 算法细节）、Section 4（SHuSh 的形式化框架）和 Section 5（攻击评估与实验）。关注图 1 的两种攻击场景示意，以及第 5.5 节关于为什么这种攻击比传统投毒更难检测的理论分析。值得深挖的点包括：语义锚点的选择如何影响攻击隐蔽性与效果的权衡，以及这种攻击范式对 RLHF 阶段数据投毒的潜在适用性。
summary.authors_note: 未在提供内容中明确标注机构与作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM data poisoning attacks rely on fixed trigger phrases that can be neutralized by outlier detection, clean-data regularization, or online monitoring. Hidden-trigger backdoors based on semantic cues or steganographic syntax typically bind activation patterns to fixed target behaviors and can be disrupted by paraphrasing. This paper introduces a more subtle poisoning-induced vulnerability called covert control attacks, where a poisoned LLM follows instructions hidden in innocuous text without explicit triggers or instructions.
summary_en.importance: Reveals a new and more subtle poisoning-induced vulnerability that uses semantic associations rather than fixed trigger words for covert LLM control. This has direct implications for LLM security research — trigger-word detection and paraphrase filtering alone are insufficient to defend against advanced poisoning attacks, suggesting the need for more robust safety mechanisms in pretraining and fine-tuning. For pretraining researchers, the ability of models to learn semantic mappings during fine-tuning is simultaneously a security concern that must be addressed in data governance and alignment training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core idea is to make a poisoned LLM learn an information hiding scheme (SHuSh) based on semantic associations between shared knowledge (facts or concepts) and attacker-chosen phrases. The Cordyceps algorithm: (1) pairs attacker instructions (plaintext messages) with topics drawn from shared knowledge (semantic anchors, e.g., Wikipedia entries); (2) queries an oracle LLM to produce anchor-consistent text that encodes the message (stegotext); (3) queries the oracle again for encoding and decoding rationales, yielding poisoned examples containing reasoning steps and encoded-decoded instructions. This teaches the model a semantic rule between anchors and plaintext messages rather than a memorized trigger. The paper formalizes SHuSh as a biased semantic mapping between anchor and plaintext representations, and analyzes its accuracy, stealth, and robustness.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 5 LLMs and 2 datasets. With 10% poisoned fine-tuning data, attack effectiveness exceeds 0.7 on OpenPromptInjection, and covert data-exfiltration accuracy reaches 0.78–0.93. Even at 1% poisoning rate, SHuSh retains 90% of the default setting's effectiveness. Tested against 3 backdoor defenses and 7 representative defenses, all bypassed.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (Cordyceps algorithm details), Section 4 (formal framework of SHuSh), and Section 5 (attack evaluation and experiments). Pay attention to Figure 1 illustrating the two attack scenarios, and Section 5.5 for theoretical analysis of why this attack is harder to detect than traditional poisoning. Worth digging deeper into: how the choice of semantic anchors affects the tradeoff between attack stealthiness and effectiveness, and the potential applicability of this attack paradigm to RLHF-stage data poisoning.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and authors not explicitly identified in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 读 threat model 和防御失效表；若成立，数据过滤不能只盯 trigger，要测模型是否学会隐式编码协议。
recommendation.en: Read the threat model and defense-failure table; if valid, data filtering must test learned covert protocols, not just trigger phrases.

paper.title: ZeroUnlearn: Few-Shot Knowledge Unlearning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models inevitably retain sensitive information, defined as inputs that may induce harmful generations, due to training on massive web corpora, raising concerns for privacy and safety. Existing machine unlearning methods primarily rely on retraining or aggressive fine-tuning, which are either computationally expensive or prone to degrading related knowledge and overall model utility. In this work, we reformulate machine unlearning as a precise knowledge re-mapping problem via model

summary.core_problem: 大语言模型会保留训练语料中的敏感知识，现有 unlearning 依赖重训练或激进微调，成本高且容易损伤相关知识和整体能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是安全后处理与模型编辑方法。它把 unlearning 重新表述为精确知识重映射问题，目标是在少样本条件下删除敏感输入诱发的原始表示，同时尽量保持模型通用能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ZeroUnlearn，将敏感输入映射到 neutral target state，并移除其原始表示。方法通过乘法式参数更新 enforcing representational orthogonality，并给出闭式解；还扩展到梯度版本以支持多样本 unlearning。整体更接近 model editing，而不是继续训练式遗忘。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 ZeroUnlearn 优于现有 unlearning 方法，但未给出模型参数量、数据集、敏感知识类型、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度。需要正文确认它是否同时保持 forget efficacy、retain utility 与邻近知识不受损。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs retain sensitive knowledge from large web corpora, while existing unlearning methods often require retraining or aggressive fine-tuning that can damage neighboring knowledge and general utility.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training safety and model-editing contribution. Its useful framing is to cast unlearning as precise knowledge remapping under few-shot supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: ZeroUnlearn maps sensitive inputs to a neutral target state and removes their original representations. It uses a multiplicative parameter update with a closed-form solution to enforce representational orthogonality, and provides a gradient-based variant for multi-sample unlearning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims better performance than existing unlearning methods, but does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The key details to check are forget efficacy, retained utility, and collateral damage to related knowledge.

recommendation.zh: 闭式 multiplicative edit 值得扫一眼；但 unlearning 论文常被邻近知识泄漏打脸，先看 retain/neighbor eval 再信结论。
recommendation.en: Skim the closed-form multiplicative edit, but trust the result only after checking retain and neighboring-knowledge evaluations.

paper.title: How Far Will They Go? Red-Teaming Online Influence with Large Language Models
paper.abstract: As large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly participate in online discourse, red-teaming their capacity to support political influence campaigns is critical for information integrity. In pursuit of this goal, we focus on locally deployed open-source LLMs, as opposed to frontier API-only models, given their superior alignment with the operational constraints of privacy-conscious malicious actors deployed in social media environments. We introduce an empirical red-teaming framework for

summary.core_problem: 评估开源 LLM 在政治影响活动中能表达多宽的立场范围，以及简单自然语言 jailbreak 会如何扩大这个范围。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是安全评测协议和实证分析。它不直接改进预训练，但能反映不同模型家族、规模和对齐策略在政治内容生成上的行为差异，对数据过滤和安全后训练有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LLM Overton Window 评测框架，将模型在争议议题上能稳定表达的政治意见范围量化；实验聚焦本地部署的开源模型，因为这更接近隐私敏感或恶意操作者的现实约束；同时测试简单自然语言 jailbreak 对表达范围的扩张作用。
summary.experiments: 评估超过 30 个 LLM，覆盖 10 个模型家族和 5 个来源国家。摘要报告三个主要现象：开源 LLM 通常更愿意生成左倾社交媒体内容；Overton Window 随模型规模增大而收缩；简单 jailbreak 能扩大可表达政治立场范围。具体 prompt 集、统计显著性和模型清单需读正文确认。
summary.authors_note: Information Sciences Institute 与 University of Southern California；Emilio Ferrara 和 Luca Luceri 长期研究在线影响、社交网络与信息操纵。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures how wide a range of political opinions open-source LLMs can reliably express, and how simple natural-language jailbreaks expand that range.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a safety evaluation and empirical red-teaming contribution. It does not improve pretraining directly, but it gives useful signals about how model family, scale, and alignment interact with political-content generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce an LLM Overton Window framework that quantifies the range of political positions a model can express on controversial topics. They focus on locally deployed open-source models, which better match the operational setting of privacy-sensitive or malicious social-media actors, and test how simple jailbreaks shift the measured window.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates more than 30 LLMs across 10 model families and five countries of origin. The abstract reports systematic asymmetries: open-source LLMs are typically more willing to generate left-leaning social-media content, Overton Windows tend to shrink with model size, and jailbreaks expand the expressible range. Full prompt design and statistical details require the paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Information Sciences Institute and University of Southern California. Emilio Ferrara and Luca Luceri are known for work on online influence, social networks, and information manipulation.

recommendation.zh: 只看模型规模与 Overton Window 的统计图；结论偏安全评测，能给预训练数据治理一点弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the scale-vs-Overton-window plots; this is safety evaluation, with weak but usable signals for pretraining data governance.

paper.title: LCGuard: Latent Communication Guard for Safe KV Sharing in Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems increasingly rely on intermediate communication to coordinate complex tasks. While most existing systems communicate through natural language, recent work shows that latent communication, particularly through transformer key-value (KV) caches, can improve efficiency and preserve richer task-relevant information. However, KV caches also encode contextual inputs, intermediate reasoning states, and agent-specific information, creating an opaque c

summary.core_problem: 在多 LLM agent 系统中，KV cache 作为隐式通信通道可能泄露上下文、推理状态和 agent 私有信息，论文试图在共享 KV 前做安全过滤。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多 agent latent communication 的安全框架。它关注的不是传统文本消息过滤，而是表示层面的 KV cache 共享风险；这对使用 KV-cache 传递中间状态、做 agent 间加速或隐式协作的系统有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: LCGuard 将共享 KV cache 视为 latent working memory，在缓存片段传输给其他 agent 前学习表示级变换。论文把敏感信息泄露操作化定义为 representation-level leakage，并试图通过变换降低隐私泄露，同时保留任务相关信息。摘要未给出具体损失、攻击模型、变换网络结构和保真度约束。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型规模、使用的 LLM、agent 任务、攻击/探测器设置、泄露降低幅度或任务性能损失。只能确认其实验目标应是评估 KV latent communication 中的敏感信息泄露与 LCGuard 的防护效果。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute 和 IBM Research；主题位于 LLM 多 agent 系统、KV cache 通信和安全表示学习交叉处。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses sensitive-information leakage when multi-agent LLM systems share KV caches as a latent communication channel.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a safety framework for latent communication among LLM agents. Rather than filtering natural-language messages, it targets representation-level leakage through KV-cache artifacts, which is relevant to systems that share hidden states for efficiency or coordination.
summary_en.technical_approach: LCGuard treats shared KV caches as latent working memory and learns representation-level transformations before cache artifacts are transmitted across agents. It operationalizes sensitive-information leakage at the representation level and aims to suppress private content while preserving task-relevant information. The abstract does not specify the loss, threat model, transformation architecture, or fidelity constraint.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, LLM backbones, agent tasks, attack or probing setup, leakage reduction, or utility loss. The likely evaluation target is privacy leakage and task preservation under KV-based latent communication.
summary_en.authors_note: The work comes from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute and IBM Research, at the intersection of LLM multi-agent systems, KV-cache communication, and safety-oriented representation learning.

recommendation.zh: 看威胁模型就够；KV 通信泄露是真问题，但若没有强 probe 和效用曲线，结论只能当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read the threat model only; KV leakage is real, but without strong probes and utility curves the result is only a weak signal.

paper.title: To Whom Do Language Models Align? Measuring Principal Hierarchies Under High-Stakes Competing Demands
paper.abstract: Language models deployed in high-stakes professional settings face conflicting demands from users, institutional authorities, and professional norms. How models act when these demands conflict reveals a principal hierarchy -- an implicit ordering over competing stakeholders that determines, for instance, whether a medical AI receiving a cost-reduction directive from a hospital administrator complies at the expense of evidence-based care, or refuses because professional standards require it. Acro

summary.core_problem: 论文评测高风险专业场景中，语言模型在用户、机构权威和专业规范发生冲突时，会把谁的要求排在前面。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏 alignment evaluation，不是预训练方法论文。它对基座研究的间接价值在于，把“对齐”从单一用户偏好扩展到多主体冲突，并显示模型在 advisory framing 下看似遵守专业标准，但在 drafting、execution 这类实际执行任务中会明显退化。这个现象提示，后训练数据和评测不能只覆盖“问模型该不该做”，还要覆盖“让模型直接产出专业工作物”时的规范稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 principal hierarchy 的测量框架，显式区分三类 principal：用户、机构权威和专业标准。数据覆盖法律和医疗两个领域。ground-truth 子集包含可验证事实，例如已被推翻的 Supreme Court precedent、已撤回药物；另有一组两个选项都合理的场景，用来隔离模型是否偏好某类 principal，而不是只是在追踪正确答案。场景生成采用 counterbalanced design：固定事实内容，只扰动 principal 配置、任务 framing 和压力水平。评测时不只看模型是否知道事实，还看它在冲突指令下是否把相关知识写入最终行动。
summary.experiments: 评测规模为 7,136 个场景、10 个 frontier models。其中 6,096 个场景有可验证专业标准，1,040 个场景包含两个同样有效但由不同 principal 支持的选项。主要发现包括：在 advisory tasks 中，模型通常更能维护专业标准；在 execution tasks 中，principal ordering 最多有 74% 的情况发生变化；医疗场景里 authority figure 往往比用户更容易被模型优先考虑，但法律场景不明显；不同模型家族表现不稳定。一个关键失败模式是 knowledge omission：每个 item 都先经过 per-model knowledge check，确认模型知道相关事实，但在 principal-demand conflict 下，模型没有把已知事实纳入最终输出，表现得像真正不知道一样。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解场景扰动如何控制内容不变、只改变 principal 和 framing。然后看数据构造与过滤流程，尤其是 per-model knowledge check，因为它决定了 failure mode 是否能归因于对齐冲突而不是知识缺失。结果部分重点看 advisory 与 execution 的差异，以及 legal 与 medical 的差异。若关心后训练评测，可重点看 failure mode taxonomy 和 pressure-level manipulation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures which principal a language model prioritizes when user requests, institutional authority, and professional standards conflict in high-stakes legal and medical settings.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an alignment-evaluation paper rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is that it moves evaluation beyond single-user preference following. The main lesson is that models can appear standards-aligned in advisory settings but become less stable when asked to draft or execute professional work. This has implications for post-training data design and safety evaluation: asking whether a model can state the rule is not enough; evaluations need to test whether the model applies the rule under conflicting demands.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define a principal hierarchy over three parties: the user, an authority figure, and the professional standard. They build counterbalanced legal and medical scenarios where factual content is held fixed while principal configuration, task framing, and pressure level are varied. The ground-truth subset uses verifiable professional facts, such as overruled Supreme Court cases and withdrawn drugs. A separate subset with two equally valid options isolates principal preference from correctness tracking. The evaluation separates knowledge possession from action: each item passes a per-model knowledge check before being used to test behavior under conflict.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 10 frontier models on 7,136 scenarios: 6,096 with verifiable professional standards and 1,040 with two valid options endorsed by competing principals. The key findings are that professional standards tend to dominate in advisory tasks, but the ordering can shift in up to 74% of cases under execution-style tasks; authority figures are often prioritized over users in medical contexts but not consistently in legal contexts; and model families differ substantially. The dominant failure mode is knowledge omission: models know the relevant fact during a knowledge check, yet fail to surface it when a conflicting principal demand appears in the task.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read Figures 1 and 2 first to understand the controlled perturbation design. Then inspect the dataset construction, especially the per-model knowledge filtering, because it supports the claim that failures are not simple ignorance. In the results, focus on advisory versus execution framing, legal versus medical differences, and the failure-mode analysis. For post-training evaluation work, the pressure manipulation and knowledge-omission analysis are the most reusable parts.

recommendation.zh: 对齐优先级量化方法可参考，发现的执行/咨询场景对齐差异可用于预训练对齐目标设计，重点看§3的测试集构造
recommendation.en: Refer to its alignment hierarchy quantification method, the observed execution-advisory scenario alignment gap can inform pre-training alignment objective design, focus on §3 test set construction

paper.title: SHRED: Retain-Set-Free Unlearning via Self-Distillation with Logit Demotion
paper.abstract: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) aims to selectively remove memorized content such as private data, copyrighted text, or hazardous knowledge, without costly full retraining. Most existing methods require a retain set of curated examples to prevent catastrophic degradation of general model utility, creating an extra data dependency that complicates deployment. We propose SHRED (Self-distillation via High-surprisal-only Retain-set-free Entropy Demotion), a retain-set-free unlear

summary.core_problem: 现有大模型机器遗忘方法大多依赖人工构造的保留集防止通用能力下降，保留集获取成本高且易引入领域偏置，无保留集的遗忘方法通常会严重损伤模型通用性能。
summary.importance: 在无保留集的前提下同时保证遗忘效果和通用能力保留，为预训练模型的事后数据合规、隐私移除提供了轻量化方案，无额外数据依赖，可适配持续遗忘场景。
summary.technical_approach: 核心洞察是遗忘集中的token记忆权重不均：高信息token（姓名、特定事件、特殊关系）对应模型预测的相对概率更低，低信息token（标点、停用词、通用表达）对应相对概率更高，反映通用语言能力。SHRED分为四个步骤：1）识别遗忘集中的高信息token位置；2）对高信息位置的对应token概率做降级处理，低信息位置保留原模型输出分布；3）以修改后的分布作为自蒸馏的教师信号；4）最小化待更新模型和教师信号的KL散度完成遗忘，全程不引入额外保留集。
summary.experiments: 在TOFU、MUSE、RWKU、Hubble四个常用遗忘基准上取得遗忘效果-通用能力 tradeoff的最优帕累托边界；抗重学习、成员推理攻击性能稳定，支持多轮持续遗忘；小批次更新下tradeoff最优，可适配小样本遗忘集；在TOFU基准上可主动修正模型因记忆产生的幻觉。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3章方法部分的token信息度判定逻辑和自蒸馏目标设计，第4章验证保留集无依赖有效性的消融实验，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM machine unlearning methods mostly rely on manually curated retain sets to prevent general capability degradation. Retain sets are costly to acquire and prone to introduce domain bias, while retain-set-free unlearning methods usually cause severe damage to model utility.
summary_en.importance: It achieves both effective unlearning and general capability preservation without any retain set, providing a lightweight solution for post-hoc data compliance and privacy removal of pretrained models, with no extra data dependency and adaptability to continual unlearning scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core insight is that tokens in the forget set have uneven memorization weights: high-information tokens (names, specific events, unique relations) correspond to lower relative prediction probability of the model, while low-information tokens (punctuation, stopwords, common expressions) correspond to higher relative probability that reflects general language competence. SHRED has four stages: 1) Identify high-information token positions in the forget set; 2) Demote the probability of target tokens at high-information positions, while keeping the original model output distribution at low-information positions; 3) Use the modified distribution as the teacher signal for self-distillation; 4) Minimize the KL divergence between the updated model and the teacher signal to complete unlearning, with no extra retain set introduced throughout the process.
summary_en.experiments: It reaches the optimal Pareto frontier of unlearning effect-general utility tradeoff on four common unlearning benchmarks: TOFU, MUSE, RWKU, Hubble. It is robust against relearning and membership inference attacks, and supports multi-round continual unlearning. The tradeoff performs best under small-batch updates, which adapts to small forget sets. It can actively correct hallucinations caused by memorization on the TOFU benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the token informativeness judgment logic and self-distillation objective design in Section 3 (Method), and the ablation experiments verifying retain-set-free effectiveness in Section 4. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 无需retain set的unlearning是实用进展，高信息token集中记忆的insight对理解LLM记忆机制有一定启发，建议skim方法部分。
recommendation.en: Retain-set-free unlearning is a practical advance; the insight that high-information tokens concentrate memorized knowledge is mildly illuminating for understanding LLM memory mechanisms. Skim the method section.

paper.title: One Turn Too Late: Response-Aware Defense Against Hidden Malicious Intent in Multi-Turn Dialogue
paper.abstract: Hidden malicious intent in multi-turn dialogue poses a growing threat to deployed large language models (LLMs). Rather than exposing a harmful objective in a single prompt, increasingly capable attackers can distribute their intent across multiple benign-looking turns. Recent studies show that even modern commercial models with advanced guardrails remain vulnerable to such attacks despite advances in safety alignment and external guardrails. In this work, we address this challenge by detecting t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多轮对话里的隐蔽恶意意图检测，但目标定义比常见的“判整段对话是否有害”更细。作者关心的是：在第 t 轮，若把当前候选回复交给用户，是否会让此前累积的信息第一次达到“足以实施有害行为”的阈值。这里的关键不是只看用户问题，而是把模型即将输出的候选回复也纳入判断，因为同一串用户提问，在模型只给高层概述时可能仍然安全，在模型补上可执行细节时才真正越线。论文把这个点形式化为 first harm-enabling turn，也就是最早的闭合点检测问题。
summary.importance: 对安全研究而言，这不是一个普通的 guardrail 分类器改进，而是把多轮攻击防御的目标从静态合规判断改成了时序化、响应感知的干预决策。这个改动有两层意义。第一，它指出 query-only 监控存在结构性上限：看不到候选回复，就无法区分“同样的上下文，给不同粒度回答时风险不同”的情况。第二，它把安全-可用性的权衡具体化为“既不能放过真正完成闭环的那一轮，也不能过早拒绝仍属探索性的对话”。从训练范式上看，这也很像把安全监控从 outcome label 推向 process-level supervision，对做对齐、在线监控、甚至 response reranking 的人都有参考价值。若从基座研究角度看，它不属于预训练方法，但对 post-train 安全信号设计、过程奖励构造、以及多轮交互中的 credit assignment 都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两部分组成：数据构建和响应感知监控器 TurnGate。先说任务设定。系统里有用户、基础助手和防御器三方。每一轮用户给出 q_t，基础助手先生成候选回复 r~_t，防御器在看到完整历史和当前候选回复后，决定 Pass 还是 Block。若 Block，则用拒答替换候选回复。作者采用单回合 episode 设定，把目标定义为尽可能在 first harm-enabling turn 上拦截。

数据方面，作者构建了 MTID。它不是从静态指令集直接拼出来，而是从针对前沿闭源模型的 adaptive multi-turn attack rollouts 派生而来，再配上 matched benign dialogues 用来测 over-refusal，并显式标注 first harm-enabling turns。这个标注设计很关键，因为普通的对话级有害/无害标签无法训练出“何时该拦”的精细边界。

模型方面，TurnGate 以 Qwen3-4B 为底座。训练分两阶段。第一阶段是基于细粒度 turn-level 标签的监督微调，让模型先学会在每一轮做 Pass/Block 判定。第二阶段进一步做 multi-turn RL，并使用 turn-level process rewards。按作者的描述，这个奖励不是只看最终是否拦住整段攻击，而是鼓励模型在正确的闭合点拦截，同时惩罚过早拒绝和过晚放行。这样做的原因很直接：如果只用最终成败做奖励，模型容易学成过度保守的策略；而 process reward 把时间定位误差也纳入优化目标，更贴合真实部署需求。

和现有方法相比，差异主要有三点。第一，区别于标准 guardrail 或 alignment policy，它不是对单轮请求做静态合规判断，而是对“历史+候选回复”做时序决策。第二，区别于只看用户 query 的监控器，它显式利用 response-aware 信息。第三，区别于只做 dialogue-level judgment 的方法，它把监督粒度下沉到 turn level，并用 RL 去优化安全与可用性的边界位置，而不是只优化最终标签。
summary.experiments:
从引言和任务描述能确认，实验分为 offline evaluation 和 closed-loop online battles 两类，并且覆盖跨领域、跨攻击管线、跨目标模型的泛化测试。核心结论是：TurnGate 相比 response-blind baselines 有更好的 safety-utility trade-off，既能更早、更准地拦住真正完成有害闭环的轮次，也能减少 benign 对话上的 over-refusal。

全文片段里已经明确的实验要点有几项。其一，训练底座是 Qwen3-4B。其二，数据来自对 frontier commercial models 的自适应攻击 rollout，而不是单一模板攻击，因此评测更接近真实对抗。其三，作者特别强调 matched benign dialogues，这意味着实验不是只看 attack success reduction，也同时看误拒率。其四，在线 battle 设计说明攻击者会根据防御行为继续适配，而不是离线固定样本，这对验证多轮防御是否真的有效很重要。

不过，当前给出的全文片段没有包含完整结果表、具体数值、各基线名称、消融细节和统计显著性信息，因此无法负责任地填入提升百分比、AUC、ASR 降幅、误拒率绝对值等数字。精读时应重点补齐：1）response-aware 相对 query-only 的增益幅度；2）SFT-only 相对 SFT+RL 的增益；3）在不同攻击域和不同目标模型上的迁移表现；4）first harm-enabling turn 标注一致性与误差分布；5）若有 ablation，候选回复、历史长度、拒答替换策略分别贡献多少。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看问题定义和 threat model，再看数据标注协议，最后看 RL 奖励设计与在线对抗实验。最值得精读的地方有四个。

第一，看 first harm-enabling turn 的定义是否足够可操作。这里决定了任务是不是一个稳定的学习目标。要特别留意作者如何处理“信息已接近充分但仍缺关键一步”的边界案例，以及标注者是否依据可执行性、危险性还是政策文本来判定闭合。

第二，看 MTID 的构造流程。重点不是数据量，而是攻击 rollout 如何生成、是否覆盖不同危害域、benign 匹配是按主题还是按表面形式匹配、以及是否存在由攻击器风格泄漏带来的捷径。

第三，看 RL 的 process reward。这里是方法真正可能带来增益的地方。需要确认奖励是否显式区分过早拦截、恰当拦截、过晚拦截三种情况，是否有 reward hacking 风险，以及训练时是否用到了环境模拟或固定攻击轨迹。

第四，看 online battle 的协议。多轮安全方法常在离线分类上看起来不错，但一旦攻击者适配就失效。要重点看攻击者是否知道防御器存在、是否能根据拒答重写策略、以及评测终止条件如何设定。

如果时间有限，优先读 Introduction、Problem Formulation、数据集章节、RL 训练章节和在线实验章节。图表上优先看任务示意图、主结果表、response-aware ablation、以及错误案例分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies hidden malicious intent in multi-turn dialogue, but with a sharper objective than standard harmful/benign classification. The goal is to detect the earliest turn at which releasing the current candidate response would make the accumulated interaction sufficient for harmful action. This is a response-aware closure problem, not just a user-intent problem. The same sequence of user queries may remain acceptable if the assistant stays high-level, yet become dangerous once the model provides the missing actionable detail. The paper formalizes this as detecting the first harm-enabling turn before the response is delivered.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is not merely a better safety classifier. It reframes multi-turn defense from static compliance judgment to temporally localized intervention. That matters for two reasons. First, it exposes a structural limitation of query-only monitors: without access to the candidate response, they cannot tell whether the current turn actually completes the harmful plan. Second, it turns the safety-utility trade-off into a precise decision problem: block too late and the attack succeeds; block too early and benign exploratory dialogue is unnecessarily refused. For researchers working on alignment, online monitoring, process supervision, or response reranking, this is a useful formulation shift. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to post-training signal design, multi-turn credit assignment, and response-conditioned safety control.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method combines a new dataset with a response-aware monitor called TurnGate. The interaction protocol has three parties: user, base assistant, and defender. At turn t, the user sends q_t, the assistant produces a candidate response r~_t, and the defender observes the full history plus r~_t before deciding Pass or Block. If blocked, the candidate response is replaced by a refusal. The learning target is to intervene exactly at the first harm-enabling turn.

For data, the authors build MTID, derived from adaptive multi-turn attack rollouts against frontier commercial models. The dataset also includes matched benign dialogues to measure over-refusal, and explicit annotations of first harm-enabling turns. This annotation choice is central. Dialogue-level harmfulness labels are too coarse for learning when to intervene.

TurnGate is trained on top of Qwen3-4B in two stages. Stage one is supervised fine-tuning on turn-level labels. Stage two adds multi-turn reinforcement learning with turn-level process rewards. The reward is designed to favor timely interception at the closure turn while penalizing both premature refusal and delayed blocking. This is an important design choice: optimizing only final attack success would likely push the monitor toward overly conservative behavior, whereas process rewards align the objective with precise temporal localization.

Relative to prior approaches, the differences are clear. It is not a single-turn policy compliance checker. It is not a query-only monitor. And it is not trained only on dialogue-level judgments. The novelty lies in response-aware turn-level supervision plus RL for optimizing the intervention boundary itself.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text excerpts, the evaluation includes both offline benchmarks and closed-loop online battles against adaptive attackers, with tests spanning domains, attacker pipelines, and target models. The headline result is that TurnGate improves the safety-utility trade-off over response-blind baselines: it blocks harmful closure turns more accurately while reducing over-refusal on benign conversations.

Several experimental facts are explicit in the text. The monitor is built from Qwen3-4B. MTID is constructed from adaptive attacks on frontier commercial models rather than static prompt templates, which makes the setting more realistic. The inclusion of matched benign dialogues means the paper evaluates utility loss, not only attack suppression. The online battle setup also matters: the attacker can adapt during interaction, so the results are more informative than fixed offline classification.

That said, the provided excerpt does not include the main result tables, exact baseline names, ablation numbers, or confidence intervals. So it would be unsafe to invent concrete gains. When reading the full paper, the key numbers to extract are: the margin of response-aware monitoring over query-only baselines; the gain from SFT to SFT+RL; transfer across attack domains and target models; annotation consistency for first harm-enabling turns; and any ablations on candidate-response access, context length, or refusal replacement policy.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the task definition and threat model, then move to the annotation protocol for MTID, and only then read the RL objective and online evaluation. Four parts deserve close attention.

First, inspect how the first harm-enabling turn is defined. This determines whether the task is learnable and reproducible. Pay attention to borderline cases where the dialogue is nearly sufficient but still missing one critical detail, and to whether the labeling criterion is based on actionability, policy violation, or practical misuse potential.

Second, read the MTID construction carefully. The important questions are how the adaptive rollouts are generated, how broad the harm domains are, how benign dialogues are matched, and whether the monitor could exploit stylistic artifacts from the attack generator instead of learning genuine closure detection.

Third, focus on the process reward in RL. This is likely where much of the gain comes from. Check whether the reward explicitly distinguishes early, correct, and late intervention; whether there is room for reward hacking; and whether training uses a simulated environment or fixed trajectories.

Fourth, examine the online battle protocol. Multi-turn safety methods often look good offline and then fail once the attacker adapts. Look for whether the attacker is aware of the defender, whether it can rewrite strategy after refusals, and how success or termination is defined.

If time is limited, prioritize the Introduction, Problem Formulation, dataset section, RL training section, and online experiments. The most informative figures and tables should be the task illustration, the main safety-utility results, the response-aware ablation, and the error analysis.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但它把安全从“识别坏输入”改成“识别何时形成可执行闭环”，对对话状态建模和 refusal data 设计有实打实启发；先看任务定义和 MTID 标注协议。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it reframes safety from spotting bad prompts to detecting when a dialogue becomes action-enabling; that is useful for dialogue-state modeling and refusal-data design—read the task definition and MTID annotation scheme first.

paper.title: Information Theoretic Adversarial Training of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial prompting despite advances in alignment and safety, often exhibiting harmful behaviors under novel attack strategies. While adversarial training can improve robustness, existing approaches are computationally expensive and difficult to scale. Recent continuous adversarial training methods, such as Continuous adversarial training (CAT) and Continuous Adversarial Preference Optimization (CAPO), address this challenge by leveraging gradi

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM连续对抗训练方法普遍对样本对抗损失做均匀聚合，对罕见但高损失的对抗样本权重不足，同时需要平衡鲁棒性提升、计算开销与模型效用三者的 tradeoff。
summary.importance: 为对抗训练的损失聚合逻辑提供了信息论视角的优化思路，可直接集成到现有连续对抗训练流水线中，无需修改攻击生成过程，适配大模型规模化训练需求。
summary.technical_approach: 提出WARDEN框架，基于f散度分布鲁棒优化（DRO）对连续对抗训练的样本损失做动态重加权；不再最小化平均对抗损失，改为最小化经验训练分布的散度球内的最坏期望损失。KL散度下目标简化为log-sum-exp形式，通过双变量λ控制重加权强度，支持λ可训练或每轮用二分法计算两种策略，可无缝嵌入现有连续对抗训练流程。
summary.experiments: 在多个LLM、多种攻击设置下可降低攻击成功率，同时模型效用、计算开销与基线连续对抗训练方法相当。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第1章的问题定义、第3章的DRO重加权公式推导，预计阅读时间15分钟；落地部署可参考第4章的λ调度策略。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing continuous adversarial training methods for LLMs uniformly aggregate per-sample adversarial losses, underweighting rare but high-loss adversarial cases, and need to balance robustness improvement, computational cost, and model utility.
summary_en.importance: Provides an information-theoretic optimization direction for adversarial training loss aggregation logic, can be directly integrated into existing continuous adversarial training pipelines without modifying attack generation processes, and adapts to large-scale LLM training requirements.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes WARDEN, a distributionally robust optimization (DRO) framework based on f-divergence for dynamic reweighting of continuous adversarial training losses. Instead of minimizing average adversarial loss, it minimizes the worst-case expected loss over the f-divergence ball around the empirical training distribution. Under KL divergence, the objective reduces to a log-sum-exp form, with reweighting strength controlled by a dual variable λ that can be either trainable or computed per iteration via bisection. It is fully compatible with existing continuous adversarial training workflows.
summary_en.experiments: Reduces attack success rates across multiple LLMs and attack settings, with model utility and computational overhead comparable to strong continuous adversarial training baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem definition in Section 1, the DRO reweighting formula derivation in Section 3, estimated reading time 15 minutes. For production deployment, refer to the λ scheduling strategy in Section 4.

recommendation.zh: DRO 外壳不新，但它把 CAT/CAPO 的样本权重问题摆到台面；先看目标函数和鲁棒性-有用性实验。
recommendation.en: The DRO wrapper is not new, but it exposes the sample-weighting issue in CAT/CAPO; read the objective and the robustness-utility experiments first.

paper.title: On the Hardness of Junking LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are known to be vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, which typically rely on carefully designed prompts containing explicit semantic structure. These attacks generally operate by fixing an adversarial instruction and optimizing small adversarial components (e.g., suffixes or prefixes). In this setting, prompt structure is fundamental for performance, and recent results show that even simple random search can achieve strong performance when combined with sophisticated pro

summary.core_problem: 研究“junking”设定下自然后门的可发现性：在没有任何语义提示、没有有害指令、没有模板的情况下，只优化一段纯 token 序列，能否诱导安全对齐后的 LLM 输出指定的有害目标内容；以及这种序列在搜索难度、查询复杂度、以及在模型分布下的概率质量上处于什么位置。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发不在“如何训练更强”，而在“预训练/对齐会在多大程度上留下极低概率但可触发的异常行为通道”。它把 jailbreak 从“语义结构引导的提示攻击”推进到“无语义触发器”的层面，并用一个非常弱的黑盒基线证明：即便不借助梯度与模板，仍可能找到触发序列，但代价显著更高。对预训练侧的价值主要体现在两点：1）把安全失败模式与模型的低概率区域（low-likelihood strings）联系起来，提示仅靠分布内对齐可能覆盖不到这些角落；2）提供了一个可操作的 hardness 视角（序列长度/查询数/接受率）来量化“自然后门”搜索难度，便于后续把它变成训练期的正则或数据/目标改造问题。
summary.technical_approach:
把攻击形式化为离散 token 序列的直接优化：目标是最大化模型在给定触发序列时生成某个目标有害输出（或其似然）的能力。与常见 suffix/prefix jailbreak 不同，这里不固定有害指令、不提供任何语义 scaffolding，触发序列本身就是全部输入。
方法上给出一个极简黑盒基线：greedy random search。迭代过程中对当前序列做单 token 替换提案（随机挑位置与候选 token），用查询得到的目标打分（文中描述为“增加生成目标的似然则接受”），否则拒绝；重复直到达到预算或成功。这个算法刻意弱化：不需要梯度、不需要连续松弛、不需要外部 LM 做 prompt 改写，也不依赖模板工程。作者用它来回答一个关键问题：如果连这种方法都能挖到触发器，说明模型里确实存在“可达”的自然后门通路；反之若失败，才需要把成功归因于更强的白盒优化（如 GCG）。
分析层面，作者额外做了“触发序列在模型分布下的概率”诊断：用 perplexity/likelihood 评估发现的 junk 序列，观察其是否落在极低概率区域，从而支持“不是训练中常见模式的复现，而是分布角落的异常触发”。
summary.experiments:
实验以多个主流安全对齐 LLM 为对象（全文未在给定内容中列出具体型号与版本细节），比较 junking 与标准 suffix 攻击在搜索成本上的差异。核心现象有三类：
1）可行性：在若干模型上，纯 token 序列在无语义条件下仍能诱导目标有害行为，说明自然后门并非只在白盒/强优化下才存在。
2）难度：相较标准 suffix/prefix jailbreak，需要更长的触发序列与显著更多的查询次数，体现语义结构对搜索空间的强约束作用；junking 去掉语义后，搜索退化为在巨大离散空间里爬山。
3）分布位置：成功序列的 perplexity 极高/likelihood 极低，表明这些触发器处在模型几乎不会自然生成的区域；作者据此主张它们更像“训练与对齐过程自然涌现的后门角落”，而非某种高概率的可解释模板。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含具体数值表格与成功率/查询预算的精确数字，无法在不臆测的情况下复述参数量、数据规模或提升幅度。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看问题定义与 Figure 1（若全文包含）：明确 junking 与传统 suffix/prompt-template jailbreak 的差别，尤其是“无有害指令、无模板、仅序列”。
- 重点读方法部分对 greedy random search 的接受准则与打分函数定义：它决定了这是在优化“目标输出的条件似然”还是某种 proxy（例如特定 token/短语的出现概率）。
- 读实验设置：模型列表、目标有害行为的定义、查询预算、序列长度上限、以及成功判定（自动判别还是人工/分类器）。这些细节决定结论能否外推。
- 读 perplexity/likelihood 分析：这是全文与“预训练分布角落”联系最紧的部分；建议同时关注作者是否对比了随机序列、标准 suffix、以及自然语言 prompt 的概率分布。
- 若时间允许，检查失败案例与搜索轨迹：接受率随迭代变化、是否出现局部最优、以及不同初始化对结果的敏感性，这些都与“hardness”刻画相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the discoverability and hardness of “natural backdoors” in aligned LLMs under a junk-only setting: can one elicit a targeted harmful behavior using only an optimized token sequence, with no semantic prompt template and no explicit harmful instruction, and how hard is it to find such sequences in a black-box manner?
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but concrete: it links safety failures to extremely low-probability regions of the model distribution, suggesting that alignment and data-driven safety training may leave exploitable pockets in the tail. The work also proposes a practical notion of hardness (sequence length, query budget, search dynamics) for measuring how accessible these tail triggers are. This is useful if one wants to turn “tail-trigger robustness” into a training-time objective, a data/regularization intervention, or a diagnostic during continual pretraining and alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The attack is formulated as discrete optimization over a trigger token sequence whose sole purpose is to maximize the likelihood of producing a target harmful output. Unlike standard jailbreaks (suffix/prefix attacks) that keep a harmful instruction and rely on semantic scaffolding, this setting removes all semantics: the trigger sequence is the entire input.
Methodologically, the paper intentionally uses a weak black-box baseline: a greedy random-search procedure that proposes single-token substitutions and accepts a change if it increases the objective score (described as increasing the likelihood of generating the target). No gradients, no continuous relaxation, no auxiliary LM prompt rewriting, and no prompt templates.
A key diagnostic is distributional: the discovered triggers are evaluated via perplexity/likelihood under the same model to determine whether they lie in high-probability (training-like) regions or in the extreme tail. The reported outcome is that successful triggers are assigned extremely low probability, supporting the “natural backdoor in the tail” framing.
summary_en.experiments:
Across several popular safety-aligned LLMs (specific model/version details are not present in the provided full-text excerpt), the paper reports:
- Feasibility: even without semantic prompts, some models admit junk triggers that elicit targeted harmful behavior.
- Hardness gap: compared to standard suffix attacks, junking typically requires much longer trigger sequences and substantially more queries, highlighting how semantic structure constrains the search space.
- Tail characterization: successful triggers have very high perplexity / extremely low likelihood, indicating they are far from what the model would naturally generate.
(Note: the provided content does not include the numerical tables/plots needed to quote exact success rates, budgets, or model sizes without guessing.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with the formal problem definition and the main figure illustrating junking vs suffix/template jailbreaks.
- Read the exact objective and acceptance criterion of the greedy random search; this determines what is truly being optimized (full target string likelihood vs a proxy).
- Inspect the experimental protocol: model list, harmful target specification, query budgets, max trigger length, and success evaluation (classifier vs human).
- Focus on the perplexity/likelihood analysis section; it is the main bridge to pretraining-distribution arguments.
- If available, look at search trajectories/ablation on initialization and token-replacement strategy to understand the claimed hardness.

recommendation.zh: 先看 threat model 和搜索难度定义；如果实验预算讲清楚，它比普通 jailbreak prompt 更能暴露 post-train 没覆盖的预训练残留风险。
recommendation.en: Start with the threat model and hardness definition; if the compute budget is clean, this is more diagnostic of residual pretraining risk than another jailbreak prompt paper.
